reviewsWithKeywords.title: Isla Mujeres Day Trip well worth the time!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful beach! Great little town with sort of a backpackers vibe. Reminded me a lot of Koh San road in Thailand where there are a lot of the backpackers hostels. Would recommend visiting. We ate at the Guru Beach Club Restaurant. Food was delicious! And the service was amazing. Our family of 4 adults were welcomed warmly and we appreciated the attentiveness of the hostess!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Nice beach, but beware of the traps
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The beach is beautiful but predatory tourism. Don't pee package ride. It's hollowed. Go alone and pay to stay at a bar for lunch. Go out cheaper!They do anything to blackmail you.Careful!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: It’s a great beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The beach is amazing. We’ve been to to some nice beaches in Florida, Thailand, down the coast in Tellum and this is right up there with them. Beautiful sand. We could walk a couple hundred yards out into the water and have it just up to our waist.The island itself seems very walkable. Sure I got offered somethings at night in the shops and restaurants area I was not interested in (powder & pot) but other than that it felt safe. The locals are very friendly and having poor Spanish was not a problem.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful Scenery with a High-Energy Atmosphere
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Playa Norte is undeniably a beautiful beach. The sand is spectacular, the water is crystal clear and gorgeous, and the natural scenery with the palm trees and pelicans is postcard-perfect. However, there is a significant issue that visitors should be aware of: the noise levels, particularly at night.There are several Palapas located along the beach that do not seem to follow any noise restrictions or respect the shared nature of the space. On multiple occasions during our stay, extremely loud, bass-heavy music blasted from these venues, making it a very non-restful experience while our family was trying to sleep.It is disappointing that such a beautiful natural landmark is being negatively impacted by a few businesses that are not respectful of the area. I hope that the local authorities will step in to work more closely with the resorts to better enforce noise ordinances.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Ok, but....
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful water, ok beach clubs, not too easy to get service, not crowded at all, very Nice.Very cosy city center with a lot of restaurants and good food.Hoyel zone at Cancun you can keep.But if we compare with Maldives or also Malaysia, .....sorry.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: I comming back agains every year for long time
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Very nice litle city and i come back agains... the playa was excellente and beautiful ...my litle girl was very satisfaction

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful beach in the early morning before the arrival of boats and the world. Long beach with coconut trees very clear and clean water.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful white sands
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This is a very nice beach albeit alot busy that Playa Centro. The sands are white and the waters blue with a lot of people around. There are some nice places to eat along this beach too.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Paradise
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Crystal clear sea that leaves you speechless. Beach with flour-white sand, very long and spacious.You do not pay for access but you can want to pay to book chairs and umbrellas only in cash.Nearby there are plenty of spartan places offering typical food.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Visit
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Very good trip we really enjoyed visiting Isla Mujeres, everything very close, clean and beautiful.I highly recommend them..

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach... when the weather allows
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Very nice beach, which unfortunately we enjoyed too quickly because of the bad weather during our stay ... so we were not able to take full advantage and discover all its assets...

reviewsWithKeywords.title: The best beach of my trip
reviewsWithKeywords.text: To my mind, the best beach within Cancun. Quieter, Crystal-clear Water, Very Good Mood, Beautiful Views. I was little but it was my favorite

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Go go go!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Did a catamaran excursion to Isla Mujeres.  Has some time at Playa Norte beach was so nice! Warm water, soft sand and very little Sawgrass. Ate at Playa Norte Beach Club  was very good food and excellent service!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beaches
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beaches without sargassum, spectacular film climate and lots of heat, crystal clear waters. It may rain but always warm and a few minutes pass and the sun returns. Carry housing to take photos underwater. Carry lots of water (with ice)

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Just dreamy!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Amazing! Without a doubt the best beach in Mexico, you can see a lot of fauna just with a basic snorkel on the beach, the beach is very safe, you can leave your things there and go quiet to the sea, the restaurants in the area are delicious!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Love it!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We spent a great couple of hours here in the late afternoon. The sand and water were both beautiful. It was busy with lots of boat trips present. There were also plenty of bars along the beach to visit.
Beautiful wide, white sand beach with a very wide area of waist deep, clear water. Great end to our day of exported island.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Paradise is on Playa Norte Isla Mujeres.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Playa Norte de Isla Mujeres is a paradise!  We returned after 10 years to this amazing place. This time we stayed for 13 days and we knew little. The sea is beautiful, calm, transparent, with an ideal temperature. The environment and its energy is magical. The sunsets are prettier than each other. Walk along Hidalgo pedestrian street, dine in its excellent restaurants, listen to good music. Everything was beautiful. Just thank you and have the opportunity to come back soon. This is the place if you want to connect with the beauty of a unique place.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Isla Paradiso
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Everything you have read, and then some. We stayed on the island, and took our rented golf cart there. Was a little tough to find parking, but that was expected. We decided to rent a couple of loungers and posted up right on the beach, about 5 feet from the ocean. I wish I could remember our server, as he was amazing! You can walk for what seems like forever out into the ocean, with just amazing colored water, and every one in a while, a small school of fish, or something tropical. If you go to Isla, you have to check it out.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Crowded & shallow
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Wasn't impressed.  Water is too shallow to swim unless you walk way out, beach was crowded.  Much preferred private beach owned by Indios Golf Carts.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach with shallow waters
reviewsWithKeywords.text: A very beautiful beach with shallow waters. Great safe option for people who do not know to swim. I found this beach while searching for shallow waters. I felt very safe in the waters here.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Playa Norte 2025
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The most beautiful beach I have ever been to. Azure and crystal clear waters, clean sand and no trash! Lots of beach clubs near by for chairs, food or drinks.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach fun for all the family
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful beach with white sand and turquoise water. multiple options for sunloungers and places to grab a drink or two easy access with pushchair. Large sea front so doesn't feel packed

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Weekend on Isla Mujeres/Playa Norte
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This beach is nothing short of AMAZING!!! The water was crystal clear while we were there. No seaweed in sight! The white sand is soft on your feet. No need for water shoes here! Calm, safe water perfect for swimming, or floating on a lounge.It does get crowded. There are tons of beach clubs with chair rentals, bars, food, massages, & more. Some people bring their own chairs or beach blankets. We didnt have kids with us, but we saw lots of kids there. Gentle beach perfect for little ones. There were a couple of vendors along the beach, but they weren’t pushy. In fact I looked forward to the popcycle cart in the afternoons! I loved the laid back, easy atmosphere of the island.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: The best beach.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The best beach of Isla Mujeres and one of the best beaches in the world..it looks like a pool/aquarium..you can swim with many fish, perfect for young children..

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Superb
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Amazing the best spectacular beach without any doubt very nice recommended very quiet to spend the holidays

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Pretty blue crystal beach🫶🌊⛱️
reviewsWithKeywords.text: It’s so good there are a bunch of good food places and it’s very pretty it’s usually packed in the afternoon but still a vibe the water is very pretty,and salty. But overall a pretty beach you should visit , hope this helped😉

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Over crowded
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Totally overrun with tourists, not quaint. Hard to appreciate the beauty of the place when it is wall-wall people. We went about 3-6, it might have been better to rent a golf cart and explore like some people do. But, so many boats blaring music and a lane line/ rope restricting swimmers to about 10 feet of ocean. Tourist trap.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: A paradise
reviewsWithKeywords.text: A paradise looked like we were in a pool the sea is very quiet to be able to swim safely, very clean, highly recommended

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Paradise on earth
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Paradise on earth ... clear water and shades of dreamy turquoise blues .. privatize a catamaran and enjoy the experience to the fullest

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Underwhelming
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The staff were amazing. Loved sitting on the trampoline.  First stop beach club for lunch. Passable food. Beach and water quite unappealing. The second stop was supposed to be Playa Norte, which is why we went. It was just a swim where the boat anchored to wait for a docking space. The current was strong and we just hung onto a rope. The stop on the island is essentially to sell you on renting a golf cart. But you can walk to Playa Norte. No snacks on the boat. No alcohol in the drinks. And it was too long. I suggest to the company skip the second stop and make it back to dock by 5:30.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Over crowded —hassle —-over priced. Not worth it
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Isla Mujeres. Is over run with visitors.  Not great experience. Upon arrival u are bombarded with hassle to buy junk. To point of being rude. Beach is great but otherwise not great. I won’t go there again. I have been going there once yr since 2005 and has been ruined with crowds   —sad joey

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Our 10th trip to Isla Mujeres.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I’ve been here many times and this trip was wonderful. The sand for the beach is there (other years it was washed out to sea) so it made it a joy to walk around versus dodging everyone. We came during Carnival which adds to the culture experience. I highly recommend you visiting if you are looking for a relaxing vacation

reviewsWithKeywords.title: One of the world's best beaches!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Best beach ever! We got married here. The sand is powder fine...beautiful! At the far east end us a lagoon to snorkel.  At the west TMS there's usually massages on the beach. All kinds in food and drink service in between.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Chaotic
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful, but surrounded by boats is full of people. Obviously being the only large sandy beach everyone flocks here.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Amazing beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: One of the most beautiful beaches I've ever been to. Water is shallow and calm. Pristine and clear. Loved the beach clubs

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Not attractive
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The positive reviews of the beach and the island are beyond me. The beach is relatively small for the crowds (at least in early January), the water is milky, there are no nice diving or snorkeling opportunities and even the view over the water was blocked by countless small yachts that brought day trippers. I would not recommend a stay on this beach and on the faceless island to anyone.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Not worth the hype
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Not worth the time or expense from Cancun.  This is an "emperor's clothes" place, the playa Norte beach is absolutely jammed (even in the off season), streets are crowded and crazy, and not at all what we were hoping to experience.  Rented a golf cart and toured around the island, which took all of 90 minutes -- mostly poor, beaches inaccessible, main town crowded and touristy.  No thanks, we'll stay in Cancun.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful beach with plenty of amenities and local treasure to explore. Ideal for groups ranging from families with small kids to adults looking to enjoy themselves.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Best beach in Cancun by far
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This is the best beach in Cancun.Forget about the Hotel strip, Isla Mujeres is the best beach.It is calm, turquoise color, you can walk mile with water below your waist line.Every time that I go to Cancun I have to visit Playa Norte.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beach massage at Tarzan
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I’m not sure where else to put this but I am so grateful for the massage I received behind the Tarzan bar with Anna. She squeezed me in as they were closing and the massage was so relaxing. I felt very spoiled:)

reviewsWithKeywords.title: One of the most beautiful beaches in the world
reviewsWithKeywords.text: One of the best beaches in the world and we have it in Mexico!! We arrived one day Thursday, Dec 12, it was very quiet but the following Friday, the number of people increased. The way here is two, 1 (without spending) would be to bring everything you need to spend several hours at the beach, drinks, food and where to cover yourself a bit of the sun. 2 (paying) you can rent beds that include a good size umbrella, recline, etc; for this way if you would have to consume any drink or some additional snack to rent your beds, time is free from 9 am to 5 pm, I would include the use of bathrooms (by the way they are very good and clean). Access to the beach is free and practically very close to the hotel and hostel area. You’ll love it if you consider carrying children because the water depth is very adequate, you could move forward several meters and an adult would reach the knees. Excellent option !!! Don't hesitate to come

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Lovely beach and island in its entirety
reviewsWithKeywords.text: An absolutely fantastic beach a lot of people etc but the whole island is lovely cozy restaurants and bars a bit anywhere on the island. Recommend 3-4 nights on the island and rent golf cart. A day trip just gives you more taste

reviewsWithKeywords.title: A beach paradise
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This place is magical. Your beach for those of us who can't swim is theBetterYou walk and walk inside the sea and without problemShe definitely loved it.My only recommendation is eye on arrivalThey offer rental of beds and umbrellas when in some restaurants in the area they include them with the consumption From the ferry to the beach it is also safe to walk without renting taxis

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Wonder of the World
reviewsWithKeywords.text: It is possible to walk about 150 meters into the sea with water in the waist. Great for children and people who like to relax in a calm and warm sea.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Location and confrontation north beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful beach and clean, there is no public shower on the north beach, but also shower in the Tarzan kiosk if I don't mistake for $15 pesos and there is shower for $15 pesos also in the center beach.The beer on the beach costs $90 pesos and in the store on the street next to $35 rs for those who want to take a 150m walk and save a little.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Best mexican beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: One of the most beautiful beach i ever seen crystal clear blue water white sand beach nice vibe relaxing....going back april 2025

reviewsWithKeywords.title: LOOK NO FURTHER!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: UNMATCHED the sand seems talcum, the temperature unbeatable, very clean, minimum wave ideal for the little ones, the breathtaking view; what more can you ask for?

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The beach is very quiet, like swimming pool. Idwal to be with young children. No toilets were seen nearby but if premises and restaurants

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great for small kids.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The water here on the side closest to all inclusive MIA is very shallow and calm, great for small children to play in. The water is crystal clear and you can walk a long time before it gets deep. The locals do daily excursions from Cancun for people to snorkel here. They feed the fish so there are plenty that live there at all times. You can take towels and drinks to the beach or can pay to sit on the chairs at the beach clubs.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach; good food
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Very beautiful beach.  It’s clean and has everything you need.  There is a buffet there which is pretty good and has decent variety.  There are also all kinds of drinks.  I definitely recommend visiting this beach and enjoying it for a few hours.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: It's not paradise
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I stayed in a hotel in front of the North Beach, and beware that it is NOT PARADISE or similar, all day there is a lot of noise from the Beach Club and yachts parked near the beach, the space is collapsed, only in the morning until 9 am approximately the beach is paradise because there are few people. I stayed 4 nights on this beach and would not do it again, it is much better the south side of the island, much less people and beaches equal or more beautiful. I leave a picture of this morning from the beach of my hotel. If you want to go go early and it is not worth staying here.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Excellent place to vacation
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The best beach if you want to swim and at the same time be calm, looks like a huge pool.In addition, the people who inhabit the place make it a super pleasant experience.She's beautiful!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Amazing.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: It certainly honors that it is one of the most beautiful beaches in the world. The ones of Cancun certainly my favorites but this beach does go one level up for my taste.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful Playa Norte
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Isla Mujeres is my new favourite travel destination and Playa Norte especially makes it so special. Beautiful warm clear water and soft white sand.Would recommend staying at least a few days and definitely more amazing to visit before 11am when boats etc pop in for day trips. Make sure you stay for a sunset also, truly stunning. Plenty of room to just bring your own towel and soak up the sun.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Go very early and take the ferry.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We went there very early by ferry before the massive crowds arrived and it was stunning. Crystal clear water and a beautiful beach. It reminded me a lot of how all of Yucatán used to be in the nineties. After eleven all the booze cruise’s arrived and I just saw people taking selfies and then hopping back on the boats. I guess I’m old but it just felt very surreal to me. This truly is a gorgeous island but overrun by tourists stinking up the place in golfcarts. It’s great to visit for a day but I wouldn’t stay much longer since it’s so jam-packed with tourists.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Love playa Norte
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I’ve been to Isla Mujeres and playa norte over 12 times and it’s one of my favorite destinations so much so that I got married on playa Norte and have even made friends here. I spend about 10 days every summer here. The beach is beautiful with calm clear water and soft sand. Safety is never an issue as isla has a naval base so you will see officers walking up and down playa Norte frequently. On playa Norte there is something for everyone from beach clubs to bringing your own beach blanket. The vendors walk the beach but are never pushy or force you to buy anything. All the islanders and locals are so kind and friendly. Like any other place as long as u aren’t rude and respect people’s culture and the island you’ll have a great time. It’s possible to go to isla on a budget by buying street food and drinks from the local corner stores. For deeper water go to playa centro for shallow super calm water playa Norte and then near Mia reef resort you’ll find lots of fish to snorkel.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Must visit!! Stunning!!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful!Amazing clear waters.Think we paid 250 pesos for 2 subbed and parasol for the day.Bars, ice cream and fresh fruit all on sale.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Visit this beach, you'll be so glad that you did!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Playa Norte Beach truly is a paradise for anyone. The island it is on is easily accessible, being just off the coast from Cancun; it is super close to the where the ferries, catamarans, and other sea vessels dock; the sand is very fine ground, beautifully white (retains less heat for more comfortable barefoot walking); the beach overall is super clean / well-maintained; the carribean sea is visually stunning with the green and blue gradients as far as the eye can see; and the sea is shallow (at most waist deep for me, and I'm on the shorter side) for what is said to be over 200 yards; the water is crystal clear, making all kinds of marine life visibal at great distances both above and below the water; and the water temperature is absolutely perfect, especially on a hot and humid day. There are also plenty of shops, restaurants, and entertainment all around. If you're ever staying on Isla Mujeres or on a nearby island or mainland city, checking out Playa Norte is a must!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: The best beach ive been to
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We took a Catamaran tour which parked up right on the beach that let us dive and swim in the water. After that we had 2 hours of free time and i had to check out the beach and i dont regret it. The waters were calm and clear and the sand was amazing! Next time i would love to book a resort right up on this beach!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Playa Norte, a piece of paradise
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I've been to several beaches and islands around the world. Playa norte is very high on the list among the most beautiful beaches.I'm there now in mid June, which is  low and rainy season. It felt like a piece of paradise. Powdery white sand, just enough waves for the fun, swimming is great for everyone including kids.Very good level of security which is very important as I'm a solo traveler. I haven't been harassed by beach hawkers, I just say No gracias, or buy fruits or drinks from them. No big deal!Even when it rains for 2 or 3 hrs then the weather clears up, it's paradise again.I didn't like to stay in one of those expensive beach front hotel. I walked 3 mins from my beautiful clean hotel everyday, for a swim & a few hrs relaxing on the beach.It's very nice to do long walks if you want to be a bit more active. One side is for swimming and the other side is more rough & no swimming. The view is breathtaking. There were less people in June, still it didn't feel isolated. May be better to travel in this period if you dont mind a bit of rain.l but you'll have much more peace & Privacy. The beach front hotels have more people on loungers next to each other, I don't like that, but there's plenty of space for everyone if you Choose your spot, see pics

reviewsWithKeywords.title: A paradise
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The beach is beautiful and worth the trip.We stayed in Cancún and took the trip to Isla das Mujeres by Catamaran.Arriving on the island we rented a golf cart to get to the beach.It really is very beautiful.Clear waters and calm sea.We do not rent chairs or umbrellas.We left our belongings on the sand and enjoyed the sea.It's worth the view.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Caribbean
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Of course we were on the best beach on Isla Majueres. Easy to find and best on foot. The water was clean, shallow and beautiful white sand. A pleasure.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: paradise beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Paradise beach in the northern area of Isla Mujeres with white sands and crystal-clear turquoise blue waters. Very extensive, shallow and full of palm trees on its shore. It has all kinds of hammock and restaurant services.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Postcard 🌞🌴🇲🇽
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Apparently the most famous square on Isla Mujeres.Very beautiful white sand beach, turquoise and warm water!!! 🌴🌊Very touristy, but enjoyable to spend an afternoon there.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Super Laid-Back
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Playa Norte was amazing. The beach was gorgeous, the water was crystal clear, and the vibe was super laid-back which we loved. Definitely a must-visit spot in Isla Mujeres!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Crystal clear, turquoise waters. White sand with many palm trees.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Playa Norte is stunning. Palm trees line the coast with perfect white sand and crystal clear, warm turquoise waters. I highly recommend stopping at the beach here if you are in Isla Mujeres because it will be one of the best beaches you have ever been too.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: paradise beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: A beautiful beach like its name in the north of the island. It has areas where there are lounge chairs that some rent and others only if you consume in a place, even with a bathroom and pool. We didn't do it but I think it's quite worth it. The beach has a large area where you can walk in and the water reaches your knees. Transparent waters, white sands really worth going.You cross on the ferry which takes about 30 minutes from Cancun and then you can tour the island

reviewsWithKeywords.title: It's marvelous! Its colors, its temperature, are ideal for rest and renewal of body and soul.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: For me, it is the most spectacular beach because it is quiet, beautiful, warm water and its endless path without waves or holes.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Every shade of blue!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Our first time to Isla and Playa Norte did not disappoint. We arrived on February 16 and were here for a week. The water is a bit cooler than I would have liked, but it felt refreshing after a long day in the sun. This beach provides every shade of blue you can imagine, it’s beautiful. There are several beach clubs along the beach. We used, Guru, Green Demon and Mayan Beach Club. I would use any of them again and they are all priced about the same. We enjoyed food and drinks at all three clubs and everything that we tried ordered was very good. What impressed me the most was how good the service was at each beach club. The waiters were incredibly attentive and friendly. I can’t wait to visit again!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Playa Norte
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Certainly nice enough.  Just a little bit busy for me.  The island is small and Playa Norte is about a 10 minutes away from the port.  So, it does get busy.Certainly worth a look if you fancy a couple of hours sunbathing

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach!!!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We made the transfer from Cancun on a Catamaran, when we arrived at the island, they left us about 300 meters from Playa Norte, so we walked. And we found a wonderful beach especially for children, clean water and no waves. Without a doubt it is a place to visit if you are nearby.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Constant threat of being ripped off and constantly harassed by street vendors. Would not recommend.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful beaches but not a fan of this place. Constantly getting harassed by street vendors constantly. They don’t take no for an answer and they’re all trying to rip you off. Cabs are different prices from day-to-day. You have to be on high alert here or you’ll get ripped off.I’ll never come back here.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Absolutely packed!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Great beach but it gets filled up in no time. The best time would be in the morning before all the tour boats  and the ferries arrive. Water is clear, no sea weeds and just an awesome beach for all ages!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Wonderful
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Magnificent beach, shallow, crystal clear water, white sand. If you move to the northernmost part there are no ferries, the (small) boats are stationed beyond a certain distance but not all day and in any case they do not prevent you from spending wonderful days.Sunbeds and umbrella for a fee; Consumables are included in the amount paid.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Holidays in cancun
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Excellent places, everything nice and pleasant, the beaches, the shopping, restaurants, everything very clean and prepared for enjoyment. Public transportation needs to improve in Cancun

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Wonderful!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This wonderful white sand beach with many palm trees and restaurants and other activities is located in the north of the island

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Not Enough Time
reviewsWithKeywords.text: It was a beautiful day and a fantastic  beach.  The crystal clear water was fascinating to my wife. She usually only goes ankle deep in the water, but went out much farther.  The beach was crowded, but not so much that we could not enjoy.  It was our fault that we only had a short day.  We plan to return and spend much more time.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful but overcrowded and expensive
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The beach is absolutely gorgeous. It was so crowded with people and boats and loud music.Renting beach chairs was expensive.It’s great for those who love touristy spaces but if you are looking for some peace by the sea or snorkeling, then this is not the place for you.I’m glad I walked along the beach to have experienced it though.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Islz Women Experience
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Excellent place.I had been 10 years ago and it was prettier. Now quite crowded with tourists and a little dirty too.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Fabulous!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Amazing beautiful white sand beach with calmer shallow water. Many boats pull up so it does get a bit crowded.  The beach is accommodated by many restaurants offering lounger and umbrella rentals as well as bar and restaurant service, beachside. Great way to have your own excursion! Take a taxi there and rent a chair and umbrella. Or go the local way and bring your towel or blanket, sit in the shade of a palm tree and drink beer from your cooler. Muy bueno!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Vacation
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Great beach, water was crystal clear, bring your own umbrella or pay for one-30$us-per day. Overall great beach! ⛱️⛱️⛱️⛱️☀️

reviewsWithKeywords.title: One of the most beautiful I have visited...
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We visited this part of Isla Mujeres and I was very surprised by how beautiful it is... I did not imagine how easy it was to see fish in this area... the waters are a translucent turquoise color... the place is very beautiful.. .

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Dream beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful beach! We visited during a catamaran tour for my husband’s 50th birthday and it was literally the beach of my dreams. Soft sand and turquoise water.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: I enjoyed a lot with my family
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Everything is spectacular, I really enjoyed the sea, it is super clean, I have a travel agency and I highly recommend visiting Isla Mujeres

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Even the brief stop off was too long!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Can’t put into words how much of a dump this place was. Dirty , smelly, rude restaurant staff and an overcrowded beach with totally inadequate toilets and constant seller hassle. Thankfully only there for a couple of hours. Couldn’t leave quick enough

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Safety pin!!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: One of my favorite beaches, crystal clear water is not deep. You can bring your drink without any problem as long as you don't disturb the public 😉, highly recommended.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: paradise beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: It is one of the best beaches I have ever seen in my life. The water is crystal clear and the shore shallow. After four in the afternoon there were few people and we were able to enjoy ourselves. The view is wonderful and you feel very peaceful. I would have liked to enjoy it for longer but we had to return to the ferry. It is a natural beauty.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Magnificent beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Not far from the pier is this postcard beach. The water is turquoise, the sand is white and fine. It is about a 10/15 minute walk away, it is not the one at the foot of the ferry.Lots of privatization. Difficult to install your towel depending on the crowds I suppose. For my part, there were few of us.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful place, white beach, definitely worth seeing
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful place to see and photograph, definitely worth going. Bathroom with shark to pet, really nice. Thank you

reviewsWithKeywords.title: North Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: A nice beach but crowded and if it is in Costa Mujeres it does not justify the cost of the tour to visit the Island, it was nothing spectacular.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Paradise
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Exquisite. Crystal clear, calm and low waters. There are bars and restaurants on the shore, it is very close to the center so you can walk without a problem.Perfect to spend the afternoon.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Excellent beach and sea
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Only about half an hour from Cancun with dolphins. The return ticket from Cancun to the island is about 25 euros (550 pesos). Very long beach, fine powdery sand, warm water and deep blue. Along the beach there is a beach bar with sunbeds and for those who want, there is also space to sit freely without a sunbed or a drink from a beach bar. You can walk the entire length of the beach in about half an hour. It is worth any visit, but also to spend about a whole day. The routes are very frequent, every hour from early morning until evening.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Mexico 🇲🇽 Playa Norte
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Amazing! Water.. beach… restaurants Need to spend the whole day.Been three times already.Worth the trip. Love Mia Hotel

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Crystal clear sea but too crowded
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Typical Caribbean beach, but if you think (like us) you will find yourself in an uncontaminated paradise, well no.The beach is full of private establishments where it is possible to rent umbrellas and sunbeds, however there is space in front of the sea to freely sunbathe.As mentioned, the water is crystal clear but it is full of boats and you can only swim within the buoys that keep them away from the shore.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beach is lovely but not really worth the hassle !
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The beach is great! It’s a hassle to get into the beach since it’s very overcrowded and no space to park the over rented golf carts ! Secondly, it’s very expensive for a few hours just to sit there and enjoy the sun, the sun and the lovely clear water . We spent $300 usd , for 5- Pacifico’s, 2- lemonades, 1- piña colada, 1-  fruit platter, and 2- coconuts plus 20% tip automatic included . Overall to spend three hours at this beach, cost us $560 ( including golf cart, ⛴️ ( round trip) 4 hrs at the beach. Definitely won’t be repeated this again since I’ve seen better beaches.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Not terrible...
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Too crowded and very noisy. Paradise for mass tourism with “excursion” boats throwing up tourists by the hundreds (including me!). Streets not very clean... in short... disappointing. I'm giving it two stars because the water is beautiful and very clear, but I was there for a few hours, and won't be coming back. Especially in August...

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Best Beach in the Cancun area.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Fantastic Beach. Wade out 30 plus feet into the smoothe blue Caribbean.  Many restaurants on the beach.  Safe and friendly .  Wirth the rip to the island bry ferry.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Sand and Sun
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The sand is perfect, the sun is bright - and the water is an amazing shade of blue. It is really beautiful. Note that this is a popular area - there are a lot of people enjoying the sand, sun and water. Enjoy!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Perfect sand. Great service.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We rented a golf cart. Drove to the end of a public street that stopped at North Beach. A very kind man named Kenji set is up with two lounge chairs and an umbrella for $20 and was our server for the day. He was kind and prompt and attentive. The beach is amazing. The view is unrivaled. The water is crystal clear.  Perfect day.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great anytime
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Playa Norte is great for a sunrise, sunset, or just about anytime.  The sand is soft and white and the water turquoise.  A great place to spend the day.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Do yourself a favor - pass on wasting a day here
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We went to Isla Mujeres to visit Playa Norte because it was widely spoken of with reverence - worth the trip…it was not.  The island takes a ferry ride that costs average $100 for round trip (2 kids and 2 adults) - no matter what you hear, the ride takes no less than 30 minutes and the ferry schedule is not every 30 min because the crossing takes more than 30 min and that doesn’t account for boarding / disembarking (this is from Puerto Juarez).  Once you arrive you are greeted to small streets and the lovely smell of gasoline from all the mopeds and golf carts (good luck parking those of you rent them; cost of $45).  After winding your way past the many many many shops and subpar (all over priced) restaurants, you will find small beaches choked with people and chairs / umbrellas; All for rent for a price.  The swimmable area is limited to accommodate the catamarans and excursion vessels and the water is not that spectacular so as to put up with all this nonsense.  I wish we would have just stayed at our resort and enjoyed the beach / ocean there which was no better than the color, sand or feel of Playa Norte.  Pass and so yourself the immense favor of soaring a wasted vacation day on this over touristy and underwhelming island and beach.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Best beach?
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This is a beautiful spot and everybody knows it. Lots of resorts with chairs to rent. Crowded. The catamarans dock and the visitors can basically get in the water and wade to shore.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Playa Norte is beautiful.  The water was warm, but cool enough to cool you off.  We rented beach chairs and an umbrella for 450 pesos for the day.  Most beach clubs are similar and then require that you buy food and or drinks.  The water was so shallow, and such a beautiful blue color.  It was a little crowded, but we didn't have trouble finding chairs.  And it was fairly quiet.  We enjoyed our day.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful but crowded
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The Beach is really amazing but the parasol rent value was too expensive like 450 pesos. If you like empty beachs such as a paradise this is not the deal for you. It's totally crowded and every 5 minutes a person come to you to offer a massage.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Nicest beach on the island
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The water is nice and clear and calm at the beach.  The only drawback is that unless you are ordering from the restaurants that line the beach, you are limited to a little strip of sand in front of their beach chairs.  They even try to charge for using the washroom.Tried snorkelling.  No sea life.The beach further up at the Centro is aweful.  Large catamaran full of people come in waves and do the buffet at a bunch of beach clubs.  Unfortunately most of the other beaches on the island are not very nice or rough. So if you want a nice relaxing beach, this is the best bet.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Crystal clear waters
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Very nice beach. Crystal clear waters. Very shallow and can walk 100m from shore. Good day to spend on the beach. 450 pesos for 2 beach chair rentals with free bottled water till 5pm. Easy to leave clothing and towels on chair and walk to restaurants for lunch that were not at the beach.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Bring earplugs
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The beach was very packed and very noisy. There was music coming from 4-5 different bars and boats. I honestly couldn’t think it was so loud, let alone relax. After a swim and a short time on the beach we left.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: The beach is beautiful, water warm and clear
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The only confusing thing is knowing where to enter the beach from. There are multiple dead end roads that lead to it, but the map from the golf cart rental wasn't exactly super clear. Suffice it to say, if you just want to go to North Beach from the ferry, you can walk, If you want to see more of the island, rent a golf cart.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: A sea of people on the sand
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The water will always be beautiful there.  The sand will always look and feel like fine powder sugar.  But it was so crowded with loungers, umbrellas and bodies that I didn't even stop to try to find a sport to relax.  The good old days of wide open space on that beach are gone for good.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We loved it here. It is such clear water and perfect sand. There is a lot of people sharing this small space though. It is a paradise!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Does live up to the hype; know which part of the beach to go
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This is a fabulous beach, and extremely busy. I suggest going early (morning), and station your self somewhere in the Northeast area of Playa Norte, across from Mia Reef Isla Mujeres. I found this area to be the nicest part of the water, and with the most fish action. The spot on the Playa Norte beach I liked the best is an area called Caleta Nómada in Google Maps. There is shade along the sand there (in Dec/Jan) to set up your towel/chairs if you don't want to pay a beach club. If you want a beach even more fabulous than this, then take an excursion to Isla Contoy, which takes about 45 minutes to get to by boat. It was worth it. Just watch the weather/wind forecast before booking.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: The best beach area in Insla Mujeres
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Clear water, nice people, the best beach area in Isla Mujeres. You will have fun here, have a drinks, food and fun

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Best playa
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Really one of the best beaches in the world the water was green and clean. The beach is very safe and always full with people. The beach is not deep at all and it’s very safe with no tides. Lot of beaches available on rent and lot of umbrellas available

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Good but don't miss what's better
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This beach is beautiful but also very busy as most tourists stay in the north. The buoys stop you from passing the boat so the water you have access to doesn't go past standing height. This is the best place for sunrises as you will get an unobstructed view of the sunset and have access to the warm water to swim in. If you have the opportunity, I would recommend spending your days at the beaches on west/south part of the island at beach clubs. You get free access, only having to pay for drinks and reserved seating if you choose you want either. These beaches are just as beautiful but much quieter and relaxing. You will also have access to amenities such as pools and water activities.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: It’s like that Instagram vs reality comparison
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Wow over-occupied for sure……Umbrella town like I have never seen… on land a sea of boats blaring music and on land a sea of umbrellas and people.  Hundreds if not thousands come in for the day and leave at night.I think Playa Norte and Isla have been in one too many travel magazines and it’s lost all of its appeal.Too bad as the downtown area is amazing!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Little Corner of Paradise
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Isla has one of the best beaches in the world. It’s a perfect place to go to relax and enjoy. If one wants more action, there are lots of excursions and trips available as well. There are lots of mom & pop restaurants with great food and drink. You’ll find no chain restaurants on Isla. One gets around in a golf cart, where one can visit the Supermercado  for delights. Plenty of bars for an evening cocktail. Heading back this month.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This is a beautiful  beach. The weather is mild and delicious (December) .You can travel to Isla Mujeres from Cancun and you can decide to stay , there are great hotels, or you can return to Cancun the same day.But I can tell you, you have to visit this beach

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Sharks!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Sting rays, Jelly Fish and sharks! The locals have an immunity somehow to the dangers that lurk below.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: What you want a beach to be
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We went to Isla Mujeres as a day trip from Puerto Morales on a Monday thinking it would be less busy. Not so. As a result, Playa Norte was also packed by afternoon. We made it our first stop and just put a towel on the sand. It felt so peaceful with such a great view. Not crowded yet. Playa Norte is beautiful - Caribbean blue ocean waters and soft white sand.  We came back again late afternoon with a plan to rent beach chairs and swim, but no available chairs could be found. It was so hot we opted not to just lay on the sand as we had earlier. Next time, we will come to Isla Mujeres and have a total beach day at Playa Norte.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: As advertised
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This truly is one of the nicest beaches we have every been to. Very tranquil in some areas and not as much in other areas, depends on what you want. People in Cancun get excursions just to come here, we stayed at the island and went everyday of our stay.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach in Isla Mujeres. You can go to the free beach, or a beach club to enjoy with your family or friends.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful beach in Isla Mujeres. You can go to the free beach, or a beach club to enjoy with your family or friends. Buy drinks and food. This is a must be

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Idyllic beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: If you're coming to Isla Mujeres, you can't miss Playa Norte! Beautiful white sandy beaches and proper blue sea - it's really delightful. They also have lots of deckchairs for rent (c.150 pesos per person) which are worth it if you're camping out on the beach for the day.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The water was absolutely stunning, it was so clear and beautiful. There were bars and food near the beach. We went around 4 pm both times so the sun wasn’t overbearing and it wasn’t as crowded, and I’m glad we did

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Playa Norte , a beautiful must see!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Absolutely beautiful beach . The water is a brilliant turquoise and the sand is white . The water was warm and only waist to chest deep . It wasn’t wavy unless a boat went by .  It was not crowded , which was great ! We only stayed a short time , but it was long enough to enjoy the beautiful beach . I recommend going earlier in the day . We left around 1:30 and it was beginning to fill up . Great place yo stop for lunch ( there are two bars /restaurants there ) or just take in the sites

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Very busy but nice beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This beach is beautiful but in my opinion there are better spots on the island, especially when compared to the crowds that gather here.  Lots of beach clubs here to get drinks and food so that is a plus. Very close to some hotels and to Hidalgo street. Its very nice spot to watch the sunset as well.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful but Crowded
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The waters at this beach are some of the clearest and bluest waters you can get in the area. However, the beach is crowded and full of tourists. The sand isn’t clean as there is a lot of trash. It also smells like gasoline with so many boats passing by. I would recommend to check it out but plan 30-45 minutes in the water. You are better off swimming at the beach near your resort.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: 7 day family trip, Made it to the Playa Norte 4 days
reviewsWithKeywords.text: An Amazing beach, has to be experienced. Went there with my two children, had an amazing time at the beach, the water is amazing

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach swarming with tourists
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Playa Norte or ‘North Beach’ is located at the very north of Isla mujeres near Isla Mujeres Town. Featuring beautiful white sand and turquoise waters its very popular both with people staying on the island and tourists coming in on day trips from Cancun. It’s one of the few beaches we have found in mexico that is completely safe for swimming - as the water is barely chest height for over 200m from shore. The water is also calm, receiving some shelter due to its location. Thus, its safe for children as well as adults.Being a beach its free to go swimming here. I’m not sure why others claim they were charged a fee to swim - they have obviously been scammed by their tour companies. You can elect to purchase a beach chair with umbrella at a price dictated by the vendor but you can also just set up your towel on the beach for free. There is plenty of places where you can do this.We really enjoyed visiting here.Keep an eye out in the shallows for the schools of herring and long Tom. Also look for the bombdiving pelicans.The only negative of this place is that it is extremely popular. Day trippers from Cancun come in boats and really crowd the place. At around 1300 I counted about 60 boats.  If you stay on the island it’s less chaotic in the mornings and evenings.Overall would recommend.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Deserves ALL of the HYPE!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Ooooohhh just an unbelievably GORGEOUS beach!  We were blessed with 3 perfect days just sitting and relaxing on this pristine beach.   Clean and well maintained!  Food trucks near by if you didn’t pack a lunch.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Playa Norte a beautiful beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Playa Norte is a gorgeous beach. Its water is crystal clear and its turquoise color is unbelievable. Perfect for families!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Very nice to be able to walk out 200 yards into the water, Crowded
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Very nice to be able to walk out 200 yards into the water, Crowded.No real snorkeling. Lots of food options. If you buy food you can get the chair and shade for free for a bit.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful Blue Water
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The water was absolutely stunning, so blue. The water was the perfect temperature too. The beach was a little busy, but that’s understandable because it’s so gorgeous.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Best beach in the Cancun area!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Clear beautiful waters. Love this beach! Almost all of the seaweed is blocked if you go down by the MIA hotel. Will definitely visit again!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Love Playa Norte
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful!  The picture is an exact impression of Playa Norte. It’s getting busier. I recommend some time other than summer. We went for Thanksgiving once and it was amazing then too.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Crowded
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The whole shore is crowded. All day long boats drop off tourists and they head straight to the beach and then travel back to the boats. It's endless. We went to a private club for the day and that afforded us lounges and refreshment options. The water is clear (mostly) of sargussam and the sand is soft and fine.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Dirty, overpriced, scam, nasty
reviewsWithKeywords.text: DO NOT GO HERE unless you want to be SCAMMED out of $40 for two chairs on the beach!!!!They charge for absolutely everything on this island, it’s insane. You are not allowed to swim in the ocean unless you pay to reserve a spot on the beach. There’s about 300 people in the water. Beach is dirty and overcrowded. Chewed up limes & beer bottles all over the floor.If you’re staying in Cancun hotel zone, it’s better to just save the trip and stay at your hotel. Our day at isla mujeres was a waste of a day.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Perfection!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: So glad we came to this beach. It’s perfect!!! Clear water, soft sand, shops, and restaurants. You won’t be disappointed if you spend a beach day here. It was just what we needed since our resort beach in the riviera maya was unusable due to seaweed.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Gorgeous Beach & Best Massage
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful beach, great massage upstairs at Chambo, and ice cream vendors walking around for the kids.  Overall, it was a great day and one of the best beaches in Mexico…not much algae.:-)

reviewsWithKeywords.title: I wanted to love this beach.. but too noisy and crowded
reviewsWithKeywords.text: It is crowded and very noisy. The water is beautiful but there still is seaweed. I wanted to relax but there is no way. Multiple sources of loud music, constant people selling things, most annoying believe it or not was the popsicle people, ringing the bell alone is not enough to bother me but constantly hitting a piece of metal on metal and multiple carts just put me over the edge. Regarding the crowds, the hotel guests were only a small percentage of the people, there are many people who come over for the day and they come to party. I would rather go to not as nice of a beach with less noise and fewer people.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Sooooo relaxing, beautiful soft sand and warm salt water
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Absolutely beautiful Float in paradise, rent a beach chair and order tacos with guac, mojito. The best Can't wait to get back 🌞👏

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Best Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: we love the north beach.  amazing beach and spectacular ocean.  Visit the Guru Beach Club for amazing food and service.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Horrible service, unfriendly people working there
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This place sucks. The water is clear and beautiful, the people are rude and ready to take advantage of you. It’s just a tacky beach.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: CRYSTAL BLUE WATER!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: My husband and I travelled to Isla Mujeres as part of a sailing cruise and we had so much fun! We had over 2.5 hours to explore the island. We did some shopping, started walking South but then quickly realized it was just way to hot! The day we went was so hot we could feel the heat radiating off of the pavement. So we took our tour guides advice and directions and found ourselves swimming at Playa Norte. Walking up to the beach you just see the crystal blue water of the ocean and it was definitely inviting! We rented two beach chairs and umbrella from "Felipez Water Sports Center" just so we had somewhere to sit and drop our stuff while we swam. A gentleman named Reuben worked there, and he was so kind! He took our drink and food orders and was very quick in bringing it to us. He made sure we were taken care of to say the least! It was nice having a spot to relax as the beach is quite full due to hotels in the area plus tourism. There was barely anyone swimming in the water or at least it didn't seem like it because the swimming area is very big! We had a wonderful time relaxing at Playa Norte, and maybe we will get to check out the Southernmost point the next time we travel to Isla Mujeres :)

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Isla Mujeres is lost and gone forever
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Sadly it must be reported that Isla Mujeres if lost and gone forever.  We have visited the island many times over the years and were looking forward to this visit.  Sadly the experience has been soured.  We have always enjoyed renting a golf cart and the drive around the island and the whole peaceful experience of the island.  Now this is not possible due to the hordes of tourists descending on the island by the boatload every 30 minutes on Ultamar ferries.  The streets were packed with golf carts and many of the roads were so packed that it was impossible to find parking place or an area to turn  the cart around.  Our favorite little beach side bar on Playa Lanchera, which in the past was our go to for a cold beer and snacks has now been turned into a rowdy beach club with payment demanded to enter and large boats packed with people dumping them out every few minutes.  A quaint and peaceful little area ruined forever.North Beach was impossible.  Thousands and thousands or people, impossible to find golf cart parking, all the beach bars packed to overflowing and most of then charging cover charges on top of inflated food and drink prices.  North Beach is now also ruined.Sadly this will be our last visit to an island that we loved.  It has gone the way of Tulum which is also a favorite place ruined by hordes of tourists and greedy locals.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: gorgeous
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Playa Norte is the best beach anywhere! there's so many places to chose to stay and many beach clubs. plan to be back as soon as we can!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Gorgeous and free to swim!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We spent the afternoon here. We ate and drank at Chichi and Charlies and chilled in the water after that. Beach chairs are for rent ONLY! But you can avoid it and just hand it on the beach if you want. We went on a Sunday and the island as a whole was pretty busy compared to when we have been there on a week day.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Crowds of people on the beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We took a stroll across the crowded beach, paid 20 pesos to use a bathroom and then walked back to order drinks at a bar. They were average, small quantities. Not much alcohol based on the taste. We didn’t stay long. The water was very pretty to look at.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Top beach!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful beach. We went twice from the Zoetry hotel which is a 20 min taxi ride for about 8-10$.The first time the water was.crystal clear, the second time we had few seaweeds. I guess it depends how oriented the currents are but it's definitely better than Cancun right now.A hint.. unless you go there to see lots of people, the beach is more quiet and nicer towards the Mia hotel on the east side. Most people get off the public ferry, walk for five.minutes and stop where everybody else sitting. If you want you can rent a sun umbrella or beach bed you'll even have better and less crowded options.Definitely worth it. It's also close to very good dining options.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful beach in isla mujeres. It is a turquoise water and the water is shallow.You don't need snorkeling gears to see the fish, you can see the fish actually while you are standing in yhe water.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: This beach has been ruined.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: After having visited Isla Mujeres twice about 25 years ago, we decided to return since we had such fond memories of the island--especially Playa Norte. What a disappointment! That beach now has between 30-50 chartered boats visiting the beach each day and anchoring right where everyone swims. In addition, the boats blast loud rap and disco music--beyond belief how horrible that is. The passengers get off the boats at the sandbar and mix in with all the beach swimmers. There were even jet skis racing all around us--so dangerous and unpleasant. What have they done to this once beautiful beach?  We never read about this anywhere and were beyond surprised to encounter these changes. Such a disappointment.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Please clean seaweed!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Unsure what is going on with the seaweed, it didn't used to be that much in the past... Overall, still a very beautiful beach. It can get a little rowdy with all the boats and partying people.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Very nice beach and district that needs to be visited when in Isla Mujeres. The beach has nice sand and turquoise waters, and has a variety of different "scenes" at different spots. Parts are good for partyers, spots are more tranquil and good for kids. The snorkeling around the bridge to Mia Reef is nice, lots of fish, with calm waters. The area/town around it has lots to offer.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Playa Norte has my heart.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The sand and water are the most beautiful.  You can walk out so far on the sandbar.  Can get crowded, but the beauty is worth it.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Easy access to water
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Early to mid-morning is best for walking.  As the day goes on this area is very packed.  Seaweed is frequently a problem.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Best Beach in Mexico
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Playa Norte is the best beach in Mexico. It waters are crystalline and the white sand is powder soft. The beach itself is free to enter and is only a 15-20 minute stroll from the ferry terminal. It is right next to the very expensive Mia Reef hotel.The waters here are incredibly shallow and it is perfect for families with small children. There are two bays, and the second bay, to the right of the Mia Reef hotel, is even shallower than the first bay. From the beach you can walk out an easy 20 metres before the water gets hip high, it is incredibly shallow and very beautiful.Come to this place before it gets spoiled. There are boats playing loud music on the other beaches before Playa Norte, and there are some boats just off the 1st bay at Playa Norte but they are far enough out not to ruin your day with their music and behaviour. We had a fabulous time with no interruptions or upsets and we would definitely come back. There are vendors that pop along selling ice cream, ice lollies etc, but they are no trouble at all, and they are not pushy in any way. There is one bar/restaurant directly behind the bays selling beer, cocktails, food etc. There is also the Mia Reef hotel, but i don't know if non guests can simply go there to eat or drink without actually staying there.There is nothing near Cancun that has anything remotely close to the quality of Playa Norte. It is miles ahead of anything else nearby and totally worth the trip from Cancun, or to stay here for a period of time.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: No longer a great beach to visit due to the  anti social behaviour from the boats
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This was our third visit to Playa Norte, unfortunately what was once one of the nicest beaches I had ever experienced has now become just an average beach.Like most places once somewhere becomes popular and well known it usually results in its decline, this is what it feels like has happened to Isla Mujeres. On our visit in 2021 the beach was packed with tourists which is fine but the issues started when entering the sea as the private boats now anchor within a few meters of the beach leaving swimmers having to navigate around both parked as well as moving boats, also each boat competes against each other to play the loudest music which ruins the paradise feel that we experienced on our 2 previous visits.I really hope restrictions are put in place to prevent the anti social behaviour we witnessed from private boats, they should not be allowed within such close proximity to the beach nor should they be allowed to play music so loud.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful, clean beach. Shallow a long way out.  Check out the side of the Mia Reef hotel, and bring a snorkel mask to see what's in there with you. There are many places on the beach for refreshments. Definitely a place to spend some time!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great for the family
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful, quintessential Caribbean beach! White sand, clear water, all the shades of blue. Nice and shallow for the kids, minimal waves. Tends to get crowded in the afternoon when the yacht/party crew rolls up.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful beach with amazing color of the water. Visited it with a boat trip from Cancun and we had many hours to explore Isla Mujeres but we decided to stay in this beach. There is a nice palm tree where you can take photos.  Good for swimming, water was not so shallow and also not so wavy.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful beach to chill on , take a swim in the warm tropical water or kick back at a beachfront bar  !! Whatever tickles your fancy .

reviewsWithKeywords.title: For me it’s the Best beach in Isla Mujeres
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful white sand beach, it has nice places for laying, drinking and eating. it’s a busy beach and in my opinion it’s the best beach in Isla Mujeres. Not quite and isolated if that’s what you want.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Extremely Overcrowded
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This is a beautiful beach but WAY overcrowded. It is where all the boats for day trips come in making it hard to get a nice spot or swim without bumping in to each other.Nice clear water but if you are looking to get away from the crowds, this isn't it.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Fabulous Mexico
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful island great beaches and lovely places to eatGreat day out from riviera maya hotel, we went by catamaran did some snorkelling sunbathing and relaxing 😌

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Nice, beautiful but crowded
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Yes it’s definitely a spot to go. Pure white beach, shallow water with a perfect sea breeze. Loved it. Ok it’s crowded but there is space to escape and to be honest sometimes a little bit of beach life or small party’s on the sportsboats is fun too. I would definitely come back again.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Crowded tourist beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Too many people at same place….. beautiful beach but, with crowded area. I preferred to stay at hotel Isla. Not worth.  Better stay at hotel

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach with plenty of space!!!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: If you are staying on isla mujeres and you don’t like your view at your resort.  No problem just take a golf cart to playa Norte and you’ll be satisfied.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach lots of people
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Considered one of the most beautiful beaches in the world. It does not disappoint.  It is breathtaking. However, be ready for the crowd. We walked around and went swimming, but decided this was not for us. Way too much people.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: shallow clear waters, GREAT beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: quintessential BEACH on the island. Playa Centro where ferries and stuff come in is also cool but this beach is away from all the docks and is just a HUGE long beach. there are mini sections that might be private to hotels/bars along the beach but you can walk the entire thing. Men kind of loiter around with jet ski's and you can haggle for a ride, I got a 30 minute ride for $40 just talking to some guys who had theirs on the shore. There are a ton of beach vendors walking around selling fruit cups, clothing/jewelry, etc. Highly recommend stopping at the tiny bodega across from north gardens restaurant on the walk in to get an authentic michelada (80 pesos) to bring to the beach with you. the water is shallow for a LONG time so you can walk out into the ocean for a long ways and be safe and have a good time.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: BEAUTIFULLY Crowded Beach!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The sand and water on this beach are beautiful. The only downside is the area is busy all day. The boats park out in the water where people go swimming. If you are looking for something less walk towards the backside of the island.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Plenty of chairs, umbrellas, & towels. Staff comes to you at the beach so you can order food & drink.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Wonderful Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Some of the clearest blue water we've ever seen.  White sand beaches that are well maintained (we saw them cleaning the seaweed several mornings we were there.  It can get busy, but never felt crowded.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: A Must Visit!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful beach with white sand and warm water.  Was not very busy when we visited around mid morning.  Rent 2 chairs and an umbrella for $10 US for 2 hours.  Bought a bucket of Coronas. Be aware that if you want to use the public toilets, it cost 10 pesos.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: beuatiful
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful beach we'll taken care of. No garbage which is nice and it was nice seeing so many people enjoying themselves.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach, very busy with yachts, but worth a visit and a cool in the lovely clear water
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful white powder sand beach and crystal clear water. Seems to be also used for mooring dozens of yachts with the passengers, mostly inebriated youngsters, party in the water. SO it is not a quiet place

reviewsWithKeywords.title: PLAYA SUPER CLEAN 👌
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Stayed at Xchel Hotel right on Playa Norte, one of the most beautiful beaches I've seen.  Clean sand, calm, warm water. I would not change anything  about this beach.   Not sure what seaweed people have complained about, I seen none during my stay.  I would recommend staying  overnight if visiting Mexico,  very short ferry ride from Playa Tortugas.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Seaweed problem along with over crowding
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Sad to see so much seaweed being dumped here and washed ashore.  The smell was overwhelming.  This along with the private property beach chairs and such make this a not so pleasant experience.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Best of The island
reviewsWithKeywords.text: A beautiful beach with perfect sand as you see in the commercials. You can literally spend the whole day relaxing on the beach. The waters are so much fun to swim and enjoy.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: picture perfect day and night
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Playa Norte is beautiful and is the best beach on all of Isla Mujeres.  Walkable from the ferry dock, all hotels on that end, and Hildalgo Street (main restaurant/entertainment).  Water is clear and mostly clear of seaweed.  One area, near Mia Reef, still had sargassum from recent hurricane, but workers were clearing it up actively all week.  Lovely calm shallower water.  You have to walk a long way in before you get up to your shoulders.  Sorry nothing to see if snorkeling, but good place to practice.  Many boats are docked and partying within walking distance out in the water.  Many beach clubs and places offering lounge chair and umbrellas.  All the places close up around 5-6 so if you plan to stay longer, I suggest bringing your own like we did.  You can still patron the beach clubs for food and drink though.  No minimums that way.  Local food and merchandise vendors walk the sand as well.  A simple No Gracious deters them.  Fantastic way to spend your vacation.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: The most beautiful beach on earth!!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The visit to the north beach at isla mujeres it's something that you have to do, at least, on time in your life!! Water was so clear and blue, I loved it :)

reviewsWithKeywords.title: LIKE A CORONA BEER COMMERCIAL!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: You know those crazy, clear turquoise beaches that you see in Corona Beer commercials? That's Playa Norte! Add some boats anchored offshore, some palapas on the beach and some beachfront bars and you've got a fair picture of what to expect. So fun!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Crystal Clear Waters <3
reviewsWithKeywords.text: One of, if not the best beaches i've ever been on. The waters were so clear and you could be pretty far out and still be touching. I always went past the buoys where the boats park just to have a section to myself.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: The best beach at Isla Mujeres
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful beach to enjoy with your family. Have cold drinks, nice snacks and food. This a must place to visit

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful, but too many boats too close to shore.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful, but too many boats way too close to the shore. They need to rope off a bigger area for swimmers and keep the boats farther away. It's so shallow so far out, those boats do not need to come in so close! Otherwise beautiful clean clear shallow water with fish as well!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful but busy beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We stayed at Nautibeach condos right on this beautiful beach. The condo complex is in a perfect location with easy access to both the beach and nearby bars and restaurants. The complex grounds and pool are gorgeous and our 2 bedroom condo was clean and comfortable with a large balcony overlooking the pool and beach. The beach gets crowded but the condos always have beach chairs for the guests. There are also showers to rinse off as you leave the beach. A lot of boats, some private and others paid tours, anchor just offshore so people can get off and swim. It can be a bit annoying if those boats play loud music since there is also music coming from the nice restaurant on the beach next to the condos. The water in front of this part of the beach is gently sloping sand so snorkeling isn't really an option but it is perfect for swimming and wading. This is a great option for families with small children or teens.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beach!!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We rented  2 bedroom condos at Nautibeach ( #5 and #6), which is a smaller, intimate development in the middle of this beautiful area. Swimming pool is just off the beach, and there are comfortable lounge chairs and security on site. It is walking distance to shopping and restaurants in town and on the beach. The hosts are responsive to all requests and make your stay easy and comfortable.  The beach can get a bit crowded, but the water is perfect- and walking along the beach less crowded areas can be found.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful white sand beach and turquoise waters.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful white sand beach and turquoise waters! One of the most beautiful and clean beaches I have seen in Mexico.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Excellent
reviewsWithKeywords.text: It´s an excellent beach to visit, the water is so peaceful and the sand so white, my only comment it´s to have more garbache containers to keep it clean, there were some young guys leaving beer cans on the beach because there was nothing close to put the garbage, please keep it cleanIt worth to go and lie on the beach

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Most Beautiful Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I just visited for my third time and the views never get old.  The whitest and softest sand and the clearest blue water.  The water has always been very calm during all of my visits at Playa Norte.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: GORGEOUS BEACH
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I love this beach and come each and every time I visit the Island! While it can get crowded the beach is second to none! Gorgeous clean water with great views of Cancun!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Clear warm water
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Gorgeous white sand beaches, clear warm water, minimal waves. Stays shallow for a long ways so you can wade out and enjoy the water.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful water and sand
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful white sand and clear turquoise water.  Tons of great beach clubs to chose from. Right in Centro.  It’s our favorite beach.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: The Good & Bad
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Playa Norte is great when visiting before 10:00 am.  This is when the water has the best clarity and there are less boats.  Early is also the best time to relax in the water.We were there for over 2 weeks and never saw any police or military patrolling the shores.  I asked the police why this has stopped and was told they don't have the officers to do this anymore.The later in the day you will see boats anchoring either right up to the buoys or over them.  One boat had its anchor 20 ft. inside the buoys.  The sad thing is the vulgar loud music some of the boats play.  A couple of. boats had music blasting with words "fuc_," "shi_," "pric_," and saying to kill policemen.   This is inappropriate for young children.  One crew member told me that Isla Mujeres was now considered to be the party island.  Another issue is the number of jet skis.  There were 12 one day zooming around boats.  I feel that someone is going to injured or killed by a jet ski with the way they are going between boats.  Though you can't rent jet skis on the island, the will drive along the buoys asking if you want to rent one.Playa Norte is still a wonderful spot; however, you need to be aware of what to expect.  It is now basically a small Cancun or Playa del Carmen.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Stunning beach and fun atmosphere
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This is the gem of Isla Mujeres. The water is pristine and calm, and the beach is kept very clean. There are a lot of places to rent chairs and many good restaurants along the entire beach. This is a must when visiting Isla Mujeres.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautifal and Calm beach!!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful beach.  You can see some amazing sunsets there as well.  Only issue is that a lot of boats park just off the coast and it can be a little loud.  The water is warm, calm and fairly shallow.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Clean beutiful beach with crystal clear water!  Plenty of activities or you can just relax on the beach.  Plenty of places to stop to eat or get a drink.  Current is pretty strong  but shallow enough so it isnt an issue.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: BEST BEACH
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We Absoluetely Love Playa Norte.  Best Beach We Have Visted.  No Sargassum, just Crystal Clear.  We Love It...

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful!
