reviews.text: If you're coming to Isla Mujeres, you can't miss Playa Norte! Beautiful white sandy beaches and proper blue sea - it's really delightful. They also have lots of deckchairs for rent (c.150 pesos per person) which are worth it if you're camping out on the beach for the day.

reviews.title: Beautiful
reviews.text: The water was absolutely stunning, it was so clear and beautiful. There were bars and food near the beach. We went around 4 pm both times so the sun wasn’t overbearing and it wasn’t as crowded, and I’m glad we did

reviews.title: Playa Norte , a beautiful must see!
reviews.text: Absolutely beautiful beach . The water is a brilliant turquoise and the sand is white . The water was warm and only waist to chest deep . It wasn’t wavy unless a boat went by .  It was not crowded , which was great ! We only stayed a short time , but it was long enough to enjoy the beautiful beach . I recommend going earlier in the day . We left around 1:30 and it was beginning to fill up . Great place yo stop for lunch ( there are two bars /restaurants there ) or just take in the sites

reviews.title: Very busy but nice beach
reviews.text: This beach is beautiful but in my opinion there are better spots on the island, especially when compared to the crowds that gather here.  Lots of beach clubs here to get drinks and food so that is a plus. Very close to some hotels and to Hidalgo street. Its very nice spot to watch the sunset as well.

reviews.title: Beautiful but Crowded
reviews.text: The waters at this beach are some of the clearest and bluest waters you can get in the area. However, the beach is crowded and full of tourists. The sand isn’t clean as there is a lot of trash. It also smells like gasoline with so many boats passing by. I would recommend to check it out but plan 30-45 minutes in the water. You are better off swimming at the beach near your resort.

reviews.title: 7 day family trip, Made it to the Playa Norte 4 days
reviews.text: An Amazing beach, has to be experienced. Went there with my two children, had an amazing time at the beach, the water is amazing

reviews.title: Beautiful beach swarming with tourists
reviews.text: Playa Norte or ‘North Beach’ is located at the very north of Isla mujeres near Isla Mujeres Town. Featuring beautiful white sand and turquoise waters its very popular both with people staying on the island and tourists coming in on day trips from Cancun. It’s one of the few beaches we have found in mexico that is completely safe for swimming - as the water is barely chest height for over 200m from shore. The water is also calm, receiving some shelter due to its location. Thus, its safe for children as well as adults.Being a beach its free to go swimming here. I’m not sure why others claim they were charged a fee to swim - they have obviously been scammed by their tour companies. You can elect to purchase a beach chair with umbrella at a price dictated by the vendor but you can also just set up your towel on the beach for free. There is plenty of places where you can do this.We really enjoyed visiting here.Keep an eye out in the shallows for the schools of herring and long Tom. Also look for the bombdiving pelicans.The only negative of this place is that it is extremely popular. Day trippers from Cancun come in boats and really crowd the place. At around 1300 I counted about 60 boats.  If you stay on the island it’s less chaotic in the mornings and evenings.Overall would recommend.

reviews.title: Deserves ALL of the HYPE!
reviews.text: Ooooohhh just an unbelievably GORGEOUS beach!  We were blessed with 3 perfect days just sitting and relaxing on this pristine beach.   Clean and well maintained!  Food trucks near by if you didn’t pack a lunch.

reviews.title: Playa Norte a beautiful beach
reviews.text: Playa Norte is a gorgeous beach. Its water is crystal clear and its turquoise color is unbelievable. Perfect for families!

reviews.title: Very nice to be able to walk out 200 yards into the water, Crowded
reviews.text: Very nice to be able to walk out 200 yards into the water, Crowded.No real snorkeling. Lots of food options. If you buy food you can get the chair and shade for free for a bit.

reviews.title: Beautiful Blue Water
reviews.text: The water was absolutely stunning, so blue. The water was the perfect temperature too. The beach was a little busy, but that’s understandable because it’s so gorgeous.

reviews.title: Best beach in the Cancun area!
reviews.text: Clear beautiful waters. Love this beach! Almost all of the seaweed is blocked if you go down by the MIA hotel. Will definitely visit again!

reviews.title: Poor service
reviews.text: Extremely poor service throughout our stay. We did an all inclusive and the service was slow and at times non existent. I would not recommend this place if u want a quality experience.

reviews.title: Love Playa Norte
reviews.text: Beautiful!  The picture is an exact impression of Playa Norte. It’s getting busier. I recommend some time other than summer. We went for Thanksgiving once and it was amazing then too.

reviews.title: Crowded
reviews.text: The whole shore is crowded. All day long boats drop off tourists and they head straight to the beach and then travel back to the boats. It's endless. We went to a private club for the day and that afforded us lounges and refreshment options. The water is clear (mostly) of sargussam and the sand is soft and fine.

reviews.title: Dirty, overpriced, scam, nasty
reviews.text: DO NOT GO HERE unless you want to be SCAMMED out of $40 for two chairs on the beach!!!!They charge for absolutely everything on this island, it’s insane. You are not allowed to swim in the ocean unless you pay to reserve a spot on the beach. There’s about 300 people in the water. Beach is dirty and overcrowded. Chewed up limes & beer bottles all over the floor.If you’re staying in Cancun hotel zone, it’s better to just save the trip and stay at your hotel. Our day at isla mujeres was a waste of a day.

reviews.title: Perfection!
reviews.text: So glad we came to this beach. It’s perfect!!! Clear water, soft sand, shops, and restaurants. You won’t be disappointed if you spend a beach day here. It was just what we needed since our resort beach in the riviera maya was unusable due to seaweed.

reviews.title: Gorgeous Beach & Best Massage
reviews.text: Beautiful beach, great massage upstairs at Chambo, and ice cream vendors walking around for the kids.  Overall, it was a great day and one of the best beaches in Mexico…not much algae.:-)

reviews.title: I wanted to love this beach.. but too noisy and crowded
reviews.text: It is crowded and very noisy. The water is beautiful but there still is seaweed. I wanted to relax but there is no way. Multiple sources of loud music, constant people selling things, most annoying believe it or not was the popsicle people, ringing the bell alone is not enough to bother me but constantly hitting a piece of metal on metal and multiple carts just put me over the edge. Regarding the crowds, the hotel guests were only a small percentage of the people, there are many people who come over for the day and they come to party. I would rather go to not as nice of a beach with less noise and fewer people.

reviews.title: Sooooo relaxing, beautiful soft sand and warm salt water
reviews.text: Absolutely beautiful Float in paradise, rent a beach chair and order tacos with guac, mojito. The best Can't wait to get back 🌞👏

reviews.title: Best Beach
reviews.text: we love the north beach.  amazing beach and spectacular ocean.  Visit the Guru Beach Club for amazing food and service.

reviews.title: Horrible service, unfriendly people working there
reviews.text: This place sucks. The water is clear and beautiful, the people are rude and ready to take advantage of you. It’s just a tacky beach.

reviews.title: CRYSTAL BLUE WATER!
reviews.text: My husband and I travelled to Isla Mujeres as part of a sailing cruise and we had so much fun! We had over 2.5 hours to explore the island. We did some shopping, started walking South but then quickly realized it was just way to hot! The day we went was so hot we could feel the heat radiating off of the pavement. So we took our tour guides advice and directions and found ourselves swimming at Playa Norte. Walking up to the beach you just see the crystal blue water of the ocean and it was definitely inviting! We rented two beach chairs and umbrella from "Felipez Water Sports Center" just so we had somewhere to sit and drop our stuff while we swam. A gentleman named Reuben worked there, and he was so kind! He took our drink and food orders and was very quick in bringing it to us. He made sure we were taken care of to say the least! It was nice having a spot to relax as the beach is quite full due to hotels in the area plus tourism. There was barely anyone swimming in the water or at least it didn't seem like it because the swimming area is very big! We had a wonderful time relaxing at Playa Norte, and maybe we will get to check out the Southernmost point the next time we travel to Isla Mujeres :)

reviews.title: Isla Mujeres is lost and gone forever
reviews.text: Sadly it must be reported that Isla Mujeres if lost and gone forever.  We have visited the island many times over the years and were looking forward to this visit.  Sadly the experience has been soured.  We have always enjoyed renting a golf cart and the drive around the island and the whole peaceful experience of the island.  Now this is not possible due to the hordes of tourists descending on the island by the boatload every 30 minutes on Ultamar ferries.  The streets were packed with golf carts and many of the roads were so packed that it was impossible to find parking place or an area to turn  the cart around.  Our favorite little beach side bar on Playa Lanchera, which in the past was our go to for a cold beer and snacks has now been turned into a rowdy beach club with payment demanded to enter and large boats packed with people dumping them out every few minutes.  A quaint and peaceful little area ruined forever.North Beach was impossible.  Thousands and thousands or people, impossible to find golf cart parking, all the beach bars packed to overflowing and most of then charging cover charges on top of inflated food and drink prices.  North Beach is now also ruined.Sadly this will be our last visit to an island that we loved.  It has gone the way of Tulum which is also a favorite place ruined by hordes of tourists and greedy locals.

reviews.title: gorgeous
reviews.text: Playa Norte is the best beach anywhere! there's so many places to chose to stay and many beach clubs. plan to be back as soon as we can!

reviews.title: Gorgeous and free to swim!
reviews.text: We spent the afternoon here. We ate and drank at Chichi and Charlies and chilled in the water after that. Beach chairs are for rent ONLY! But you can avoid it and just hand it on the beach if you want. We went on a Sunday and the island as a whole was pretty busy compared to when we have been there on a week day.

reviews.title: Crowds of people on the beach
reviews.text: We took a stroll across the crowded beach, paid 20 pesos to use a bathroom and then walked back to order drinks at a bar. They were average, small quantities. Not much alcohol based on the taste. We didn’t stay long. The water was very pretty to look at.

reviews.title: Top beach!
reviews.text: Beautiful beach. We went twice from the Zoetry hotel which is a 20 min taxi ride for about 8-10$.The first time the water was.crystal clear, the second time we had few seaweeds. I guess it depends how oriented the currents are but it's definitely better than Cancun right now.A hint.. unless you go there to see lots of people, the beach is more quiet and nicer towards the Mia hotel on the east side. Most people get off the public ferry, walk for five.minutes and stop where everybody else sitting. If you want you can rent a sun umbrella or beach bed you'll even have better and less crowded options.Definitely worth it. It's also close to very good dining options.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach!
reviews.text: Beautiful beach in isla mujeres. It is a turquoise water and the water is shallow.You don't need snorkeling gears to see the fish, you can see the fish actually while you are standing in yhe water.

reviews.title: This beach has been ruined.
reviews.text: After having visited Isla Mujeres twice about 25 years ago, we decided to return since we had such fond memories of the island--especially Playa Norte. What a disappointment! That beach now has between 30-50 chartered boats visiting the beach each day and anchoring right where everyone swims. In addition, the boats blast loud rap and disco music--beyond belief how horrible that is. The passengers get off the boats at the sandbar and mix in with all the beach swimmers. There were even jet skis racing all around us--so dangerous and unpleasant. What have they done to this once beautiful beach?  We never read about this anywhere and were beyond surprised to encounter these changes. Such a disappointment.

reviews.title: Please clean seaweed!
reviews.text: Unsure what is going on with the seaweed, it didn't used to be that much in the past... Overall, still a very beautiful beach. It can get a little rowdy with all the boats and partying people.

reviews.title: Great Beach
reviews.text: Very nice beach and district that needs to be visited when in Isla Mujeres. The beach has nice sand and turquoise waters, and has a variety of different "scenes" at different spots. Parts are good for partyers, spots are more tranquil and good for kids. The snorkeling around the bridge to Mia Reef is nice, lots of fish, with calm waters. The area/town around it has lots to offer.

reviews.title: Playa Norte has my heart.
reviews.text: The sand and water are the most beautiful.  You can walk out so far on the sandbar.  Can get crowded, but the beauty is worth it.

reviews.title: Easy access to water
reviews.text: Early to mid-morning is best for walking.  As the day goes on this area is very packed.  Seaweed is frequently a problem.

reviews.title: Best Beach in Mexico
reviews.text: Playa Norte is the best beach in Mexico. It waters are crystalline and the white sand is powder soft. The beach itself is free to enter and is only a 15-20 minute stroll from the ferry terminal. It is right next to the very expensive Mia Reef hotel.The waters here are incredibly shallow and it is perfect for families with small children. There are two bays, and the second bay, to the right of the Mia Reef hotel, is even shallower than the first bay. From the beach you can walk out an easy 20 metres before the water gets hip high, it is incredibly shallow and very beautiful.Come to this place before it gets spoiled. There are boats playing loud music on the other beaches before Playa Norte, and there are some boats just off the 1st bay at Playa Norte but they are far enough out not to ruin your day with their music and behaviour. We had a fabulous time with no interruptions or upsets and we would definitely come back. There are vendors that pop along selling ice cream, ice lollies etc, but they are no trouble at all, and they are not pushy in any way. There is one bar/restaurant directly behind the bays selling beer, cocktails, food etc. There is also the Mia Reef hotel, but i don't know if non guests can simply go there to eat or drink without actually staying there.There is nothing near Cancun that has anything remotely close to the quality of Playa Norte. It is miles ahead of anything else nearby and totally worth the trip from Cancun, or to stay here for a period of time.

reviews.title: No longer a great beach to visit due to the  anti social behaviour from the boats
reviews.text: This was our third visit to Playa Norte, unfortunately what was once one of the nicest beaches I had ever experienced has now become just an average beach.Like most places once somewhere becomes popular and well known it usually results in its decline, this is what it feels like has happened to Isla Mujeres. On our visit in 2021 the beach was packed with tourists which is fine but the issues started when entering the sea as the private boats now anchor within a few meters of the beach leaving swimmers having to navigate around both parked as well as moving boats, also each boat competes against each other to play the loudest music which ruins the paradise feel that we experienced on our 2 previous visits.I really hope restrictions are put in place to prevent the anti social behaviour we witnessed from private boats, they should not be allowed within such close proximity to the beach nor should they be allowed to play music so loud.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach
reviews.text: Beautiful, clean beach. Shallow a long way out.  Check out the side of the Mia Reef hotel, and bring a snorkel mask to see what's in there with you. There are many places on the beach for refreshments. Definitely a place to spend some time!

reviews.title: Great for the family
reviews.text: Beautiful, quintessential Caribbean beach! White sand, clear water, all the shades of blue. Nice and shallow for the kids, minimal waves. Tends to get crowded in the afternoon when the yacht/party crew rolls up.

reviews.title: Great beach
reviews.text: Beautiful beach with amazing color of the water. Visited it with a boat trip from Cancun and we had many hours to explore Isla Mujeres but we decided to stay in this beach. There is a nice palm tree where you can take photos.  Good for swimming, water was not so shallow and also not so wavy.

reviews.title: Beautiful Beach
reviews.text: Beautiful beach to chill on , take a swim in the warm tropical water or kick back at a beachfront bar  !! Whatever tickles your fancy .

reviews.title: For me it’s the Best beach in Isla Mujeres
reviews.text: Beautiful white sand beach, it has nice places for laying, drinking and eating. it’s a busy beach and in my opinion it’s the best beach in Isla Mujeres. Not quite and isolated if that’s what you want.

reviews.title: Extremely Overcrowded
reviews.text: This is a beautiful beach but WAY overcrowded. It is where all the boats for day trips come in making it hard to get a nice spot or swim without bumping in to each other.Nice clear water but if you are looking to get away from the crowds, this isn't it.

reviews.title: Fabulous Mexico
reviews.text: Beautiful island great beaches and lovely places to eatGreat day out from riviera maya hotel, we went by catamaran did some snorkelling sunbathing and relaxing 😌

reviews.title: Nice, beautiful but crowded
reviews.text: Yes it’s definitely a spot to go. Pure white beach, shallow water with a perfect sea breeze. Loved it. Ok it’s crowded but there is space to escape and to be honest sometimes a little bit of beach life or small party’s on the sportsboats is fun too. I would definitely come back again.

reviews.title: Crowded tourist beach
reviews.text: Too many people at same place….. beautiful beach but, with crowded area. I preferred to stay at hotel Isla. Not worth.  Better stay at hotel

reviews.title: Beautiful beach with plenty of space!!!
reviews.text: If you are staying on isla mujeres and you don’t like your view at your resort.  No problem just take a golf cart to playa Norte and you’ll be satisfied.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach lots of people
reviews.text: Considered one of the most beautiful beaches in the world. It does not disappoint.  It is breathtaking. However, be ready for the crowd. We walked around and went swimming, but decided this was not for us. Way too much people.

reviews.title: shallow clear waters, GREAT beach
reviews.text: quintessential BEACH on the island. Playa Centro where ferries and stuff come in is also cool but this beach is away from all the docks and is just a HUGE long beach. there are mini sections that might be private to hotels/bars along the beach but you can walk the entire thing. Men kind of loiter around with jet ski's and you can haggle for a ride, I got a 30 minute ride for $40 just talking to some guys who had theirs on the shore. There are a ton of beach vendors walking around selling fruit cups, clothing/jewelry, etc. Highly recommend stopping at the tiny bodega across from north gardens restaurant on the walk in to get an authentic michelada (80 pesos) to bring to the beach with you. the water is shallow for a LONG time so you can walk out into the ocean for a long ways and be safe and have a good time.

reviews.title: Playa Norte- fun resorts
reviews.text: We stayed at Mia Reef but walked the North Beach. Stopped at a few places to swim and have drinks. Very worth to walk this beach and see all there is to see!

reviews.title: Seems Like the Perfect Place to Hangout
reviews.text: I loved this beach...with its sights, sounds, people-watching, drink options, location, etc. What fun!

reviews.title: BEAUTIFULLY Crowded Beach!
reviews.text: The sand and water on this beach are beautiful. The only downside is the area is busy all day. The boats park out in the water where people go swimming. If you are looking for something less walk towards the backside of the island.

reviews.title: Beach
reviews.text: Plenty of chairs, umbrellas, & towels. Staff comes to you at the beach so you can order food & drink.

reviews.title: Wonderful Beach
reviews.text: Some of the clearest blue water we've ever seen.  White sand beaches that are well maintained (we saw them cleaning the seaweed several mornings we were there.  It can get busy, but never felt crowded.

reviews.title: A Must Visit!
reviews.text: Beautiful beach with white sand and warm water.  Was not very busy when we visited around mid morning.  Rent 2 chairs and an umbrella for $10 US for 2 hours.  Bought a bucket of Coronas. Be aware that if you want to use the public toilets, it cost 10 pesos.

reviews.title: beuatiful
reviews.text: Beautiful beach we'll taken care of. No garbage which is nice and it was nice seeing so many people enjoying themselves.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach, very busy with yachts, but worth a visit and a cool in the lovely clear water
reviews.text: Beautiful white powder sand beach and crystal clear water. Seems to be also used for mooring dozens of yachts with the passengers, mostly inebriated youngsters, party in the water. SO it is not a quiet place

reviews.title: PLAYA SUPER CLEAN 👌
reviews.text: Stayed at Xchel Hotel right on Playa Norte, one of the most beautiful beaches I've seen.  Clean sand, calm, warm water. I would not change anything  about this beach.   Not sure what seaweed people have complained about, I seen none during my stay.  I would recommend staying  overnight if visiting Mexico,  very short ferry ride from Playa Tortugas.

reviews.title: Seaweed problem along with over crowding
reviews.text: Sad to see so much seaweed being dumped here and washed ashore.  The smell was overwhelming.  This along with the private property beach chairs and such make this a not so pleasant experience.

reviews.title: Best of The island
reviews.text: A beautiful beach with perfect sand as you see in the commercials. You can literally spend the whole day relaxing on the beach. The waters are so much fun to swim and enjoy.

reviews.title: picture perfect day and night
reviews.text: Playa Norte is beautiful and is the best beach on all of Isla Mujeres.  Walkable from the ferry dock, all hotels on that end, and Hildalgo Street (main restaurant/entertainment).  Water is clear and mostly clear of seaweed.  One area, near Mia Reef, still had sargassum from recent hurricane, but workers were clearing it up actively all week.  Lovely calm shallower water.  You have to walk a long way in before you get up to your shoulders.  Sorry nothing to see if snorkeling, but good place to practice.  Many boats are docked and partying within walking distance out in the water.  Many beach clubs and places offering lounge chair and umbrellas.  All the places close up around 5-6 so if you plan to stay longer, I suggest bringing your own like we did.  You can still patron the beach clubs for food and drink though.  No minimums that way.  Local food and merchandise vendors walk the sand as well.  A simple No Gracious deters them.  Fantastic way to spend your vacation.

reviews.title: The most beautiful beach on earth!!
reviews.text: The visit to the north beach at isla mujeres it's something that you have to do, at least, on time in your life!! Water was so clear and blue, I loved it :)

reviews.title: LIKE A CORONA BEER COMMERCIAL!
reviews.text: You know those crazy, clear turquoise beaches that you see in Corona Beer commercials? That's Playa Norte! Add some boats anchored offshore, some palapas on the beach and some beachfront bars and you've got a fair picture of what to expect. So fun!

reviews.title: Crystal Clear Waters <3
reviews.text: One of, if not the best beaches i've ever been on. The waters were so clear and you could be pretty far out and still be touching. I always went past the buoys where the boats park just to have a section to myself.

reviews.title: The best beach at Isla Mujeres
reviews.text: Beautiful beach to enjoy with your family. Have cold drinks, nice snacks and food. This a must place to visit

reviews.title: Beautiful, but too many boats too close to shore.
reviews.text: Beautiful, but too many boats way too close to the shore. They need to rope off a bigger area for swimmers and keep the boats farther away. It's so shallow so far out, those boats do not need to come in so close! Otherwise beautiful clean clear shallow water with fish as well!

reviews.title: Beautiful but busy beach
reviews.text: We stayed at Nautibeach condos right on this beautiful beach. The condo complex is in a perfect location with easy access to both the beach and nearby bars and restaurants. The complex grounds and pool are gorgeous and our 2 bedroom condo was clean and comfortable with a large balcony overlooking the pool and beach. The beach gets crowded but the condos always have beach chairs for the guests. There are also showers to rinse off as you leave the beach. A lot of boats, some private and others paid tours, anchor just offshore so people can get off and swim. It can be a bit annoying if those boats play loud music since there is also music coming from the nice restaurant on the beach next to the condos. The water in front of this part of the beach is gently sloping sand so snorkeling isn't really an option but it is perfect for swimming and wading. This is a great option for families with small children or teens.

reviews.title: Beach!!
reviews.text: We rented  2 bedroom condos at Nautibeach ( #5 and #6), which is a smaller, intimate development in the middle of this beautiful area. Swimming pool is just off the beach, and there are comfortable lounge chairs and security on site. It is walking distance to shopping and restaurants in town and on the beach. The hosts are responsive to all requests and make your stay easy and comfortable.  The beach can get a bit crowded, but the water is perfect- and walking along the beach less crowded areas can be found.

reviews.title: Must Do.
reviews.text: We had a blast at Playa Norte and do yourself a favor and explore all of it it is a huge beach area that wraps around the end of the island. Great food and drinks but get there early to get a ocean front lounger and umbrella. We made sure each time we got right on the water and it was glorious.

reviews.title: Beautiful white sand beach and turquoise waters.
reviews.text: Beautiful white sand beach and turquoise waters! One of the most beautiful and clean beaches I have seen in Mexico.

reviews.title: Excellent
reviews.text: It´s an excellent beach to visit, the water is so peaceful and the sand so white, my only comment it´s to have more garbache containers to keep it clean, there were some young guys leaving beer cans on the beach because there was nothing close to put the garbage, please keep it cleanIt worth to go and lie on the beach

reviews.title: Most Beautiful Beach
reviews.text: I just visited for my third time and the views never get old.  The whitest and softest sand and the clearest blue water.  The water has always been very calm during all of my visits at Playa Norte.

reviews.title: GORGEOUS BEACH
reviews.text: I love this beach and come each and every time I visit the Island! While it can get crowded the beach is second to none! Gorgeous clean water with great views of Cancun!

reviews.title: Clear warm water
reviews.text: Gorgeous white sand beaches, clear warm water, minimal waves. Stays shallow for a long ways so you can wade out and enjoy the water.

reviews.title: Beautiful water and sand
reviews.text: Beautiful white sand and clear turquoise water.  Tons of great beach clubs to chose from. Right in Centro.  It’s our favorite beach.

reviews.title: The Good & Bad
reviews.text: Playa Norte is great when visiting before 10:00 am.  This is when the water has the best clarity and there are less boats.  Early is also the best time to relax in the water.We were there for over 2 weeks and never saw any police or military patrolling the shores.  I asked the police why this has stopped and was told they don't have the officers to do this anymore.The later in the day you will see boats anchoring either right up to the buoys or over them.  One boat had its anchor 20 ft. inside the buoys.  The sad thing is the vulgar loud music some of the boats play.  A couple of. boats had music blasting with words "fuc_," "shi_," "pric_," and saying to kill policemen.   This is inappropriate for young children.  One crew member told me that Isla Mujeres was now considered to be the party island.  Another issue is the number of jet skis.  There were 12 one day zooming around boats.  I feel that someone is going to injured or killed by a jet ski with the way they are going between boats.  Though you can't rent jet skis on the island, the will drive along the buoys asking if you want to rent one.Playa Norte is still a wonderful spot; however, you need to be aware of what to expect.  It is now basically a small Cancun or Playa del Carmen.

reviews.title: Stunning beach and fun atmosphere
reviews.text: This is the gem of Isla Mujeres. The water is pristine and calm, and the beach is kept very clean. There are a lot of places to rent chairs and many good restaurants along the entire beach. This is a must when visiting Isla Mujeres.

reviews.title: Beautifal and Calm beach!!
reviews.text: Beautiful beach.  You can see some amazing sunsets there as well.  Only issue is that a lot of boats park just off the coast and it can be a little loud.  The water is warm, calm and fairly shallow.

reviews.title: Great Beach
reviews.text: Clean beutiful beach with crystal clear water!  Plenty of activities or you can just relax on the beach.  Plenty of places to stop to eat or get a drink.  Current is pretty strong  but shallow enough so it isnt an issue.

reviews.title: BEST BEACH
reviews.text: We Absoluetely Love Playa Norte.  Best Beach We Have Visted.  No Sargassum, just Crystal Clear.  We Love It...

reviews.title: Beautiful!
reviews.text: No rocks, just sand and really good restaurant nearby. It was crowded even with the big beach but can still swim freely.

reviews.title: Come early to avoid the crowds
reviews.text: The beaches are still beautiful and clean, but the north part of the island is way overpopulated. We even went to stay during the week and still find lot of tourists.Lot of business in the beaches selling food, restaurants, chairs, umbrellas from the hotels. Then you have the boats coming from Cancun with lot of "party" people, putting loud music and park just right there next to the beach. Can't imagine all the trash that this beautiful beach is getting underground.If you like to enjoy some privacy in the beach, then this island is not for you.

reviews.title: Beaches
reviews.text: The Norte area is great for swimming in the ocean. There are umbrellas chairs and foodShowers. The sun was hot drink lots of water.

reviews.title: Chill/beautiful beach
reviews.text: Really beautiful and nice beach but small space to swim. The chairs and sunbrellas are only 200 pesos per person so it pays off to rent some. Also bring beer/drinks with you with a freezer from Oxxo :)

reviews.title: Gorgeous As Always
reviews.text: The best sand. Most clear and calm water. Heaven. Great beach clubs, food & drink choices, and massages.

reviews.title: Fabulous!
reviews.text: Best part of ANY island! Playa Norte is the best! On the North side gets a little warm as the breeze is minimal. Around the corner on the West side you get a fabulous breeze as you watch the sunset.

reviews.title: Amazing beach
reviews.text: One of the best beaches we have been to in all our years of traveling.  Super soft sand and calm water with the best colors.  It’s a must see if you go to isla.

reviews.title: Beautiful
reviews.text: Playa Norte is a great place to relax, have some beer and then a relaxing massage. I’m happy happy happy with Isla Mujeres

reviews.title: Awesome beach with some cool restaurants on it. The water is super warm!
reviews.text: Beach is beautiful with calm waters. Many restaurants on the beach, water is very warm and a beautiful color

reviews.title: The best beach around
reviews.text: It is an amazing beach near town and you can venture out100 yds and still be up to your waiste in the water.

reviews.title: Nice beach but crowded with party boats
reviews.text: The beach is really nice... but unfortunately during the day some boats are coming from Cancun and they party all day long from the boats. All the jetski and the loud music break the charm of that beach. Worst of it... they don't leave a cent of money on the island... real shame...

reviews.title: Spring Break 2021
reviews.text: Love this place. Family friendly but Adult fun. Beautiful spot, lots of food and drink options. Close to town but fairly secluded.

reviews.title: Beautiful scenery
reviews.text: The beach is always wonderful here, in April the water is fairly cool unlike when visiting in the months of July or August. I highly recommend bringing along a dry bag large enough for your belongings so you can just walk from the beach into the water without worrying about leaving your belongings behind.

reviews.title: One of the most beautiful beaches in the world, but TOO MANY BOATS
reviews.text: I have been to Playa Norte probably 20 times or more in my life since the mid 90’s. It is an absolutely beautiful beach with shallow, turquoise waters, flour-like white sand and little to no seaweed. It has always been more crowded over the past couple of years but this year was substantially worse. By far, the worst part is that there are now a large number of boats and yachts that come to the beach and drop anchor just past the swimming barrier. This is the first time that I have seen this, maybe a newer thing since Covid? Not sure. A lot of them blast music so people on the beach and swimmers are forced to listen to several different boat’s music all at once, not fun. Also, the boats really ruin the view for the beach goers. Still a beautiful beach, but something needs to be done about this issue, especially the noise. I counted around 20 boats on weekdays and close to 50 on Friday and Saturday.

reviews.title: Day visit
reviews.text: It’s crowded but a beautiful stretch of beach. We stayed on the other side of the island but enjoyed day trips to old town and Playa Norte!

reviews.title: Not the nicest beach
reviews.text: If you like really loud music, sitting 2 feet from the person next to you, during COVID, not good, how is this allowed???  and not very clear water, you will like this place.We went on Sunday to try it. The Ferry ride over was great and fun. Then we walked to the beach. We were so disappointed because we read such good reviews. The water is not crystal clear and very cloudy and the beach clubs has obnoxious people playing very loud music, so if you want to sit on a beach and relax, it's impossible.  One guy had a boombox playing very loud rock and roll. Do you really want to sit next to this guy. Do you think the patrons of the beach club would tell him to turn down the volume. No. So this place is for people who like all of above. We went around the corner and the water was lovely, the beach wasn't that crowded and it was way better than Playa Norte. They need to change a few things there.

reviews.title: Calm, gorgeous water
reviews.text: Playa Norte is perfect for swimming or lounging in the sun on the sand. The beach is so clean... no seaweed, and super calm, cool turquoise water.

reviews.title: Awesome
reviews.text: The beach is beautiful and the people are all in festive vibe to have wonderful time. Some of the best sunsets will be seen from playa Norte. Enjoy the views

reviews.title: Beautiful beach soft sand
reviews.text: The beach is beautiful, soft sand, clear water, only thing I didn't like is all boats who dock close by, otherwise it's a paradise

reviews.title: Beautiful beach and water -- looks just like the pictures
reviews.text: The sand is powder soft and bright white. The water is SO turquoise blue, and quite  shallow. We would lay out in the sun, then dip in for a refreshing swim. There are plenty of bars and restaurants all up & down the beach. Sometimes, you might get a waiter or a local person who approaches you to see if you'll come eat at the restaurant or buy some trinkets from them. But they are not pushy at all, and you just have to say "No, thank you". It didn't bother me at all.You will notice there are many boats anchored just a little offshore in the middle of the day, bringing people over from Cancun for the afternoon. There is plenty of room for everybody though - we always found a good spot to be away from crowds.- It was a great way to spend our first three days on Isla Mujeres -

reviews.title: Best beach on ISLA!
reviews.text: Hands-down the best beach on isla! We stayed at privileges alux and we’re hanging out at their beach club but could walk around the point anytime we wanted absolutely stunning view amazing water great vendors all along the beach

reviews.title: Hidden Paradise in Mexico
reviews.text: This was my favorite part of the whole vacation! It is stunningly beautiful! TIP: Go to the far north east side to find the little lagoon. The lagoon is full of little fish and the water is so clear/blue that you can see them swimming around. The sand is so soft. It feels like you are dreaming. If you are going to Isla you cannot pass this up!

reviews.title: Love it!  Great beginner snorkel place.
reviews.text: Snorkeled here for a few hours while our taxi waited for us.  Thankfully we brought our own gear as I didn't see any rental places.  Water was crystal clear but the waves were crashing hard on the reef so view wasn't great.  We did see a lot of fish, but nothing too amazing.Current through from the bay to the sea was fast and dangerous but there was a lifeguard standing there keeping a close eye on that spot.

reviews.title: INCREDIBLE BEACH - the party scene
reviews.text: The beach is gigantic with some great bars for some outstanding people watching. It is rated one of the top 10 beaches in the world and it is.

reviews.title: This place is beautful day or night!
reviews.text: I have been to Isla Mujeres many times over the years for day trips, this was my first time staying on the island.  My husband and I had a magical walk on the beach one evening, the moon was bright and it was simply stunning.  I hope to be back soon.

reviews.title: Amazing beach area just a bit crowded!
reviews.text: Here comes all the people from Cancun, and also everyone will visit from the island stayers. definitely worth it! Just saying that there are several boats parking in front of the beach!

reviews.title: Spectacular beach
reviews.text: Beautiful white sands, tranquil, crystal blue water! Definitely worth the excursion from downtown Isla Mujeres.

reviews.title: Best Beach on the island
reviews.text: I did not stay at or near the beach but we travel here by gulf cart to enjoy the beautiful blue water and excellent beach from our hotel which was near the south of the island.

reviews.title: Beautiful but crowded beach
reviews.text: Water is amazing and beach is beautiful.  It was quite busy the day we went but we still enjoyed it.  Stopped at the bar with swings right at the entrance to have a margarita before continuing our day.

reviews.title: Perfect Beach!
reviews.text: White sugar sand. Blue kool-aid looking water. Perfect slope and sand in the water. Clarity and cleanliness of water is off the charts. Yachts and ferries sailing by. And a perfect island vibe! Can’t wait to go back!

reviews.title: AMAZING FOOD
reviews.text: We love this place & always stop in while in Isla Mujeres. They’re expanding to accommodate even more people. Worth the wait!

reviews.title: Playa Norte....A Beautiful & Calm Beach
reviews.text: Playa Norte is the perfect beach for kids.  The waters are such a beautiful shade of turquoise, clear, and extremely calm.  Parents will definitely not have to worry about waves crashing into their very young children.  Also, if you child is old enough this is the perfect spot for beginning snorkeling.  If you are staying at Mia Reef there are paddle boards and kayaks to use free of charge.  Playa Norte is also wonderful for just relaxing and enjoying the simple life.  Please note that there are many day trips to Playa Norte from Cancun so the beach has the potential to become crowded but that was not a problem for us during our visit.

reviews.title: Beaches are beautiful
reviews.text: Hidalgo street is a tourist trap and try to avoid after first pass. Several good restaurants and a couple of great street vendors. Not much to see or do.

reviews.title: Gorgeous
reviews.text: Perfect sand and water though a bit chilly.  Go in the morning and there is plenty of room and empty chairs before the crowds arrive after noon.

reviews.title: local telling tourist they cant use the beach
reviews.text: some guy at playa norte just before you turn the island on north beach is chasing tourist away saying they can not be on his beach.  The beaches are federal and toursit are allowed 20 meters from the shore to inland. but he still insists its his beach and if your on it and dont go away he will threaten you

reviews.title: Nice beach but......
reviews.text: Many other reviews have said that the beach has narrowed over the years. We didn’t find it too narrow and had plenty of sand to walk over to get to the sun beds provided by our hotel (the Ixchel - highly recommended) but it was surprisingly busy, given travel restrictions these days. There were plenty of bars, restaurants and services (watercraft, massages etc) around but, most noticeably, a lot of boats (presumably on day trips from Cancún) are anchored just off the beach all day, some playing music very loudly. Very nice water for swimming.

reviews.title: Best beach ever
reviews.text: This is my favorite spot for a dip. Go to the Green Demon Beach club for dancing and spicy mango margaritas

reviews.title: One of the nicest in the whole Maya Riviera.
reviews.text: Beautiful beach, lots of visitors, soft white sand. Even during a pandemic, you almost forget about it when visiting this slice of Paradise. Don't miss this beach if you come to Isla Mujeres. One of the nicest in the whole Maya Riviera.

reviews.title: Gorgeous!!
reviews.text: Gorgeous public beach, did not have a lot of seaweed while we were there. The pic is a view of it from our resort.  Lots of fun bars and restaurants along the beach.

reviews.title: Nice beach
reviews.text: Very clean beach, just about 10 min walk from the ferry.  Many shops and restaurants around.  The north side is very nice and smooth. To the north you find more waves. They have several massages tables around for relaxation.  The water is clear.

reviews.title: Crowded place, waiters just wanna get people for their umbrellas
reviews.text: The Isla is dirty and smelly. MX$300 for an umbrella in Playa Norte. The day we went there were lots of people on the sand and on boats with loud music near the beach. Color of the water is impressive though, but wouldn't go back.

reviews.title: Best Beach On Isla
reviews.text: Best swimmable beach on Isla (Best Scenic Beach is Punta Sur). Nice soft white sand, clear waters, and turquoise hues. Definitely must go here. :)

reviews.title: Greatest of all beaches
reviews.text: Routinely rated in top ten in the world. They work to control sargassum. There are several great beach clubs, The Mayan being the best with excellent food!

reviews.title: Top place to stay
reviews.text: This is by far the best spot on the whole island. You are close to the center, you have good options and good swing bars. There is something for everyone here and during the summer the water is so calm you just chill in the water with a cold drink in your hand.

reviews.title: Heaven or Hell
reviews.text: No question asked Playa Norte is beautiful and there is plenty of room for everyone here but our personal experience from staying on the beachfront hotel for 5 days is that the beach has 2 different faces; beautiful and tranquil paradise during the first part of the day and then it becomes a music club for boats with drunk and loud parties spoiling it until about 5-6PM when finally almost all of them go back to Cancun/mainland - pretty sad but that is the reality (and we visited during pretty slow COVID November 2020...)There are numerous beach clubs to rent chairs from and some decent food options if you don't want to leave the beach at all - do your homework as they are somewhat placed in different areas and they do feel differently. The area by Mia Hotel has the most sand bars, the middle is fewer building and more palm trees and the corner where ChiChi's 'n Charlies is where you will find more building on the waterfront - the range of spots where you can stay is pretty great :)Great beach for swimming in peaceful waters, walk on sandbars and enjoy the views, and sunsets :) we loved taking a stroll from one end to the end in the evening when things started to calm down but I must say after 2-3 days the loudness of it gets a bit annoying - do try Playa Centro (next door on the west coast) as boats don't go there and the waters are pretty nice as well.TIP: many beach clubs take credit cards, also many have deals actually where after spending certain amount the beach chair and umbrellas become freeTIP: lots of vendors selling cigars, hats etc. just be nice and politely say no if you aren't interested, just be prepared to be asked a lot of times :)

reviews.title: Great beach
reviews.text: Excellent beach with calmer waters than some of the beaches in the hotel zone of Cancun. There are plenty of bars along the water if you want to get a drink or a bite to eat

reviews.title: Beautiful Beach!
reviews.text: Beautiful Beach! Plenty of fun and sun! A lot of entrepreneurs selling things but they didn’t hound you if you said no! Place where the boats dock. Music and a good time!

reviews.title: Good Beach
reviews.text: Good beach overall. Basically next to the Ixchel Beach Hotel and as you walk out of the hotel you are at the beach. It can get kinda crowded though so that is something to be mindful of.

reviews.title: Seaweed beach
reviews.text: Sea weed everywhere, chairs are for rent, the only thing worth it is the $20 golf cart to see the island and if you do make sure it’s dry as there is no flood control on street and here is a pic of the best beach in the world

reviews.title: Best beach yet!
reviews.text: This is the most beautiful beach I have ever visited.  The water was muy fresca and felt amazing all day everyday.

reviews.title: The beach daydreams are made of!
reviews.text: The most BEAUTIFUL beach I have visited so far in my life! It’s clear and every beautiful shade of blue you can imagine. We absolutely love swimming there and laying out on the beach. It’s the very essence of true paradise! I could look at that water forever...😍😭

reviews.title: Awesoooome Beach!
reviews.text: Playa Norte is one of my favorite places/beaches in the world! The water is so crystal clear and calm you don’t even want to get out of the water! It’s just so beautiful!

reviews.title: Again and again!
reviews.text: If you are uncertain about what beach to visit on your trip to Cancun or Riviera Maya look no more!Playa Norte has an expansive beach with clear waters and no waves, so perfect for everyone. Plus sunsets are quite something.Also, it never gets seaweed, so when everything is packing that algae, you could still swim here.

reviews.title: Beautiful
reviews.text: Wow, what a beautiful beach and location.  We found a small bar ocean front and were able to enjoy the water for a few hours.

reviews.title: one of the most beautiful beaches in the world
reviews.text: I have been a permanent world traveler for about 2 years, and have seen some amazing beaches. between the solitude, and the water color, plus the easy access to the city itself, and of course shade! gives this a big thumbs up

reviews.title: Closed due to Covid but..
reviews.text: So the beach is currently closed because of Covid but we ended up going to a bar along the beach and ordering margaritas and they let us stay and swim and we had no problems at all. The sand is very nice, the beach very clean and we didn’t see any algae in the water which was great. Very beautiful, blue beach and I’d say it’s worth a visit.

reviews.title: The best side of the island
reviews.text: The beaches are beautiful - but dont expect waves, the ocean is very calm at this part of the island - perfect for families and small children. Lots of great options for food and drinks!

reviews.title: CURRENTLY CLOSED
reviews.text: Playa Norte is CURRENTLY CLOSED TO EVERYONE. This beach is absolutely beautiful, however it's closed - even the private areas owned by hotels/restaurants are inaccessible and they have people policing it. We didn't know this before booking our hotel. The other beaches further south on the island are open, it's just Playa Norte and Playa Centro.

reviews.title: turquoise waters the best ever
reviews.text: WHAT A LOVELY PLACE, the turquoise waters are amazing. A MOST IN THE CARIBBEAN. The white sand and the open sky, unique experience to enjoy.

reviews.title: A place to reflect
reviews.text: North shore is a must in isla mujeres. Try watching  sundown or watch the sun come up! I have visited many times and everytime is a new experience. The beach does not change much, clear blue water with gentle waves and white sand beaches.... what is a bit different is me. I love to reflect as I look.

reviews.title: The beach was closed when we were there.
reviews.text: Closed. We missed getting to swim here by 2 weeks. We did go by Nd wish things were different. The people in this area are some of the nicest we have ever met. Everyone needs to visit the Isla Mujeres

reviews.title: Beach Closed.  Water Open.
reviews.text: This is so dumb.  If you are staying on North Beach you can't walk on the beach.  If you hire a party boat out of Cancun you can use the water in front of the beach.  Here is a picture of the boat traffic using the water in front of the beach.  They are literally lined up up from the top to the bottom of the beach.  But you can't touch the sand if you staying here.

reviews.title: Amazing view and ocean is crystal clear
reviews.text: Amazing view and restaurant that’s located at the location has a breath taking and relaxing view. Prices are not that expensive and food was delicious.

reviews.title: Attraction to visit on golf cart
reviews.text: The island is just 7 kilometer road.    You can rent a golf cart for 4 people for 150 pesos per hour (8 dlls per hour) or "negotiate a better deal for 3 or 4 hour.    You drive around and stop on any place to enjoy the nice sand

reviews.title: Beautiful Sandy Beaches!
reviews.text: The north beach is very beautiful and also crowded but well worth visiting for the day.  You can rent beach chairs at one of the many establishments on the beach and get food/refreshments served to you at your beach chair or go up and sit at their restaurant.  Get there early for a good spot!

reviews.title: Most beautiful water
reviews.text: Beautiful blue water! We walked the beach but then sat at a bar right at the edge of the water and had drinks, it was like the Corona commercials.

reviews.title: Beautiful Beach
reviews.text: Playa Norte is a must stop!  The water is amazing and the sand is soft and white.  We ventured there for sunset and were not disappointed.  It was truly a sensational place to watch the sun set.  We have also visited in the daytime and usually it is very busy with a vibrant atmosphere!

reviews.title: Beautiful beach, can get crowded
reviews.text: Nice beach, clean (when we were there), and friendly. It can get crowded.The water is beautiful and it is a nice place to relax for a few hours. We enjoy watching the boats as they anchor, come by

reviews.title: Beautiful, powdery sand, but way too busy
reviews.text: This beach is gorgeous, but we found it terribly over-crowded. Large groups were leaving their garbage behind everywhere, and we found it hard to take in the beauty with the place being so overrun.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach with turquoise water
reviews.text: We enjoyed this amazing beach with the turquiose water and white sand!! Dont miss it! Great for spending 2-3 hours

reviews.title: Tourist Mecca and sandy beaches
reviews.text: Gobbled up with the Mia Reef resort at the pit and resorts at most of the beaches, you can still sneak into on of the restaurants which has sandy beaches.  Try Playa Centro a public beach with swim areas.  Chair and umbrella rentals run a bit pricey.  Coco Restaurant and Beach Bar is chill with great service.  Beachside massages are also available.  Most everyone speaks English, but try and speak their native Spanish and you will gain a friend and respect.  Lots of street vendors and places to rent golf carts to tour the island.

reviews.title: Halloween and Dia de Los Muertos in Playa Norte
reviews.text: Unlike many places in Mexico right now, Isla Mujeres is pretty safe for tourists, especially if you stay in Playa Norte along the areas around Hidalgo, a no-car street lined with bars, restaurants and tourist shops. Cheesy? Yes. A little like Bourbon St meets Duval St? You betcha. Worth spending a few nights there? Absolutely. Check out Las Brisas Mexicanos on Hidalgo and Matamoros for the best Enchiladas with Salsa Verde I’ve every had (it’s the Salsa Verde) and don't miss El Patio down the road for the live music. There’s an incredible local band that does all 80s and 90s rock, and fantastic drinks too (cash only). At the end of the night sit on a swing  and enjoy a margarita outside Stingray’s (Hidalgo and Mateos), and then get fresh churros from Churrasic Park, a vendor right on the corner.  The end of October is a lot of fun on Isla Mujeres. On Halloween, local children trick or treat through the area and it’s really a cute sight. If you make it to one of the Dia de los Muertos festivals around the central plaza, there’s food, music and traditional costumes and religious displays. It’s so worth checking it out. Don’t stop with just Hidalgo and Playa Norte though, rent a golf cart (they’re cheaper in town than at most resorts) and drive all over. There’s great views at Punta Sur (the southern point of the island) and friendly people throughout.

reviews.title: Playa Norte
reviews.text: It better on pictures! Nice island but beach is not so good. However it's OK to spend 1-2 days here.

reviews.title: Most luxurious beach I have ever enjoyed.
reviews.text: Soft white sand that doesn’t burn your feet. The Mia Reef Resort is on its own island beside Isla Mujeres which causes a rapid flow of current between the two. The water is mostly shallow so there is no danger. Once you float out to the rope that stops you, there is deep water but if you keep going it gets shallow again. There is plenty of shallow water for kids to enjoy a swim. Frigate birds are soaring overhead all day- amazing. It’s a safe area to swim, keeping in mind the sun is very hot, there is no shade, and the wind makes you think you are not getting burned. I got burned on several days, no matter what shirt or screen I put on.

reviews.title: Nautibeach beach club is my new love
reviews.text: North Beach is always a must but this was my first time at Nautibeach. Great service, the food is spectacular and the drinks are beyond spectacular. That was my first time at Nautibeach and it will not be my last. The sand is so soft. The water is perfect.

reviews.title: Playa Norte
reviews.text: Such a beautiful beach! The waist deep water in the lagoon is perfect to float in! It’s busy during the middle of the day but we’ll worth a trip!

reviews.title: Amazing cristal water
reviews.text: Must see! Beautiful beach! Not much free space as lots of beach club along the beach.But Loved it!!

reviews.title: Must go
reviews.text: It is like paradise on earth. White sand and turquoise waterBeautiful! Planning to go back and I left yesterday!

reviews.title: Fun day at the beach
reviews.text: We rented a golf cart and found street parking easily. We took sandwiches and a cooler from our AirB&B and enjoyed the day at the beach. We were there on a Sunday and it was very crowded. I would recommend Central beach as it seemed to have more room for our chairs we also brought. Can easily rent beach chairs and umbrellas on both beaches. Vendors walked by from time to time selling ice cream bars, fresh fruit and bracelets.

reviews.title: Best beach
reviews.text: Grab a parking spot for your golf cart, rent a beach chair and enjoy! Lots of good beach restaurants to enjoy. Most of the other beaches are not free.

reviews.title: Great Beach!
reviews.text: One of the prettiest beaches you will ever see! Can get crowded, but still worth the view. Tons of beach bars around also.

reviews.title: Gorgeous Beach
reviews.text: One of the prettiest beaches I have ever seen. Gorgeous shallow water, soft white sand, plenty of spots to spend the day on a blanket or in a lounge chair.

reviews.title: Best beach in Isla Mujeres
reviews.text: Gorgeous beach in Isla Mujeres and the best option if taken others into comparison. Although swimming restrictions were very high (limited space to swim), this beach was mostly calm and safe to spend a part of the day whilst visiting the island. Upon arrival, we saw many restaurants and bars, as well as various lounge chairs and sun canopies displayed along the sand. It can get a bit crowed at some times of the day, but it is definitely a must see. This beach is really close to the pier head, so walking here is not a big deal. Customer service at the bars and restaurants surrounding the beach was really good, and best time to sit and have some food should certainly be during sunset hours. They have awesome local beers and surprisingly food was top quality. Pictures taken here were the best ones. Everyone should come visit and have a dip in the beautiful sea here. It's wonderful

reviews.title: Great breakfast
reviews.text: Coconut French toast was as good as all the reviews say!! A must try. Next time the eggs Benny which looked amazing as well

reviews.title: Day at the Beach
reviews.text: Nice beach.  Easy to get to off the ferry and downtown.  Gets crowded at times, especially on Sundays.  Go early to get beach chairs or cabanas.

reviews.title: Trip to Isla 2020
reviews.text: CrowdedHectic NoisyCrowdedTequila soakedIntoxicated Touristy Perfect if you're under 40A lot of fun if you're in the right frame of mind!

reviews.title: Great Beach
reviews.text: Great beach, sand and warm water. You can lay on your own towel or rent an umbrella and lounger. Drinks are served beach side and are reasonably priced.

reviews.title: The most stunning beaches!
reviews.text: If you're traveling to Isla Mujeres this is the place to be.  Head to the furthest north/west tip of the island for the best beach area, it's nice and shallow and you can walk out forever in the calm aqua waters.

reviews.title: Beautiful Beach
reviews.text: A great beach with turquoise water. A must see on Isle Mujures. We rented a bed with an umbrella at a local restaurant and had a nice day. Great beach to walk!

reviews.title: Lovely
reviews.text: Gorgeous beach. Well worth a visit. Lots of places to eat, drink and shop nearby. A highlight of our trip.

reviews.title: Best beach ever
reviews.text: The best beach from Isla Mujeres. Clear water, nice people, cold drinks. This is the beach that you must visit

reviews.title: Gorgeous overcrowded beach
reviews.text: Beautiful - and I do mean gorgeous - beach but way overcrowded with chairs and cabanas that you need to  purchase . Great place if your looking to party with a crowd.  Get there early or later in the evening (bring the deet) for a really great beach experience.

reviews.title: Beautiful
reviews.text: This place is as beautiful as everyone says.  The water was amazing.  Lots of people and very busy on the weekend.  Tuesday wasn't as busy and we enjoyed it.

reviews.title: Great beach that’s gotten too busy
reviews.text: Great beach that’s just too busy!! Says it all Guess it depend on when you’re here! Too many people on top of one another... other side of the island is more attractive at least to us now...

reviews.title: This is a must!
reviews.text: A beautiful beach with calm waters! The beach gets busy by noon, we would recommend getting a chair at a resort.

reviews.title: A Slice of Heaven
reviews.text: This is our 8th year on the island and we come for the weather, beach and food.  It's a nice place to be in February.  Beautiful white sand and Carribean Blue water.

reviews.title: beautiful beach
reviews.text: Great sandy bottom, nice swimming, lots of people and boats. You must rent a chair and umbrella if your going to be there a full day. lots of venders.

reviews.title: North Beach Crowded
reviews.text: North Beach was once pristine and lovely,  but it has grown to be too crowded.  Some days it is difficult to find a spot.  In recent years, massage huts, beach clubs, vendors and bars/restaurants have taken over much of the space.  There are only a few areas where you can go to set up your own chairs or blanket without having to rent lounges or order overpriced food and drinks to sit at a beach club.  I have often counted 50 boats anchored off of North Beach, many of which play loud music.  There is a  constant parade of boats coming from  Cancun loaded with snorklers to snorkel in waist deep water in the bay.  It is best to visit the beach in the morning or to come later in the day.  Midday is too crazy!

reviews.title: Beautiful beach
reviews.text: Water is crystal clear beautiful. Tiny waves which id great for swimming and for little ones. The sand is so sift and white

reviews.title: Beautiful Beach / Great Sorkeling
reviews.text: A visit to  Isla Mujuers ..should  include  Playa Norte ! Nice swimable beach. Beaches in the hotel zone much more beautiful. Downside is  that it is commercial ,crowded and no where to park .

reviews.title: GORGEOUS!
reviews.text: It tooks us alllllll day to get here because we somehow bought the wrong ferry trip to Isla Mujeres, BUT - it was worth it once we got to Playa Nortew!!! The water is the most beautiful color and super calm, so it is great for the little ones. I wish we had more time here!

reviews.title: very crowded
reviews.text: The place is very crowded and there is not a lot of space to stay except if you pay for a chair. The view is beatifull but not amazing.

reviews.title: "North Beach" area
reviews.text: Very crowded with chase lounges right up to water line. Some seaweed issues as some areas do not rake up and move away. If you want the loud, beach, party scene this is it on the island.

reviews.title: Beach’n It
reviews.text: Bring your towel, chairs , cooler or whatever you can carry!  Just pick an out of the way shady spot and setup shop. No need to rent a chaise unless you want to. Lots of people watching. Get wet and stay cool under a shade tree if you can find it.

reviews.title: Annoying Beach People
reviews.text: We went to a public beach on Playa Norte.  Was very nice shallow waters with white soft sand. I've been spoiled seeing countless beaches around the world so this was OK for me.  Not spectacular but nice. Unfortunately  MXN dude approaches us and  is insisting that we pay 400 MXN pesos ($30 CND) for a lounger that we were not using.  We had our own blanket and umbrella.  He went and got another friend from a restaurant and both of them tried bullying us off the beach and kept saying we cant use our umbrella.  After about 15 mins pestering us I told him it is a public beach! Unless he showed me in writing a law that states we can not use our own umbrella and blanket then back off or call the PoPo.  After that he left us alone.  Unfortunately Quintana Roo, Mexico has become very expensive.  No one is starving. No beggers. No homeless, which is a good thing but at the great expense of the touristas.

reviews.title: Beautiful
reviews.text: This is, by far, the best beach on the island. There are multiple options for accommodations or beach club rental on this end of the island.

reviews.title: Winter vacation
reviews.text: Great place for breakfast or lunch. People working treat you like family. Great Bloody Mary’s. We have eaten several breakfast there and have never been disappointed. Will go back. Cute place.

reviews.title: Catamaran to Isla Mujeres was great!
reviews.text: Took a trip to the island and walked to Playa Norte, incredible sight! went swimming in unbelievable water it was an amazing experience! The water was so clear and pretty calm- all the little shops and people selling on the streets was amazing as well. Was the best part of our trip by far

reviews.title: Beautiful! Bring Pesos!
reviews.text: Made me want to stay the night here, so I did! The area is so fun, the water is gorgeous and clean! 300 pesos to rent a beach chair, great price!

reviews.title: Gorgeous
reviews.text: Gorgeous sand and water. Walk around before settling in - there are definitely quieter and busier sections of the beach. Pros - free, byob, beautiful sand and water, sandy bottom.  Cons - can get busy and loud (music coming from speakers in all directions lol), Centro gets busy with tour boats

reviews.title: One word - Awesome
reviews.text: If you make it to Isla Mujeres a must. Plenty of places to chill or hang for the day. Walking distance to downtown, dining and entertainment if needed. Plenty of places to rent water toys, chairs, etc. If a need just ask someone always willing to help. Remember beach ettitique is important and pick up after self. Enjoy

reviews.title: beautiful white sand
reviews.text: A spacious beach covered in a beautiful white sand.  Take along a towel and enjoy the water.  Easy access.  We all appreciated the chance to relax after a long walk from the opposite end of he island which I also recommend.  You will have to rent a chair and umbrella if you want one but will make your stay more comfortable if you have a little shade.

reviews.title: Relaxing Relaxing Beach!
reviews.text: Amazing white sand beach! Crystal clear Beautiful turquoise water teeming with aquatic life. No waves just smooth as glass.

reviews.title: Beach
reviews.text: Best beach on the island, although the vendors were annoying all day long.  Very popular for the sail boats and catamarans.

reviews.title: If you want to stay directly on North Beach then Ixchel Beach Hotel is a great option
reviews.text: The pictures say it all really... Great for couples, friends, families of any ages. I've found that the earlier you book the lower the pricing...

reviews.title: Beautiful sand and ocean with no sea weed.
reviews.text: This is and outstanding beach.  We spent as many days as possible swimming and laying in sun here.  It is expensive if you aren't staying at a resort with their own beach chairs.  It was 300 pesos minimum to rent a table and plastic chairs.  Some areas of this beach are close to ferry and boat traffic.  Stay until the sun sets, its breathtaking!

reviews.title: Top quality beach
reviews.text: Nice sand, quality water and had a place on the beach...beautiful location. Have been there twice for 10 days and likely to go back.

reviews.title: The most beautiful beach in Isla Mujeres!
reviews.text: This is my favorite spot in Isla Mujeres. The beach is nice and safe. You can literally walk some meters and you'll find hundreds of fish. It's a great place for snorkeling. Really, you don't even need to swim. Amazing experience!

reviews.title: Best Beach on the Island
reviews.text: All water areas on the Island are beautiful, this beach is the most tranquil, busy but floatable. Everything you need can be gotten here, massages, food and shopping.

reviews.title: Great beach
reviews.text: This is an amazing breach. We rented a golf cart and drove here to spend a few hours. We ordered foot and drinks and just played in the water. Bring a beach blanket and water. Enjoy.

reviews.title: Beauty
reviews.text: Everyone we asked and everywhere we read mentioned how Playa Norte is a must. We arrived to the island around 9:30 and walked to Playa Norte (about 10 minutes). It was practically empty. We walked around some more and swam in the crystal clear water. Around 111, it started to get more packed. The beach is clean and there is plenty of space to put your towel down and tan.

reviews.title: Pure tranquility
reviews.text: There really is no place like Playa Norte. Beautiful, tranquil, and one of the best places in all of the Caribbean to catch a sunset. We always go to Tarzan’s and grab a table. Cost are an expensive and the sunset can’t be beat

reviews.title: Great beach
reviews.text: This public beach is a great place to spend the day. Parking is a little tough, but take your time and you’ll get a spot. There were tons of boats anchored at the beach and the people camped out on the beach for the day. We brought our snorkel gear and checked out the grassy/rocky area by the hotel on the Northeast end. Honestly, the water was so clear and there were so many fish right in the shallow area that we didn’t even need our snorkel gear.

reviews.title: Great place for the kids to play
reviews.text: Super fun to play in the currents, snorkel around the rocks, or play in the warm shallow waters. Public beach! There are plenty of beach front restaurants/clubs to order food/drinks/chairs but you can bring your own for the fraction of the cost and enjoy your day just the same

reviews.title: Beautiful beach!
reviews.text: We stayed at privilege aluxes, which was right around the corner from Playa Norte. Love, love this beach. Clean, clear water. Great people watching.

reviews.title: Catamaran day
reviews.text: Food. Ambiance. All of it is amazing The personnel is friendly, the place is clean and the food is delicious

reviews.title: Amazing Beach
reviews.text: Fabulous beach on Isla Mujeres with restaurants all around so you don't need to go far.  We stayed on the Island for a 5 day/4 night family vacation and loved it all!  Highly recommend with beautiful sunrises & sunsets.  You get them both on this island!!

reviews.title: Amazing
reviews.text: The most beautiful beaches, crystal clear water. We did not stay on this island just a day visit, we would definitely return.

reviews.title: Beautiful Beach, lots of selfies
reviews.text: Great beach overall.  Nice for swimming. Small for the number of people trying to hang out there. I would prefer a slightly less crowded beach.

reviews.title: Beautiful white sand beach
reviews.text: This is the premier beach of Isla Mujeres and every hotel has a bar and/or restaurant right on this beach.  Best times are earlier in the morning or later in he afternoon after the day trippers go home.

reviews.title: GORGEOUS!
reviews.text: Beautiful white sand & calm turquoise water. We didn't rent a chair or umbrella, just towels on the beach.

reviews.title: fab beach
reviews.text: really great beach with fun beach clubs and great massages up and down the beach. Easily accessible. The beach is shallow enough to wade out

reviews.title: Like the old days
reviews.text: One of our best experiences South was Playa Mujeres.  Still has the narrow cobblestone streets that cars don’t fit down and you can walk everywhere.  Sit and have a beer at a cantina and watch life go by. The highlight of the day trip was playa Norte.  Take a towel and a cooler and sit in the sand and swim in the clear warm sea.  It’s like the 80s when all beaches were public and you just bought a chair from a vendor or brought your own.  We made like hippies all day, sun swimming and cervesas.  Just walk if your at all mobile.  Don’t waste money on a golf carts.  Turn left from the ferry, walk to the end of the road and your there.  About a 5 minute stroll.

reviews.title: Winter get a way
reviews.text: Nice relaxed atmosphere. Very laid back. Norte beach is quite shallow and you can walk out in the ocean a long way in shallow warm water. Very clear and soft white sand. Hotels facing the beach had very crowded lounges. The first 50 yards in from the water is a public beach and the resorts property continued in from there.

reviews.title: The best island !
reviews.text: This is the best island i have been to, a very small one with coast to coast 2-3 minutes walk at the narrowest point, beautiful clear blue water. going to Isla Mujeres should be a must when visiting Cancun

reviews.title: Warm Blue Water!
reviews.text: We spent every day over the holidays at Playa Norte.  The water seemed warmer this time of year than last year.  It felt like when we visit at the end of May.  There was some erosion since this summer, but realize the sand shifts.  There was a little sargassum at times (nothing much) after rain storms.  This is still are favorite place to hang out each day.  We prefer to spend our time at Mayan Beach Club since it doesn't get as crowded there as other parts of the beach (Ixchel to MIA).

reviews.title: Best beach on the island
reviews.text: We first stayed at Izla Hotel for à couple of days. But the beach there was not that great, but the Hotel was! Then we moved to à Hotel at north beach. More expensive and less comfort but the view and the beutiful beach companseted that! To overlock sunset with Cancun skyline was fantastic!

reviews.title: January at Playa Norte
reviews.text: Playa Norte is truly one of the best beaches in the world.  The water is clear and blue and the sand is white and perfect for a beach day!

reviews.title: Overrun with tourists but pretty
reviews.text: North Beach is great because the water is most always calm and shallow enough to swim.  Unfortunately, they are way over crowded with tourists these days.  If you want to relax, the other side of North beach just South of Playa Mia is lest tourists but you can't always swim over there because of current.

reviews.title: Beautiful
reviews.text: Beautiful beach and water but I wasn't expecting it to be so built up.  Entire beach is lined with bars, restaurants and rental chairs /umbrellas. Completely packed with tours the day we went.

reviews.title: Clean beach but crowded
reviews.text: Walkable from the ferry.  Can snorkel from the beach. Sand is soft and a great place to picnic. Parking is tough in the area.

reviews.title: A fabulous beach
reviews.text: This is a glorious beach with the Caribbean waters superb! Lots of people enjoying the water and the sandy beach, lots of services offered, lounges for rent (15 for the day), great food nearby.Not be missed a great part of the charm of Isla Mujeres steps from Centro’s cafes and shops!It’s a wow!

reviews.title: Beautiful view
reviews.text: Beautiful view. Water is crystal clear. Sand is so soft. Water does not get deep anywhere we went. It gets very crowded. Get there early if you want a seat on the water.

reviews.title: Overrated, crowded and highly commercialised
reviews.text: Better beaches elsewhere on the island. Too many commercial establishments / restaurants do not give a relaxing feel... I found cancun hotel zone beach better. Kids refused to enter water as they did not find it appealing enough..

reviews.title: Crowded beach
reviews.text: Beautiful calm water. Soft fine sand.  Crowded but this is a busy time of year, last week a December, first of Jan.   Hotel properties are closing in on beachfront.

reviews.title: Playa norte beach - beautiful blue water and nice views
reviews.text: Playa Norte is the north end of the island and it is one of the best beaches which has amazing landscapes, affordable and great for kids with amazing shades of blue water. Remember to apply sunscreen as you will get tan in a few hours. This beach was enjoyed by all age groups and water is very shallow, towards the end there are some rocks and a small house with nice views.There is a lot of opportunities for shopping, dining/bars with music, spas/massages, local tours, and snorkeling. Enjoy!

reviews.title: Best beach around the island
reviews.text: Playa Norte is a beach at the north end of the island, is is beautiful but the clubs around it , takes advantage of it’s beautiful by there prices

reviews.title: Beach time
reviews.text: Beautiful white soft sand, amazing shades of blue water, and incredible snorkeling opportunities.Wade into the calm warm water then take a nap on the warm soft sand while the sun caresses you into dreams of paradise.This beach has something for every age. Just remember your sunscreen because you will want to stay all-day.

reviews.title: Playa norte review
reviews.text: Clean beach, amazing landscape,spacious, affordable and great for kids because the sea is like a pool

reviews.title: Beautiful beach
reviews.text: A beautiful beach and places to snorkel out in the water.  It is a great place for kids as the water is very shallow for quit a ways out.  There is also a nice place to walk to some rocks and a small house.

reviews.title: Calm clear water, soft sand
reviews.text: This beach is absolutely beautiful and the island is so small that you can easily walk to neighboring beaches along the water for a change of scenery.  The swimming section does not extend very far in the ocean due to boat crossings but there is still enough space to swim around and enjoy the water.

reviews.title: Beautiful Beach
reviews.text: It is a very good experience to go on Playa Norte beach!! I really recommend it . There are plenty of things to do like feed fish ,listen to Discotheque music and just swim around without any waves ! Water is absolutely beautiful and not too crowded!!! Nice place for food and drinks too.

reviews.title: So beautiful
reviews.text: We loved the beach here even though it was so windy. Go all the way to the bridge to The resort to see the whole area.

reviews.title: White sandy beach
reviews.text: First came to this place 31 years ago for honeymoon. Its alot more crowded now and more built up but it's still the best beach on the island and one of my favs. Lots to see, eat, drink and do here. The one annoyance is the vendors selling everything that keep approaching you. Dont even look at them and they just keep walking. The turquoise color of the ocean is gorgeous

reviews.title: Best beach around!
reviews.text: This is by far the best beach...water was absolutely beautiful and not too crowded!  Nice place there for food and drinks as well.
