Sarcasm was there but didn't interfere with anything...great for wading...plus a sandbar,.  This beach is perfect for those traveling with children of all ages...

reviews.title: Paradise
reviews.text: This is the best beach of the island! Warm turquoise water, white beachWell frequented! Good restaurants with an extremely good service To come back  Unforgettable

reviews.title: Good people watching
reviews.text: Enjoyed a few sunny hours on the beach at Playa Norte.  We parked our golf cart nearby and brought our own blanket and snacks, so didnt need to rent a chair or use bar services.  We found pleasantly clean, soft sand and warm waves.  It was somewhat crowded and a little noisy, but not too bad.  There are a few vendors, similar to everywhere we have been in Cancun. Quite a bit of boat traffic with the ferries and party boats passing quite close.  Nice beach here,  but i think we have been spoiled during our stay at Casa Maya so it didn't seem spectacular to us.

reviews.title: Crowded but pretty
reviews.text: Love the powder sands of Playa. Its getting more and more crowded every time I go. Wish it could be kept a secret!

reviews.title: Vacation
reviews.text: Very nice beach to rent a chair and umbrella for the day,watching all the boats was great. Nice place to relax and people watch.bought souvenirs from the locals.

reviews.title: One of the best beaches in the world.  Busy though.
reviews.text: You can walk into the open ocean forever. Beach chairs can be rented for US$15 for the day, however, you can also just leave  your stuff on the beach. Very shallow.

reviews.title: The views!
reviews.text: The beach is gorgeous. No filters needed. Shallow. Lots to see when snorkeling. No heavy currents or undertows. It is a must see!

reviews.title: Beautiful Beach
reviews.text: Such a beautiful beach and the water is gorgeous. Worth a visit while on Isla Mujeres. We took the ferry over from Playa Tortuagas for a day trip. We rented a golf cart to cruise around the island. We visited Playa Norte to relax on the beach for a bit and go swimming.

reviews.title: Stayed at Mia reef
reviews.text: It was beautiful. The beach is private but public can access the waters but most don’t. There’s a reef and plenty to look at if you like to snorkel. The beach washes away at tide and the refill it from the sand in the water. Kinda neat. Very relaxing beautiful blue clean beach. Lots of boating activity.

reviews.title: A wonderful beach
reviews.text: The white sand, the clear water without weeds, no big waves, the ambiance with the bars boarding the beach... I really love this beach and intend to go back.

reviews.title: Stoped to eat our lunch
reviews.text: We picked up a burrito near by and parked the golf cart to enjoy the beach.  Such a beautiful spot, quiet and serene.  The white sand and crystal blue water is just gorgeous.

reviews.title: Amazing stay!
reviews.text: Really awesome beach area, crystal clear water, white sands, not too many people in the morning. Nice for long walks. We enjoyed it a lot.

reviews.title: Wonderful Beach
reviews.text: Great free beach with warm, clear water. Bring your beach chairs and enjoy the day! We loved people watching. Everyone was having fun! This is a great family beach.

reviews.title: Spectacular Watee
reviews.text: Such a gorgeous beach with the bluest water you'll ever see. Pictures don't even do it justice. Had a fun day exploring and ended on Playa Norte.

reviews.title: Awesome neighborhood
reviews.text: We had a very large group of family and friends staying all over the North end (Playa Norte) of Isla.  Really an awesome area that is safe and provides something to do for everyone.

reviews.title: Gorgeous beach
reviews.text: One of the prettiest beaches I've seen.  Love the public access along the pricey hotel fronts. Pictures from the point were beautiful.

reviews.title: Beautiful
reviews.text: Beautiful beach! Lots of fun bars and restaurants to walk to. Feels safe, even at night. Would recommend

reviews.title: Stunning beach with beautiful turquoise water
reviews.text: Playa Norte is seriously stunning. Dotted with palm trees and soft white sand it is a place where you can fully relax and enjoy the strong sun of Isla Mujeres. There are different sections of the beach- some have beach bars that play music and other stretches are peaceful and serene with only the sound of crashing waves. You get to choose what experience you want and there is something for everyone. There are beach vendors offering handmade bracelets etc  and massages but they are not overwhelming like some other places we’ve traveled to in the world. The water is clear and clean and isn’t very rough at all-perfect for swimming. Highly recommend this beach while visiting Isla Mujeres

reviews.title: Hands down best beach anywhere
reviews.text: The best beach anywhere and I’ve been to Philippines, Thailand, and other places but this is it folks. Check it out for yourself

reviews.title: Lovely beach
reviews.text: Best beach from the whole Island. This is the beach that you must visit to relax and enjoy cold drinks

reviews.title: One of the most beautiful beaches in the world
reviews.text: Even if you are not staying on Playa Norte, make sure you spend a day on the beaches.  Good place to take sunset pictures.

reviews.title: Amazing!
reviews.text: The beach is amazing with white cool sands and warm crystal clear water. Definitely worth to spend a day on or even the whole vacation.

reviews.title: Stunning Coast Line, Beaches and Crystal Clear Water
reviews.text: We visited Playa Norte for one day from Cancun and were so impressed that if we return to the region again we will stay on Isla Mujeres and specifically Playa Norte. The beaches are stunning and friendly, the water is calm and shallow (even out 25 metres), and the views are fantastic. Easy to get to, and lots of restaurants and bars are on the beach. A real highlight of our holiday.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach
reviews.text: Went to Isla Mujeres for the day while staying in Cancun.  Made my way to Playa Norte which is a beautiful peaceful beach.  The water is blue and calm and you can got quite far out without it being too deep.  There are many places along the beach where you can rent a beach chair for the day.  There are bars and restaurants all along the beach and ladies come by offering massages and beach vendors offer their goods.  It is arelaxing place to spend the day.

reviews.title: Best Public Beach In All The Yucatan
reviews.text: Awesome beach, we spent all of our 7 days on Isla lounging here. We’ve come from Belize through Tulum and all up the Yucatan and this is the best beach we’ve seen. Even Cozumel didn’t come close as far as public beaches are concerned. There’s so much sand which is rare with all the erosion over the years and it extends 100 feet off the water at least. With plenty of natural shade in the form of palm trees, which are also perfect for setting up a hammock! The best part about it isn’t even the perfect blue shallow waters or the sandy bottom, it’s the fact that no one is bothering you! No hustling here at all. The odd person trying to sell mango or a massage but that’s it! You can choose to rent a bed at a beach club or you can choose to just chill. Amazing beach with lots to offer, Even some cool snorkelling over by the MIA Resort. Plan to spend lots of time here if you are downtown. Better yet, just stay downtown! Not a bad spot to catch the sunset either.

reviews.title: great sandy beach
reviews.text: this is a long stretch of sandy beach open to the public and within walking distance of the main town. The warm carribean waters are safe and shallow for a distance in to the sea.pleny of bars and hire of chairs and equipment are all available there.

reviews.title: Day trip
reviews.text: Golf buggy trip round the Island. Is absolutely devine there with beautiful beaches. A must see. Gorgeous.

reviews.title: Great place for a swim
reviews.text: Our last stop on our trip to Isla Mujeres was at Playa Norte.  This beach has change so much since our last visit in the late 90's.  It has been super developed compared to when we were here then.  The beach has not changed much other than there are a good deal more hotels here that there was in the past.  The beach is still nice, but there a lot more visitors.  When we visited on this trip, there were many catamarans anchored off-shore that brought other visitors to the beach.

reviews.title: Too crowded
reviews.text: 4 years ago it was an amazing place - calm, beautiful white beach, some sunbeds - it was my paradise beach. But now it changed to a party zone without a possibility to relax. The beach was just cramed fully with of course rentable sunbeds so the beach seemed to be very small and even the part where it’s allowed to swim was very small. Loud and nasty music everywhere and big boats are just sailing a few meters from the shore. Much to near. The only thing that was still amazing was the crystal clear water but no chance for snorkeling this time - because of boats, jet ski and so on.When you like a Cancun - like Party come. If not go somewhere else. I was really disappointed. They sold this place. 😞

reviews.title: Great place to relax and take in the sun.
reviews.text: Great place for a short visit.  Island is fun to explore.  We went diving and really enjoyed it.  Lots of wild life.

reviews.title: Pretty but overrated
reviews.text: We have been twice now and both times the beach was so crowded it sapped the fun out of it. The water is beautiful but right in front of you are many boats parked, enjoying the water. This further distracts from what should be a great view.

reviews.title: Best beach
reviews.text: Been hear many times, other beaches on island have gotten bad, but Norte looks cleaner every year. Sure you have to rent chairs and umbrellas but well worth is, water always calm.

reviews.title: Best beach ever
reviews.text: I have traveled a lot, and this is my favorite beach. It is crystal clear and calm. You can feed the fish and don't even need snorkeling equipment.

reviews.title: Super!!
reviews.text: Easy to go from Cancun to the island by ferry, also the beach is not far from the port of the island for the ferry. The sand of the beach is very light and clean. I fall in love to super beautiful Carribean blue sea from the beach. Amazing time to me.

reviews.title: The most beautiful beach in Isla Mujeres
reviews.text: This is the most beautiful beach in Isla mujeres. The water are so clear and the color is just amazing. The beach may get a little crowded and yet, totaly worth visiting and even staying near by. It is very close to a street with lots of good resturants and souvenir shops.

reviews.title: Gets busier every year
reviews.text: Awesome beach. Crowds are too much sometimes. Gorgeous sunsets. Hotels claim their piece of beachfront so you have to get there early or late.

reviews.title: Great drinks and views
reviews.text: We spent our off day (non-diving or snorkeling) to visit the north end of the island on a golf cart.  Playa Norte was easy to find and provided beautiful views of the Caribbean

reviews.title: Paradise away from home
reviews.text: Playa Norte is the best beach in the island. Nice restaurants and good views of the sunset.  I will be back

reviews.title: Quick Getaway
reviews.text: The Beach is one of the most beautiful beaches in the world. White sand turquoise water friendly people.I'll be back

reviews.title: Lots of Crowds, very touristic
reviews.text: Although it’s out the season, the place is currently has many daily visitors, the sellers are very pushing. Food is poor and we recommend to skip; go to the south part!

reviews.title: Breathtakingly beautiful views while still experiencing local culture
reviews.text: Ventured to playa Norte from Cancun for the day with a friend that had been many times before, and throughly enjoyed the experience.  I was treated to a wonderful tour of the entire island via golf cart, and The views were absolutely spectacular!!  I loved venturing through the local family run restaurants offering their own specialties that were absolutely phenomenal!!!  The guacamole and Mexican salsa at La Lolita were the best I’ve ever had, and I’m a huge guac fan!   The mojito’s are delicious as well, and come served in wonderfully chilled stoneware, and served by very friendly staff... which is incredibly refreshing after a few hours on a golf cart.  Lol.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach
reviews.text: This beach is a must see if you are staying in cancun we took a ferry to isla mujeres for the day rented, gulf cars, and had lunch at a seafood restaurant. The water was crystal clear with no waves.

reviews.title: Fourth time.
reviews.text: We come to Isla every summer. Our hotel has a great beach but we still like to wade through the water toward north beach.  Plenty of great spots to grab a drink on the beach

reviews.title: Best Place in Mexico.  Have been going there since 1996.  Always fantastic!
reviews.text: I have met people here from all over the world.  They always say it is the only place in Mexico they would come back to.  Not the best for tourists or night life only because they are not open late, not because the music isn't incredibly diverse and comparable to anywhere else in Mexico you would go to.  Laid back, quiet nights.  AA+1 restaurants.  Stay away from the all inclusive hotels.  You want to experience the island, the people and the culture.  One of my favorite places is The Joint on the south end of the island.  Music in the morning, super friendly employees and great breakfast reasonably priced.  Unless you like bumpin' in the clubs and spring breakers this place is not for you.  Mature travelers preferred.

reviews.title: BEST BEACH EVER!
reviews.text: We stayed at playa arena right on Playa Norte. We got out and explored the town as much as we could, but we felt like we were missing out by not being on the beach, so we wound up spending most of our time here. The sunrises and sunsets are incredible. The water is the most beautiful color I’ve ever seen. Of the 13 islands I’ve visited, this place is the most magical. Even the vendors are kind. A simple “No gracias,” kept them at bay and they were very kind and respectful. We made friends with several of them by doing this.I’ve seen people complain about boats, but the noise from the waves drowned out most music. Sundays seem to be the busiest. I loved seeing all the big boats and seeing others having a good time. We talked to a few of the passengers who came ashore. We paid the same price for our room for a night as what they paid for a six hour excursion! this was our first trip here, and as far as I’m concerned, it will be the only island I ever return to. It’s that awesome.

reviews.title: Hounded by sellers
reviews.text: There are more sellers than tourists on this island be warned you won't get a minutes peace, you are constantly badged by sellers. If you want a peaceful island visit go to Holbox.

reviews.title: Vacation
reviews.text: We had a wonderful week, swimming, snorkeling and enjoying the food. The weather was perfect, the friends that went with us had a great time too.

reviews.title: Stunningly beautiful beach
reviews.text: If you visit Isla Mujeres, walking along Playa Norte and watching the sunset is a must. Soft white sand, many places to eat and drink, chair and umbrella rentals are available for about $12 US (or less) all along the beach.

reviews.title: MUST SEE, STAY, SWIM
reviews.text: The best spot to relax and refresh on the island. Great people, great drinks great service, great times! Can't wait for the next visit!

reviews.title: Awesome Beach
reviews.text: We love coming here, whenever we have gone it has never been super crowded. Although at one time we did count 30 + boats out past the buoys, but the people tend to stay on or near those boats. We rented some chairs in front of Chimbos and Gabrielle was our waiter. What can we say, but he was awesome from the start! The bonus was when we went to leave he brought us a bucket of water and helped rinse the sand off of our feet! Talk about service. He always had a smile on his face and was super kind. We also like to visit the little massage place that has the green and pink curtain I think the color is. we have used Claudia and her gals several times. It was $35.00 for 70 mins.

reviews.title: Breathtaking beach!
reviews.text: We only visited for few hours during our catamaran trip, but, that was enough to leave a long lasting memory of this wonderful beach. We want to comeback and explore the area next time. Playa Norte is the Best Beach I ever visited!

reviews.title: Beautiful water, too many boats
reviews.text: We stayed at Mia reef which is right next to playa Norte. We have visited various Caribbean beaches from Dominican Republic, Jamaica and Cozumel. The water is the best we have been in. Crystal clear water and very calm. Only drawback is that the beach is overrun with boats near the buoys on excursions from Cancun. The boats bring tons of people from about 10am to 6pm. The music blares from all the boats. When we are in the water before all the boats come it t pure heaven. The boats don’t completely ruin the experience but it does distract from the beauty of the waters.

reviews.title: Nice getaway, very nice place to visit and swim in
reviews.text: The actual part that you want to visit when checking out Playa Norte is not the section immediately next to the ferry landing. Keep going toward the Na Balam hotel. The area up there is very pristine, sandy and not as crowded. You can rent beach chairs and umbrellas for a couple hundred pesos. KIds will love swimming in the water. I don't think it gets deeper than four feet so you can wander out there and hang out. Lots of places to buy a beer and/or water.

reviews.title: Couples Getaway
reviews.text: Awww. What can I say. So relaxing. Clear blue waters. A lot to see and do. Enjoy your time and take it all in.

reviews.title: My favorite beach!!!
reviews.text: Playa Norte is beautiful.  The water is a perfect temperature, the sand is soft.  This is my happy peaceful place to go!

reviews.title: Amazing beach
reviews.text: Loved playa norte from the first moment! The wite sand, the warm and clean water makes playa norte the paradise on earth!

reviews.title: One of the most beautiful beaches in the qorld
reviews.text: Playa Norte is stunning. It’s getting crowded. But if you go elsewhere on the island during the day and show up two hours before sundown you will have all the beauty with less crowds. Enjoy!!

reviews.title: Too many boats & people trying to sell
reviews.text: The beach is beautiful until all the boats from Cancun arrive after lunch. You can’t even see past 50 yards or so...it’s just boats, loud music and more boats. Forget laying back and enjoying a good book...every 5 minutes someone wants to sell you jewelry, henna, sarongs, shirts, peanuts, fruit, cigars, etc. I expect it when passing a shop...but not on the beach. It’s still one of the most beautiful beaches without the boats & sellers.

reviews.title: Awesome!
reviews.text: It is a paradise! So beautiful beach, clean and white sand shallow sea. You can swim, puddle boarding, kayaking or snorkeling. Liked this little street where are so many cafes and restaurants.

reviews.title: Best Sunset and friendly people
reviews.text: We spend two evenings here watching the sunset. The view, sand and people were all the BEST.  Don't miss this free show.

reviews.title: Overrun!!!
reviews.text: What has happened to Isla??  We have been vacationing on Isla since 2002.  Have not been able to go 2017-2018 for various reasons.  We were SHOCKED at the change in the island.  North Beach now looks like a spring break beach in Florida. 30 + boats full of people from cancun pulling up everyday with music blaring and hundreds of people.  Day after day, all day long being bugged to buy jewerly, hammocks, wraps, tattoos(ps dont do this!! lasted 3 hrs not 3 weeks!! live and learn) massage, bracelets, nuts, headbands, hair braids, children selling candy,  "bands" begging for money after "playing something"?? We had money stolen from bag on beach.  Riding around the island on the golf cart is nearly impossible now d/t parts of the road dug out about every 8 feet.  They tried to fill it in with dirt but the are worse than ANY of the speed bumps.  Last but not least the prices have gone up to shocking levels for Isla!.  PS---fyi for smokers.  Isla turning into a no smoking island.  Sad sad sad!  Our little vacation spot is not recognizable!

reviews.title: Sunset must
reviews.text: Catch the end of the day here in warm waves and beautiful sand. Watch the sunset and stay in or out of the water just a bit longer for the beautiful skies. Unbelievable.

reviews.title: Best beach!
reviews.text: Playa Norte is the reason to come to Isla Mujeres! Beautiful white sand, NO SEAWEED!, and shallow blue water. Just perfect! Pay a few dollars to rent lounge chairs and enjoy your day. There are many food and drink options as well as inexpensive massages.

reviews.title: Gorgeous!
reviews.text: If you are looking for a beach without the seaweed, this is the beach for you and your family. When you get off the ferry, just walk to the left. About 100 yards down the street, you will see rentals for golf carts. If you are interested in touring the island, the rental is well worth it, we loved it! If you are just interested in the beach, there are beach clubs all along the coast. The farther you walk, the less crowded it is. If you have small kids, the beach all the way at the end just in front of hotel MIA is the best. Crystal clear water and no more than thigh level deep for a long way out.

reviews.title: I knew I’d love from my window seat in the plane!
reviews.text: As so many other reviewers shared, it is beautiful. Emerald and blue water tones. Yes, you can see the fish swimming around the water is so clear. The sand is white and soft. Highly recommend visiting.

reviews.title: World class beach
reviews.text: I have visited Bali, Thailand and many other top beaches and punta norte is one of my top. There are many beachclubs where to relax, some more noisy than others so it is up to you.The water was cristal clear and there are no waves which makes it nice for kids too.There is an area for snorkling with loads of colorful fishes

reviews.title: Favorite beach on Isla Mujeres
reviews.text: Don't really know what makes a beach my favorite, but it is, so there you go, a five star review for 100 characters.

reviews.title: Beach was beautiful...feed fish next to hotel mia..very relaxing
reviews.text: Beautiful beach..water is warm...not very deep..fish swim.next to you bought saltine crackers feed the fish ...ecellent experience..

reviews.title: Beautiful beach but CROWDED, shopping, shopping and more shopping.
reviews.text: A beautiful area downtown with lots of shopping choices and is SUPER CROWDED, but a must to visit anyway!

reviews.title: Nice beach but DON'T stay at Ixchel Hotel
reviews.text: DO NOT STAY at Ixchel Hotel!!! We paid for three nights in the penthouse suite 707 and the room and bed was riddled with FLEAS!! I had bites on my leg and complained the following morning. The staff sent the maintenance guy to see if he could 'find' the fleas and he shuffled a few cushions on the couch around for about 30 secs and then said he couldn't see insects. I asked to move rooms and they moved us to a cheaper room and I asked for a refund for the difference but they staff just kept telling me to come back as they need to ask someone to authorise it. I chased up about 6 times while on holiday and even the manager MARIANA was useless and couldn't make a call so when we checked out I had to ask again and Alexis said he would give me the refund - he took a copy of my credit card and until this day they never processed it. It is absolutely disgusting to be treated this way! Honestly do not waste your money staying here unless you want to bring fleas away with you! I have stayed at much nicer hotels for less! on Playa Norte!

reviews.title: Never fails!
reviews.text: Even on a cloudy day, this beach is beautiful. If you like to swim, you'll love this beach because you can essentially swim the length of it and see straight to the bottom. Sometimes it's busy, depending on the season, but even then it doesn't feel too crowded. You just have the find the right spot. We always go to the very end, near Hotel Mia.

reviews.title: TOTAL DISAPPOINTMENT!!!
reviews.text: Saying Playa Norte is one of the top 10 beaches in the world is a joke! We arrived at Playa Norte and we didn't want to believe it! The beach is small and was completely crowded, the different beach bars were playing very loud music. Even worse were the 80 yachts moored a few meters from the beach, each playing music louder than the other !!! We thought we were going to paradise and ran into a fair !! A real nightmare !!Isla Mujeres and Playa Norte never again !!!

reviews.title: Vacationer trip
reviews.text: It is easy to spend the whole week enjoying Playa Norte. The sand is great and the water colors are superb.

reviews.title: Get there early
reviews.text: Get there before all the tour boats! it is beautiful always, but peaceful in the am! We got chairs next to Tarzan, much quieter and less people!

reviews.title: Getting SUPER Crowded!
reviews.text: Have been to Isla many times and stay between Privileges & Ixchel.  This time I stayed at Privileges and several people staying there commented on how crowded it was.  I had no problem getting a spot on the beach though and really didn't notice the crowds.  However, next door at Ixchel it was horrible!!! Hundreds of people, you couldn't see the sand for all the people.  Both Ixchel and Privileges have "private" areas for their guests, but the beaches are public and anyone can use the beach.This trip I did see a lot of folks.  One family of about 20! was trying to camp out on Privileges property which security put a stop to.North Beach by Ixchel has better swimming as there is an artificial breaker that controls the current, at Privileges however, there is no barrier and the current drags you toward the pier.  You cannot just relax and float or swim, as you are always fighting the current. People literally clung to the barrier rope to keep from drifting off. Frustrating!Also, because of the artificial barrier, people tend to flock to the beach area by Ixchel.  I'm not sure how it is further down the beach and towards Mia which has a shallow bay.As for the crowds, I believe it has to do with the seaweed issue. I come back to Isla/Playa Norte because there is little to none.  The sunsets at Playa Norte are beautiful.While the beach is great, the crowds and in some places currents are an issue.

reviews.title: The secret is out.
reviews.text: Returning again to my favorite island for the 8th time; and never any disappointment in the beaches. Voted among the top 10 beaches in the world, but shhhhhh. Don’t tell anyone.

reviews.title: The best beach from Isla Mujeres
reviews.text: The paradise exist, and his name is Playa Norte. You must visit, enjoy and relax on this beach. Take a cold drink.

reviews.title: Sunset perfection
reviews.text: Great spot to swim, watch a fabulous sunset and enjoy a drink.Our favourite spot was a casual bar on the point between the 2 beaches. Last drinks at 7. But they are happy for you to sit and sip your drink for the next hour ,good value wine by the glass. Would suggest a walk around the point to media luna beach and along the cliff top walk beyond so lovely ... could be on a Greek island

reviews.title: Beautiful beach
reviews.text: Definitely the best beach in isla Mujeres ! A good vibe in the center of everything. Restaurants kind of pricey but the beach is amazing

reviews.title: Lovely beach but you have to get a sun bed
reviews.text: Great beach, shallow water that’s calm and easy to swim inRoped off swim areaBut v hot with no shade unless you rent a sun bed (ours was 100 mx each for the day) which included showers and loosLots of bars and restaurants nearbyIf you’re in the Isla Mujeres you’re not going to NOT go there are you?

reviews.title: Nice Beach
reviews.text: Nice Beach. Fine sand, low buildings partially hidden by trees. Multiple facilities available. But super crowded and weed in the water.

reviews.title: Very nice place
reviews.text: We ate at a local restaurant right on the beach. Playa Norte is quite fun, very lively and safe. A must stop destination for all while visiting Isla Mujeres.

reviews.title: Stunning.
reviews.text: An absolute must for children. The water represents more of a ‘bath tub’ feel vs. an ocean. It’s so beautiful.

reviews.title: Idyllic beach
reviews.text: Amazing beach, white sugar sand and turquoise warm waters. A beach lovers delight.Lovely beach bars nestled within the palm trees.

reviews.title: amazing beach destroyed by Cancun day trippers
reviews.text: This beach is amazing, I've traveled the world and seen some amazing beaches, this is one of them. Crystal clear water, calm, white sand you can walk out hundreds of feet, even neck deep you can see your toes the water is so clear. Unfortunately, the idyll is shattered by dozens (literally, I've counted 30-40 at once) of boats that show up from Cancun starting around 10-11 am, blasting really REALLY loud music, each playing different music so what you hear on the beach is a cacophony, and staying until 4 or so in the afternoon. Get there early in the morning to enjoy it, or come back late afternoon and you can also catch an amazing sunset if the clouds cooperate.

reviews.title: Totally overrated
reviews.text: We visited Isla Mujeres because we read that the beaches were absolutely amazing, especially Playa Norte. The water is warm, calm and a very clear turquoise. BUT, there’s a rope in the water where the swimming zone stops and the other side is basically a yacht parking lot. No view of the ocean, just the boats. And they all play different and super loud music, so much for a relaxing day at the beach. We couldn’t find an umbrella to purchase on the island, so unless you rent one, there is very little shade. We sat down next to a fence, where the sun was less brutal. We didn’t even take pictures, was not worth it.

reviews.title: Love Playa Norte
reviews.text: The best beach on Isla Mujeres. Clear water, nice people, relax, and cold drinks. You must visit Playa Norte, you will love it

reviews.title: Excellent beaches
reviews.text: The bluest waters I’ve ever seen. There are different restaurants and bars excellent to spend the day at.

reviews.title: Best resort for Cancun - safe and very private with excellent food and amenities!
reviews.text: All inclusive experiences can be disapointing - but our stay here was simply superb! The restaurant offerings and the service was excellent and the dining areas were very comfortable and well maintained!

reviews.title: More than beautiful beach
reviews.text: Cool breeze, sunlight and the coral beach.. it was a fabulous day out with my family. Everyone there looked so happy and satisfied with the whole atmosphere. Beach clubs are around and the music from them coming out.. I am definitely going back sooner or later

reviews.title: Amazing beach!
reviews.text: I will admit, it’s really hot and more crowded than in the past but Playa Norte is really gorgeous. I love IM so I am biased. Hawaii is amazing, too, for that matter. But there is just something special about this island. There are no high rises or fancy resorts, so if those are your needs, go somewhere else.

reviews.title: Best beach of our trip
reviews.text: Water is absolutely crystal clear, zero seaweed whatsoever. Gentle waves and smooth sand. Rental umbrella/bench are good addition but not required for shorter stay, set up your own spot and go for a quick dip, the beach itself is free.

reviews.title: Gorgeous beach overrun with people
reviews.text: Such a beautiful beach! The white sand and turquoise waters are not to be missed. The only bad part is all the people! It’s absolutely swamped and any type of shade is charged for a premium. Bring cash if you want any type of comfort. But it is a gorgeous spot.

reviews.title: Very very cool
reviews.text: We went to chill and got exactly that. Come early, pick a place in the shade and chill. Really beautiful beach.

reviews.title: No seaweed paradise
reviews.text: Read the title, it says it all. This is just the place to go away from Cancun and Riviera Maya sargasso problems and enjoy the crystal clear water.Avoid the beds for rent, they are 500$ in off season, just bring your own and enjoy for free.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach
reviews.text: This a beautiful clean beach. The sand is soft & white & the sea is a brilliant blue. It is at its best early morning before the boats arrive but you can find quiet parts of the beach during the day. There are plenty of beach bars who will look after you during the day. We paid 300 pesos for two beds & a parasol for a full day. As a party of 50 we had a wonderful evening meal at the Mayan Beach Club. They put the tables on the beach and were able to watch the beautiful sunset. Fantastic.

reviews.title: Best Beach on the Island
reviews.text: We arrived on the South side of the island and got a cab to this beach situated on the North (Norte).Pure white sands, shallow waters and beautiful.Lots of bars and people generally having fun. Great place!

reviews.title: GORGEOUS
reviews.text: If you have a chance to visit this island and beach, DO IT!  The water is the most beautiful you will see in the area.  We rented a golf cart (DO NOT RENT FROM CIROS) and toured the island, and then spent the rest of the time at Playa Norte.  We paid $15 for two beach chairs and an umbrella.  The beach service was excellent.

reviews.title: Very busy, typical tourist beach
reviews.text: The views from this beach are great but it’s very crowded and noisy given that it’s right in the tourist downtown area.  It’s definitely worth a look-see.

reviews.title: Playa Norte
reviews.text: Beautiful water, white sand and life under the sea! Would definitely come back again very soon. Best time to come is in the morning as sometimes it can get crowded

reviews.title: Lovely beach with no waves...goods and bads in my review
reviews.text: The Goods:Nice beach with no wavesWe found 2 chairs and umbrella for 250 pesos in a  great place and they allowed us to bring our cooler (many places do not do that)The price for chairs and umbrella include free bottles of water for twoEnjoyable time with kidsThe BADS:Restroom cost you 5 pesosALL the rich Mexicans who have yachts park them in reverse so close to the beach and they have loud musicIf you don't bargain for prices they will charge you 650-700 pesos for umbrella and chairsDO NOT take the ferry back to cancun between 5-6pm because its peak time and either you will be waiting for the next ferry or miss the ferryHope this helps, This place is good for families and we enjoyed it at 100% despites the bad things

reviews.title: Nice beach
reviews.text: Lovely beach, bright blue water and super soft white sand. Gets a bit busy as the day goes on. Lots of places to buy food.

reviews.title: Best beach in the world
reviews.text: You must visit this beautitul beach. Clear water, nice people, nice places to get relax and have cold drinks

reviews.title: Beaches don’t get any better than this.
reviews.text: This beach is fabulous. We have been swimming here at least twice a day for the past week and walking along it as well. The water is so clear. The water is refreshing and warm.

reviews.title: Greatest beach on earth
reviews.text: I have been living in Cancun for 16 years now, so when it comes to beaches, i know them all, in Tulum, Playa, Holbox, Cozumel etc. We have  the best of the best beach sin the world, but the Queen of them all is definitely Playa Norte in Isla Mujeres, first of all it is a little classic mexican caribbean island, and imagine this white sand, cristalino water beach, with more tan a hundred yards up to your waist, great restaurants and the most beautiful women in the world, (and men also), so just take the ferry and discover the most beautiful beach on earth.

reviews.title: Amazing carribean blue
reviews.text: The ocean here and sand are phenomenal.  Pick a place on the beach and spend the day.  Depending on where you stay you can reserve a palapa or a beach bed.   Great bars and chair side service!!

reviews.title: Summer 2019
reviews.text: Beautiful beach. Shallow water it's great for children. It gets quite busy close to lunch when all the boats arrive but there is plenty of space for all.

reviews.title: Great, great , great
reviews.text: Great waters, great sand, great coctails.Really enjoyed this one.We were lucky and it wasnt so crowdy.

reviews.title: A world top beach
reviews.text: We’ve been coming back here multiple times over 20 years. Beach has retained its beauty though quite a bit more crowded than it used to be. There’s usually shade under a palm tree if that’s what you want. Otherwise lounge chairs, umbrellas and shaded lounge beds are available for a fee if not staying at one of the hotels like Na Balaam. Water is beautiful and depth increases very gradually with no drop offs that I’ve found. Weekend can be noisy with usually dozens of party boats from Cancun anchored just beyond roped swim area, many with loud music. Early morning on North Beach is best, a magical time and place.

reviews.title: Playa Norte - beautiful!
reviews.text: Shallow clear swimming water, great beach! Our family with small children enjoyed the day. Lots of people on the beach and in the water but did not seem over crowded. We rented two lounge chairs and an umbrella for $300 pesos. Several bars/restaurants on the beach.

reviews.title: Beatiful Beach
reviews.text: Loved the Beach With Crystal Clear water. The sand was like powder, so clean. Not too overcrowded. Stunning!

reviews.title: Playa Norte
reviews.text: Busy but fun and touristy beach. Stunning water. Beers and snacks steps from the water. Worth a stop for sure if on Isla!

reviews.title: Best beach!
reviews.text: Ideal for all! From 4 year old in arm bands through teens up to 45+ falling off paddleboard. Great times!

reviews.title: Boat Bay for Cancun Yhats
reviews.text: Over crowded, the coral is dead because of the result  tourists and over crowding. It is also high season and super hot and humid.The boats sort of take over with tours from Cancun. It should no longer be allowed to keep the serenity of the beach in my opinion. Each boat is blasting its own music as well as the restaurants on the beach so it music competing with each other.... A bit too intense.  The water itself is beautiful and it is where you come for the sunsets. Many places to eat and drink.

reviews.title: Playa Norte is awesome!!!!
reviews.text: We stayed at the Ixchel Beach Hotel in Playa Norte for 2 weeks and it was awesome.  Everything is within a 10 minute walk.  We enjoyed many great meals in the area.

reviews.title: Playa Norte, the best beach!
reviews.text: We discovered Playa Norte and Isla Mujeres a decade ago and have vacationed here nearly every year since then.  Sometimes twice a year.  We love the sugary white sands, the emerald blue water, the palm trees for shade, the breeze that seems to constantly caress your skin, the great service that one gets from the many beach clubs and restaurants, the gentleness of the waves kissing the shore and the long, slow slope of the sea floor that allows one to walk far out into the water.  We have visited as a couple, with a group of couples, with teen children, young children and with those that are young at heart but have some years behind them.  The beach is great for all ages!  Playa Norte is our favorite escape!  P.S. I forgot to mention the sunsets so I’ll include a picture.

reviews.title: Beautiful especially at sunset
reviews.text: Lovely soft white sand - very clean and plenty of choices for hiring sun beds etc.  During the day it was packed but in the evening it was less busy and great for watching the sunset. At 6am I had it just about all to myself perfect for an early morning dip in the lovely calm warm waters.

reviews.title: So crowded you can’t move
reviews.text: And you really can’t get a break from all the noise. If you’re looking for lots of really loud music, a lot of booze and tons of people, then this is the spot for you. Otherwise try the quiet side of the island cause you can’t hear yourself think on this beach. It is kept amazingly clean.

reviews.title: Stunning beach!
reviews.text: We stayed at Playa Norte and it was seriously the most beautiful beach I’ve ever seen in my life!The locals are so friendly and sweet and this beach is very close to so many great restaurants!

reviews.title: Touristy and expensive
reviews.text: We went there because, from the pictures and reviews, we thought it was “the thing” to do. No thank you. It was very crowded and the few chairs that were available were $350 pesos. You can go to many other places on the island where the beaches are beautiful and the chairs are free or way less. That’s why beach clubs are a better option in my opinion.

reviews.title: The best beach
reviews.text: Glad we took the time to visit Playa Norte.  We stayed for a few hours.  I felt safe to leave or bags on the beach, we did not rent chairs.  You can walk out forever, there are many boats here but they are a ways from the beach.  The water was beautiful and warm and worth the trip to Isla Mujeres.

reviews.title: Beautiful
reviews.text: Great for kids. Super clean. Don’t have to pay to go. Can take your boat there. Recommend to go between the week days, weekend gets full.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach and gorgeous sunsets
reviews.text: This is our go to place each year to rest and refresh our stressed out brains and bodies.  The beach is soft, cool sand and generally the water is very calm which makes it perfect for young families and older folks.  The only negative is that word continues to spread about this wonderful location and it's beginning to be crowded during the day.  Later afternoon and before noon is perfect.

reviews.title: Lovely beach!
reviews.text: Lovely and clean but quite busy. It’s so nice to see the little fish swimming near your feet. Definitely worth a visit if you’re on the island.

reviews.title: Great, clean, beach
reviews.text: We stopped here first thing after arriving on Isla Mujeres.  We rented a golf cart and happened to find the public entrance without even trying.  Get there early as parking backs up down the block and around the corner.  There are a number of resorts that rent chaise lounges under an umbrella, but otherwise there are few shady spots.  The water is clear and stays shallow quite a ways out.  Boats congregate here to swim, and many of the boat tours will stop off here as well.  We didn't walk the beach much, so I'm not sure if there are food and drinks for sale, but if I had to guess you could find something fairly close by.  Nice beach, but it's the main area everyone goes to.

reviews.title: Best beach, but come early
reviews.text: Playa Norte is the most beautifull beach we have ever visited. Blue sea, white sand beach,  and quiet.Until the tour boats from Cancun come in. They start to arrive around 11am and can count up to a hundred or more.So for the remote desert island feel: come early.

reviews.title: Gorgeous!
reviews.text: The water is so clear and beautiful. Small but lovely beach. Nothing to say except I want to go back so badly!

reviews.title: Beautiful Beach
reviews.text: This was a great place to visit with beautiful water, clean beaches....NO SEAWEED !!  Only problem, Cancun's and Playa's seaweed problem has made it overcrowded now.  Was there a few years back, never crowded.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach but too busy
reviews.text: Beautiful beach but there were as many people as there were grains of sand! Beach is packed with sun beds. Great if you can get down early though and get a bed. 300 pesos for two beds and an umbrella.

reviews.title: Most beautiful beach of the island
reviews.text: Best beach. White sand, palms, blue water. You can rent 2 beds for just €15 for the whole day and get 3 vouchers for free water.

reviews.title: Gorgeous Beach
reviews.text: Best beach I’ve been to. The water is so crystal clear. Many clubs and restaurants along the beach.  Bring your own umbrella and chairs or rent them from one of the facilities.

reviews.title: The beach to go to on Isla Mujeres
reviews.text: Rented a bed at the Green Demon Beach Club for the day and thoroughly enjoyed the experience.  No need to hit a beach club to go here but it's worth the walk! Beautiful!

reviews.title: Gorgeous!
reviews.text: If you visit the island or any place nearby - you HAVE to go to this beach. It’s a paradise! It’s a relatively quiet place. There are bars you can get a drink but it’s not a party beach. In the afternoon there are beautiful yachts coming which makes it somehow even more exotic.

reviews.title: Excellent beach!
reviews.text: Playa Norte is as great as everyone says it is. The waves are gentle, the sand is white, the water is clear, and you can wade 100+ yards out and still be only chest deep. We loved it and the kids loved it. It's pretty calm in the morning but picks up around lunch as more people arrive. There are plenty of great beach clubs to choose from if you want to get chairs/umbrellas, and some of those will include food.

reviews.title: It really nice
reviews.text: It beautiful beach and good food, service and really safety all island are amazing and safe. I’m obligatory deals

reviews.title: Beautiful beach
reviews.text: Beach was literally a huge pool. Water was clear blue, and you can walk way out and still only be waste deep. We left tulum because of the seaweed snd was very happy to come here.

reviews.title: Great Beach
reviews.text: Voted #1 beach for good reason. Calm clear water with sandy ocean bottom. Great for relaxing and watching the sun set.

reviews.title: Great Beach - missed the bars w music
reviews.text: Great beach to relax in the beautiful turquoise water, with a cocktail, listening to the music from the boats anchored close by, we stopped on our way back from our whale shark experience and it was a nice change being on the boat side. We walked up and down the beach always finding Tarzan bar to be or favorite.  Easier to move ur golf cart than walk the beach in some areas, you will get it once you get there.

reviews.title: Beach is amazing here!
reviews.text: Beach is amazing at Playa Norte! Will definitely return to the Mia Reef Resort. Hotel was not all that but the location was worth it.

reviews.title: Prettiest Beach on Isla Mujeres
reviews.text: Unless you are open to paying for the Pool Bars on the other side of the island (which I recommend - they were great!), then Playa Norte is your only option for authentic beach while here.   A mini Miami Beach with chairs for rent, massage therapists hawking their services, and lots of activity.  If you want quiet time, bring the headphones. And don't forget your wallet.

reviews.title: Paradise
reviews.text: The only place where the seaweed is not so bad. Full of parties, happy people, white sands and yachts.

reviews.title: Great water for smaller kids
reviews.text: This beach never disappoints.  The angle of the beach is such a shallow angle that you can journey out 100 yards or so and still only be waste deep.  Beautiful white sand bottom reflects the light blue water perfectly.  Bring along something to feed the fish and the kids (of all ages) will be thrilled!

reviews.title: Beautiful beach!!
reviews.text: A very pretty beach with white sand and turquoise water. Place is usually full of people though and there are beaches around the island that are just as nice and have no/a small number of people. You just need to ride a little bit and look.

reviews.title: Pristine beach
reviews.text: We visited Isla Mujeres for second time. Went straight to Playa Norte. Beautiful clear water and calm. Great for the little ones. You can walk out very far and adults still touch the soft sand. Gorgeous views.

reviews.title: Beautiful Beach and Sunset Viewing
reviews.text: We were staying on the island, so we rented a golf cart for 24 hours (highly recommend.) We got the cart at 3pm and drove around for a bit and then came back to Playa Norte to watch the sunset. It was very crowded at this time of the day and the water isn't as crystal blue (because the sun is setting) but still a great place to see the sunset. The next morning we went down to Playa Norte earlier and nearly had the beach to ourselves (10am time frame?) If you want to experience it with little crowds, that's the pro tip. Water is also postcard perfect at that time of day if the sun is shining. You def. should check out this area if you are on Isla.

reviews.title: Beautiful
reviews.text: We had a beautiful day at playa Norte! We rented chairs and and umbrellas at a reasonable rate and had lunch and drinks

reviews.title: excellent beach
reviews.text: Lots of pure white sand and bath water clear blue sea - although can get crowded in places. Lots of bars

reviews.title: Lots of fish for snorkel
reviews.text: Went to playa norte but the beach next to MIA hotel and it was beautiful.  The water is clear and shallow and so many fish to see.

reviews.title: One of my favorite beaches
reviews.text: Calm water and lots of bars and restaurants. If you like to snorkel  walk along the beach towards MIa Reef Hotel. This area of the beach is away fro town and not as busy and offers a chance to do some light snorkeling in a protected bay

reviews.title: nice but disappointing beach
reviews.text: Playa Norte is seamingly the tropical beach - turquise water, lots of palms and white sand. However, compared with other beaches of the same sort, it is much less pleasant.  The beach is cut into sections according to the hotels behind it and the result is that parts of it are very narrow and one does'nt get a view of the entire strech of beach.Another fact is that in December, when the weather is perfect, the sea is rough and not the ideal calm tropical waters.  I've also been there in February - the sea was better but it was also much warmer. This of course may change from one year to another.

reviews.title: Stunning
reviews.text: Cool, crystal water with lots of life. We lounged around in the water as tropical fish swam by. There are also fantastic tide pools near the Maya resort where we saw tangs, coral, and many variations of beautiful fish. Take a snorkel- you won't regret it.

reviews.title: Paradise
reviews.text: This beach is the paradise. Clear water, relax, the kids love it. We visit this beach every day to have great time and enjoy the view

reviews.title: Best Beach
reviews.text: We always get chairs/umbrella in front of Buho's so we have easy access to food, drinks and beach side massages.

reviews.title: Fantastic Beach!
reviews.text: Gorgeous white sand and turquoise water! Very relaxing! Great for people watching! Close to the Hidalgo main strip. My favorite beach!

reviews.title: My favorite spot in the Caribbean
reviews.text: We stayed at Ixchel Beach on Playa Norte. No rocks and chairs everywhere. Even if you aren’t staying at a condo on Norte, you can rent a chair, umbrella etc. We are from FL and have lived in beaches our entire life. This was a special beach and we will be returning!

reviews.title: Beautiful beach
reviews.text: This is a beautiful beach. Boats are kept at bay with a bout and string. Lots of activities. Great service.

reviews.title: gorgeous beach!
reviews.text: Although the beach itself was spectacular, with the island being so small, it was super crowded on the beach and with yachts pulling up out in the water.

reviews.title: Best beach I’ve been too!!
reviews.text: This made my vacation. We chartered a boat went to playa Norte were so impressed and felt so relaxed we did it again the next day !! This excursion made my vacation !!

reviews.title: Loved it - two thumbs up
reviews.text: Arrived in Isla Mujeres around 11 and visited this beach first. There were not many persons and we got to enjoy the beach to ourselves a little. We came back around 3pm and entered the beach by the side with the Reef hotel. It was less populated but still a lot of persons. I liked that we could have used the facilities of any of the restaurants on the beach. We rented a mattress, table and umbrella I believe for 300 pesos(15USD)

reviews.title: Still Beautiful
reviews.text: The blue waters on Playa Norte are inviting.  You can spend hours in the water swimming and relaxing.  There are few people and boats there before 9:00 am.  This is also a great place to watch the sunset.  The downside is a oily white film appeared on the water after 5:00 pm and a few times earlier.  Was this from the boats parked beyond the buoys?

reviews.title: beautiful beach, too crowded
reviews.text: A beautiful beach just to crowded to enjoy as much as you would like.  Still glad we stopped and spent a few hours swimming.

reviews.title: Beautiful water and Beach, crowded
reviews.text: Playa Norte has the most beautiful beach on Isla Mujeres! The water is so clear that I could see my toes when standing in 4 feet of water. The sand is smooth and not rocky. You don't need water shoes. Our only negative is that it's full of a lot of people. In spite of that, we went there 3 times. We chose to not rent beach chairs. It's perfectly fine to put your beach towel and stuff on the beach. If you are polite to the walking beach vendors, they will not hound you. We felt safe everywhere on this beach and in the water. We've traveled all over and this was the most beautiful water we've ever seen!

reviews.title: Outstanding Caribbean beach!
reviews.text: Stopped here for a few hours as part of a day trip. This beach and the sea is pure paradise and is well worth the trip! We hired a golf buggy for an hour and took a drive round the island which is beautiful.Highly recommended!!

reviews.title: Beautiful white sand beach
reviews.text: We had a fantastic time at Playa Norte in Isla Mujeres. Although the beach was busy with other tourists and boats, the scenery was just too beautiful to let that bother us. It reminded my husband and I of the US Virgin Islands St John - the beach had a feel more typical of part of the Caribbean. The water was absolutely gorgeous and crystal clear. The young children in our group loved splashing around in the water there - even though they are small, the waves did not knock them over. We packed a picnic and our own beach towels to save a little money as the food choices & lounge chairs  on the beach were a little higher than we wanted to pay.  There are plenty of choices for food, drink, cabana or lounge rentals. I visited this beach on Isla Mujeres 10 yrs ago and it was a sleepy Mexican beach. Now, it’s a quite a busy beach but don’t let that detract from the amazing scenery and wonderful Caribbean vibe.

reviews.title: Beautiful,  but crowded
reviews.text: The beach is absolutely beautiful here, but can get really crowded. Hard to find a quiet spot where boats aren't blaring music.

reviews.title: Awesome
reviews.text: Like the pictures... a huge swimming pool... beautiful, amazing unexplainable... highly recommended! Enjoy

reviews.title: Super clean beach.
reviews.text: Clear water, you go in and don’t want to come out. Not too crowded.  No evidence whatsoever of sea weed.  No big waves to worry about and easy in and out of water, even for 81 year old like me and the wife.

reviews.title: Fantastic!
reviews.text: We spent 2 days of our 10 day vacation in the Cancun area on Playa Norte (North Beach) on Isla Mujeres. My family, including 2 teenage boys, had a great time on both visits. The beach is beautiful, the water is calm, colorful and warm, and the sea views and sunsets are amazing. Although mostly on the rustic side, there are plenty of places to rent lounge chairs and umbrellas, to eat and drink, and to shower and use the bathroom. The beach was full and vibrant both days we were there; so, if you're looking for a place that's quiet with few visitors or more on the upscale, exclusive side of things, you'll want to look elsewhere. We've visited several tourist beach areas around the world, including Ibiza, and all agreed that we enjoyed Norte Playa as well as any beach we've ever visited. Enjoy!

reviews.title: Great beach, bad atmosphere
reviews.text: Don't get me wrong, it's a beautiful beach. Blue, calm water and stunning white sand. But wow, SO many people. It was hard to really enjoy the beach as there are just so many people on the beach and in the water that you get a bit claustrophobic. Would probably skip this beach the next time we visit Isla and find somewhere a bit more relaxing elsewhere on the island.

reviews.title: Our nicest beach so far in MX
reviews.text: Love this place. Busy, vibrant and great for people watching. Loads of gin palaces rock up each afternoon for offshore parties. Grab a sunlounge, a bucket of beers and have a great time!

reviews.title: Best calm water beach on earth
reviews.text: We consistently come to Playa Norte for the calm turquoise waters that you can walk out to and no current.  The people watching is great and there is plenty of space to bring your beach chairs.  Bathrooms on site as well as several beach restaurants.

reviews.title: Visit for the party atmosphere not the serenity
reviews.text: I have come to realise that Australia has the best beaches in the world for beauty & serenity. Now this beach is very different, there is not much sand. Its like a skip & a jump from the bars into the green clear water. Im not used the this (think Bondi or Manly). On that sand is alot of squashed in sunbeds (these dont exist in Australia, we use towels). The sand is not white like in Australia, there was no silica noise when you walk across it, its more off white sand (lower in silica). Now in the beautiful green calm water is 50 party boats playing loud music. I did a boat tour & found the water more stunningly beautiful (clear green) from the boat (away from the hoards of sunbeds & people).  Im glad i visited as this beach is very different to what ive seen before: green water, party boats, sunbeds, heaps of people & bars.

reviews.title: Best beach in all of Cancun
reviews.text: The water, sand and atmosphere on the North end of the island is match no where else.  No seaweed, clear water and nice white sand. The chair side service was excellent. The drinks were big and well worth the cost. It is a very busy beach area since it is the best so be prepared to get there early or not get a chair.

reviews.title: Best Beach
reviews.text: We've come before, and this is the image people imagine - palm trees, beach chairs, and palapa restaurants that deliver food and drinks you.  Water is clear and has very shallow shelf beach.  Yesterday I heard someone say what we were a thinking - I'm standing in a postcard.

reviews.title: Nice beach
reviews.text: It’s a lovely beach definitely, clear water and nice sand. However it’s sooo busy, busy with people and busy with boats. Trying to snorkel to see fish is difficult when there’s loads of people trying to see the same thing. It was good but not as great as I’d expected! The sea is also roped off at a certain point so it stays very shallow, not enough o swim in.

reviews.title: Always a great time!
reviews.text: I’ve been coming here for years and it is just as gorgeous and fun each time! Great place to spend the day relaxing and splashing in the crystal clear water. Look forward to my next visit to Isla Mujeres - one of my favorite places in Mexico.

reviews.title: Top
reviews.text: We love this beach.  We love this part of Isla Mujeres.  We love the beautifull sea, the people. What a Nice place. Beware of yellyfish

reviews.title: Beautiful but has it's drawbacks
reviews.text: Me and 2 friends were there in Jan 19.  The beach is, of course, beautiful as all beaches in the Yucatan are.  The water is nice and still.  There are plenty of beach chairs to be rented and food service to your beach chair.The drawbacks are as follows:1. The beaches are crowded2. The water is shallow3. The swim area is roped off and never allows swimmers to get in water over 5 feet (1.5 meters) deep.4. There are lots of boats anchored just outside the swim area blasting loud music.If that is your scene, then this is a great place for you.  I prefer a less crowded beach that allows me to actually swim and not just wade.  Please don't rope me off from the sea that I love so much!

reviews.title: Great Beach
reviews.text: Playa Norte is one of the nicest beach we've ever seen. We started coming here in 2008. It has changed since....much busier now. But still the beach has one of best powdery sand and it never gets hot. You can be walking on it at hot temperatures and your feet won't burn. Love Playa Norte 💕

reviews.title: Stunning beautiful an more
reviews.text: Beautiful beach 🏖 very busy now in comparison two three years ago Full of bohemian beach bars very comfortable an relaxed part of the island 🌴

reviews.title: Best beach on Isla
reviews.text: It’s the best beach on the island. It’s also the most crowded. Shallow clear water draws people not only from the island, but also from Cancun. Lots of boats stop there also. Worth a visit.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach!
reviews.text: One of the most beautiful beaches I have visited!  The water is so clear and clean and no seaweed! Sand is amazing!

reviews.title: Beautiful sunset
reviews.text: Beautiful beach with plenty of beachside bars for a cold beer while you watch the sunset. Close to the "hustle and bustle" of downtown Isla Mujeres.

reviews.title: Do not miss
reviews.text: This is the most beautiful beach I’ve been to. Light, powdery sand, turquoise water that you can see through to the bottom. Go early if you want to avoid the crowds from Cancun.

reviews.title: Beautiful white sand beach
reviews.text: Beautiful beach but it does get busy. We stayed at Playa Arena. They have full service bar and food on the beach with chairs and umbrellas. It's not the U.S.A so you'll need to wave a waiter down to order. They don't bother you. You'll also need to ask for your ticket to pay.

reviews.title: Incredible
reviews.text: The best beach in Isla MujeresLike a mirror, calm water, incredible turquoise color, you can see the bottom of the see, transparent and clean.Never seen sea like this....

reviews.title: Gorgeous Beach!
reviews.text: The public side is actually less crowded than the resort side, and we had a great time. There are guys who will help with chairs and shade for a fee...the $15 USD for umbrella and chairs was reasonable.There was a little bar close by - don't remember the name, and the drinks were reasonably priced! You have to get a key from the guy to use the restroom across the street, but that was easy. You MUST go to Playa Norte. Clear water, white sand, one of ou r favorite places!

reviews.title: Disappointing, dirty, unpleasant, avoid
reviews.text: This was our first visit to Isla Mujeres and we had heard good things so were curious to visit. We took the ferry which was actually the one saving grace of the trip as it was modern and efficient. When we arrived the first thing you notice is the mopeds and diesel golf carts buzzing up and down and the associated smell of diesel fumes. The streets are clearly not cleaned with much regularity as from the terminal to the beach (about ten minutes) there were spilt drinks, food etc all festering in the sun. Arriving to the beach itself, the sand is very nice and the beach itself is clean. There were a few groups of drunk locals hanging around, barely able to stand, which again does not match the image we had in mind. The water fills with fumes and diesel from passing boats, making it quite unpleasant. Lastly but worth noting is that bathrooms are not provided, although the Pemex has one at a cost of ten pesos, the restaurant toilets are for patrons only. I found the local businesses on the whole to be unfriendly and only interested in getting your money out of you, which given what is clearly a soulless tourist trap, should be more than expected.There are far nicer places to visit on the riviera maya, and at $300 for foreigners this is an expensive way to get shaken down by hostile locals in a dirty seaside village.

reviews.title: Best beaches every!!
reviews.text: Took our family this year, our kids had a blast playing in ocean and building sand castles!!  Only complaint would be all the boats that dock just out side of the swim rope.  Water is amazing blue and they work hard here to keep it clean on the beach.  Amazing.  4th year to go to this location, love it.

reviews.title: Best beach ever
reviews.text: The water is so blue it makes the sky look pale, the sand so white it doesn't get hot in the sun.  Drinks and food are easy to get, just bring cash and sunscreen.  My new absolute favourite beach ever.

reviews.title: If I had known about this gem
reviews.text: I stayed in Cancun and went to Isla Mujeres/Playa Norte for the day. I instantly fell in love. I realized this was what I needed to celebrate my 50th birthday. I traveled alone to Cancun. I will say there are tons of beautiful places in Cancun. But nothing like this beach. I was hypnotized by the beautiful. I met a lot of nice ppl in a matter of a few hrs. If you go please stop by the garden bar restaurant right up the street. Ana is a gem.... The food and service is top notch. Enjoy

reviews.title: Delightful day parked just off the beach
reviews.text: Had a beautiful day anchored just off the beach. The views are breath taking, water crystal clear and the people exceptionally friendly and accommodating. The services for the tourists are numerous,from bathrooms, cantinas, restaurants, taxi's etc everything is at your finger tips.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach
reviews.text: We spent 2 days just Lounging on the beach. Beautiful blue water. You may can find a less crowded beach, but we enjoy the activity.

reviews.title: My go to place in the Yucatan
reviews.text: I visit family in Cancun every year and going to Isla Mujeres is a must!  Its a quick 30 min ferry ride from Cancun. Nice golf carts/mopeds to rent. The island is gorgeous. I always enjoy swimming in the lagoon and eating great Mexican food at one of the cafes hidden in the neighborhood.

reviews.title: Nice beach ruined by chairs
reviews.text: Lovely beach but every inch covered by deckchairs. So much for public beaches!The water is clear and there was no sargassum when we were here. Not much marine life but nice for swimming.

reviews.title: Beautiful Beach
reviews.text: We spent a day here last week and was absolutely wonderful. When we first got there at 10am, there were very few people  on the beach. We rented chairs and umbrella from Coco's for $15/day. It was lovely until around 2-2:30 when it becomes a bit more crowded and the chairs fill up. The chairs are close enough that you really can't get between your chair and the person next to you.   You'll not find a more beautiful beach. It reminds me alot of Grace beach in Turks and Caicos and Eagle beach in Aruba. It's amazing how close the large freighters and barges get to shore ! Would highly recommend !

reviews.title: No question this is the best beach on the island!
reviews.text: There is absolutely no question this is the best beach on the island! The sand is incredibly soft and the water is unbelievable! Great place for couples to relax and or a family to enjoy.

reviews.title: Beautiful Paradise
reviews.text: While in Mexico we went Playa Norte twice. Beautiful  white sandy beach. A popular spot for pleasure boats and big yaughts. Rent a chair and umbrella on the beach for 300 pesos each person  but if you eat and drink that much it is free at the Mayan Beach Club. Our favorite  spot to be in Mexico! Now I know why it has been voted by Trip Advisor as one of the top beaches in the World.

reviews.title: A bit crowded and noisy when we were there but worth it.
reviews.text: Our forays to Playa Norte (North beach) found it to be crowded and noisy. Maybe we didn't find the best parts of it? It was beautiful though.

reviews.title: Celebrating early birthday
reviews.text: Playa is a beautiful beach by Isla mujeres we took a tour the cost was $70 I spoke to people when I was in the line to aboard the boat she bought it for $50 when were at the Port they asked us if could upgrade for $40each and you get a boat with less people we were only 10 but I wouldn't do it not much of a difference you get the same buffet and they took us to the same place that the other boat will take you. It was nice they stop by playa Norte for 15min n people were able to swim in the middle of that ocean, but they don't carry life jacket 🤔☹️.

reviews.title: Playa Norte
reviews.text: Excellent pristine water and white sand! Bring your water shoes and snorkel to maximize your experience. Vendors on the beach sell; cut fruits, nuts, sarongs, t shirts, hats, palm made baskets/purses, silver jewelry and beaded crafts. No sargasso! You can walk along the shoe easily. There is the option of staying on the public beach section for free or stay at a beach club that offers clean bathrooms, beach bed and umbrella. Prices range so choose accordingly! Bring zinc sunscreen so you don’t contaminate the water. Playa Norte/North Beach is a beach lovers paradise! 😁❤️

reviews.title: It’s ok
reviews.text: You have to get to the beach early to avoid crowds of people. The beach is large and the sand is wonderful but it’s covered in beach chairs, which would be nice, but you have to rent them. If you don’t want to pay for a chair there is only small areas of sand you can use. Aside from that, the water is crystal clear, no seaweed. And there are a to. Of amazing restaurants within walking distance. Can’t go wrong with any of the food.

reviews.title: Dinner at Playa Norte
reviews.text: Tonight we comes at Playa Norte.Ordered an appetizer of pork rolls. In mango sauce......very tasty!Entree: blackened red snapper...very nearly presented and tastyDrinks:  Palomas and draft beerThe view and the sunset were fantastic!!Great meal!!  Great day!

reviews.title: Stunning!!!
reviews.text: Very beautiful clear water and clean beach. Nice and shallow so you can walk far into the water. Also water was very calm. I was staying in riviera maya in Mexico where the sea was just full of seaweed so was nice to go to a clear beach.

reviews.title: Amazing beach
reviews.text: This beach is so beautiful. The water was amazing. It is a must if you’re visiting the island. We stayed in a hotel right on the beach and I wouldn’t have had it any other way. I will definitely be coming back.

reviews.title: Beautiful experience!
reviews.text: If you are visiting Mexico I highly recommend booking this excursion! Beautiful beach, soft sand, great food, warm water and lots to see.  Also, rent a golf cart and book the guided tour as it is well worth the money and a great chance to see the sights and learn some interesting history of the island.  We traveled on The Big Chill to the island. Excellent staff, tour guides, information, and  tips. Overall, wonderful experience!

reviews.title: great place to catch the sunset
reviews.text: this beach has a ton of locals and some nice bars and restaurants.  It's great place to catch the sunset and spend the whole afternoon.

reviews.title: Beautiful but touristy
reviews.text: Beautiful beach with a lot of people. You can still find a quiet spot for yourself. Right in the middle of the playa there's a place where some guys blast music. Bad music. I think if you stay close by you might get a brain damage :)

reviews.title: Words can’t say enough! So beautiful!
reviews.text: 3/17/19 - 3/24/19Hands down this is the most beautiful beach we have seen in Mexico thus far! The water is so pretty! Seaweed doesn’t hang around long; we only saw it early morning and by the afternoon it was gone. We enjoyed multiple walks along the beach of Playa Norte. So so breath takingly pretty! ❤️ There’s enough room for everyone!!

reviews.title: golf cart ride down to Playa Norte
reviews.text: This beach was extremely crowded. Vendors and tourists were everywhere. Beach looked beautiful. If you like crowds this is for you if not stay at your hotel and swim in the pool or do like we did get a hotel down near punta sur and enjoy the tranquility and stay on the south end of the island.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach
reviews.text: Unbelievable postcard beach ... One of the nicest beach’s I’ve ever seen plus there’s great food options and beach clubs to relax while you’re enjoying the view ...

reviews.title: Way too crowded!
reviews.text: The water and beach are both beautiful, but there are hordes of tourists, expensive too close together rental lounge chairs, and too many boats in the water. I went there several times and turned away each time due to the crowds. Stay away--it's not one of the beat beaches in the world, even without the crowds. I could name a dozen beaches that are far better!

reviews.title: Exquisite beach!
reviews.text: Prettiest beach in the world! No pesky, annoying seaweed, to deal with! Beautiful with swing bars, no bars, and lots of sights!Enjoy the sunsets and cocktails which abound day and night!

reviews.title: Busy and Boring
reviews.text: Best advice is to stay to the South of Playa Norte. Too many boats to get a view and too many tourists.

reviews.title: Beautiful Beach
reviews.text: The family loved the beach.  The water was beautiful and refreshing on a hot spring day. It was very crowded for a random Wednesday in May.  I can only imagine it gets much worse during peak times.

reviews.title: looks like photos
reviews.text: nearby restaurants, beach clubs, areas for massage, chairs, umbrellas and mattresses for Pay, though it is a public beach. Safe for kids as the water is clean and shallow.

reviews.title: Main beach
reviews.text: Very crowded but it is still nice and it is easy to rent little beach-bed or just lay under a palm tree.

reviews.title: White Sand Beach and Easy Access
reviews.text: Perfect beach for families, kids, even serious swimmers. Water is warm and calm. Try Green Demon for tanning beds or chairs, food, and a relatively quiet place to enjoy the beach for the day.

reviews.title: It is indeed one the most beautiful beaches in the world
reviews.text: We had an amazing time. The only place my father in law got in the water. The color is out of this world and we had the most amazing time. We wish we hadn't waited to go until the day before we left so we can fit in another trip. Definitely get there in the mornin to get a good spot on the beach!

reviews.title: Beautiful Beach but Very Crowded
reviews.text: We had the luxury of checking out Playa Norte on Isla Mujeres a few weeks ago and it truly is beautiful.  We went later in the day (around 3:30 P.M.) in hopes to miss some of the crowds we had been warned about.  It was still pretty crowded with alot of construction in the immediate vicinity.  The water was crystal clear and the sand was white and soft.  If it wasn't so crowded I would have given it 5 stars.  I would check it out if you're on the island.

reviews.title: Fantastic water, sand, and atmosphere!
reviews.text: Amazing azur blue colored waters, palm trees all over, great strip of restaurants nearby, and best atmosphere ever in general! I strongly recommend this place. It was just amazing <3

reviews.title: It was like spring brake
reviews.text: The beach was over crowded with people.  If u want a calm nice beach avoid playa Norte and look for a smaller beach out south.

reviews.title: over rated
reviews.text: This appears to be the place everyone wants to go, so it was very crowded later in the day.  Early morning is the time to go.  It's a very beautiful beach and very gradual sloped bottom.  You can wade out for 100 yards.  But, the chairs and umbrellas are either private or you have to rent, and they are very close to each other.  I think it's a place you can say you've been - but I have no desire to go back.

reviews.title: Clean beach with turquoise water
reviews.text: Spend a half day in the beach. Very clean, no seaweed, clear turquoise water. Many restaurants,bars and massage places around.  If you walk further towards Mia hotel you can find Il Segreto, smaller beach with shallow and calm waters ideal for families with small kids

reviews.title: Beautiful beach!
reviews.text: Calm waters, crystal clear, white powdery sandy beaches with numerous options involving restaurants/bars

reviews.title: Over crowded beach with wall to wall boats of day trippers just off shore
reviews.text: This is probably the most beautiful beach I have ever seen in terms of sand and water, HOWEVER, I was just shocked at the hoards of people, boats in the water, beach umbrellas and lounges crowding the beach and loud music everywhere. To be fair, we stayed on Isla  Mujeres over spring break in March but after reading the glowing reviews for this area i was very disappointed. The shops are expensive and the sales people quite aggressive. We did have some good meals with good service in Playa Norte but as mentioned by others, the prices are high.

reviews.title: beautiful
reviews.text: You really can't beat the beauty of Playa Norte. The sand is something you dream about. The water is crystal clear.

reviews.title: Picture perfext
reviews.text: Absolutely breathtaking beach with fine white sand. You can rent chairs or umbrellas or simply lay your towel in the sand. Lots of vendors walking by to offer a cold beverage or you can order if you are renting a chair. It’s only a short walk from Calle Hidalgo.  Perfect spot to chill and enjoy a swim!

reviews.title: Best beach on Isla Mujeres!
reviews.text: Big white beach with sparkling waters. Easy access for kids and very shallow. Lots of beach bars and music during the day. Sometimes the tourist boats can get a bit much... have a cocktail at green demon!

reviews.title: Beautiful Beach
reviews.text: The most beautiful beach BUT sun beds will cost more than you expect and they pack you in like sardines. Take supplies as island is expensive.

reviews.title: Busy Busy Busy!!!
reviews.text: Great awesome beach!  Perfect for the little ones, but a bit too busy for me!  If you sit in a chair, someone will come by and request money, so be prepared or park your butt in the sand!

reviews.title: All about the water!
reviews.text: The most beautiful, turquoise water I've ever seen. The beach is sugar white, and the water is calm and clear. You can wade out to your neck and see your toes! Plenty of beachside lounge chair/bed rentals...usually the connecting restaurant asks you to spend a certain amount of money, but, it's always reasonable. You don't have to use the lounge chairs. Plenty of people bring their beach towels and lay out in the beautiful sand. I cannot recommend this beach highly enough.

reviews.title: Great place to relax and enjoy one of Mexico's best beachs
reviews.text: The water is crystal clear and a nice 82 degrees make and calm. Not a lot of wave but enough for you to enjoy the pristine setting and of course there's great restaurants and bars all around you. Great day trip stop on your visit ti the enchanted island tour.

reviews.title: Stellar
