reviews.text: One of the nicest beach areas I’ve been to. Great stretch of fine white sand and calm warm water. A great place for a cold drink, some food and scenery. Some of the finest boats around come to spend the day. Makes a nice walk early in the morning.

reviews.title: Beach vacation
reviews.text: Leave Cancun and get a place here if you go in April. It is quieter, cleaner, and has a beautiful beach if you go all the way to the end on the north side.

reviews.title: HEAVEN
reviews.text: Why do people go to the Caribbean when you can go to Isla for a fraction of the price.  Don't want to let the secret out but the best island in Mexico after about 15+ trips.

reviews.title: Beautiful
reviews.text: The beach is so beautiful. Beautiful blue waters and white sandy beach. Its has plenty of beach bars and restaurants. Weekends it does get very crowded as locals from Cancun plus tourists are there. You can rent beach chairs and umbrellas or bring your own. My hotel was on the beach so I would swim and then go and lay by the pool where it was much quieter. You can swim, sun, eat drink and shop it's all there.

reviews.title: amazing
reviews.text: It was sooo pretty. Can't wait to go back. Bring a float. It's the only thing we didn't think we would need but the water is so clam.

reviews.title: Too many people
reviews.text: And the irony that I’m one of them isn’t lost on me! What is a beautiful beach long beach with soft white sand surrounded by palm trees is spoiled by so many folks (there are stretches of beach where spotting sand between the logjam of loungers is almost impossible). And looking out you are confronted by an armada of day tripping boats hugging the waterline. However early morning and late afternoon after many of the Cancun holidaymakers have gone back to their all inclusive cocoons you can still see the magic underneath all of the kitsch.

reviews.title: North Beach
reviews.text: We have been here many times. This is the first time we found it a little to crowded to enjoy. Lots of boats coming over from Cancun and dropping their guests off for the day. They have put so many tables and chairs out on the beach that you have to rent for the day, it was hard to find a spot that we could set up our chairs for the day. :( It is a most beautiful beach that we have enjoyed coming to for over 20 years, we must have just hit a busy time. We’ll definitely return!

reviews.title: Amazing!!
reviews.text: I kept hearing about how this is one of the most amazing beaches in the Caribbean and that was a lie. I think that it is one of the most amazing beaches in the world!! Isla Mujeres is one of my favorite destinations top 3 for sure, and playa norte is a huge part of that.

reviews.title: Way too busy, felt like a crowded public pool.
reviews.text: Water was beautiful of course but so ridiculously crowded. Rows and rows of bathing beds all crammed together. Not an inch of sand free for public use. Beaches are free in Mexico but the attendants look down their noses at you if you don’t take them up on their persistent offers to hire a bed. We just wanted to take a quick dip and found it quite unpleasant. Maybe we are spoilt as in Australia beaches are both free and free from sales harassment.

reviews.title: Crowded but beautiful
reviews.text: Definitely the fun beach to visit while on Isla Mujeres! Pristine waters, white sand, palapas, lounges, bars, restaurants, music and crowds of people  - it is all happening here! Avoid if you are trying to get away from it all

reviews.title: Beautiful, cool white sand
reviews.text: Beautiful cool white sand. Pick a beach club and relax. Great for swimming. Smooth, white sand. So very clean.  Beautiful blue waters and gentle waves.

reviews.title: Playa Norte
reviews.text: Great beach early morning until about 11:30am when it becomes a bit crowded. My husband and I enjoy the area near Green Demon. We order Guacamole, chips and yummy smoothies there.

reviews.title: Busy but beautiful
reviews.text: We had a great time on this beach, though I think you will find less busy parts of the island with equally as nice beaches. We had chair and umbrella tickets from our hotel for here though. There is a great spa, Spa Leidy right behind where we were sitting that was amazing! $35 USD for one hour I had Venesi and my fiancé had Danielle and those girls know what their doing!!

reviews.title: Must visit when in Mexico
reviews.text: Playa Norte is voted as nr 7 best beach in the world and I can understand why! Soft white sand, beautiful turquoise water that is crystal clear and not deep. Very kidfriendly but also great for couples or solo travellers. Very chill out and romantic vibe. Several beachclubs on this north part so you can choose which one you like. I can recommend Oceanvs, right next to Mia Reef. Beds are 200 mxn per bed with large parasol. Free for hotel guests of hotel NaBalam.

reviews.title: Love Isla Mujeres
reviews.text: We had a wonderful stay.  Would highly recommend this to anyone!!!  Gorgeous, Beautiful, easygoing.  We will be back!!

reviews.title: Relaxation paradise
reviews.text: Great vacation with our teenage daughter and toddler son.  Hard to find a place that has activities suitable and enjoyable for both but Playa Norte is perfect since the beach is immaculate and the water pristine and calm so both kids could enjoy it!  The women who clean/rake the beach each morning are dedicated to making this beach beautiful which is amazing given how many tourists visit it each day!

reviews.title: Busy Beach...even in the Spring
reviews.text: This beach was lovely but very busy. I had never been to a beach where you had to walk over others to get to where you wanted to go. It was a gorgeous beach. Just a little too busy for my taste
Great place. Better than the mainland. Great beach side restaurants and bars. Grab a golf cart and explore.

reviews.title: LOVE THIS BEACH
reviews.text: Next to the beaches of Tulum, this is my favorite beach on the Yucatan Peninsula.  The North end of the 'Island Of Women' is spectacular.  I love to just wade out into the water, for what seem to be forever, and I am still in chest sea and more than 100 yards from shore.  The beach seems to always have a fun, eclectic group of tourist from a cornucopia of countries that make for interesting conversations and mingling ... very cool place indeed.  Cheers.  JMAC

reviews.title: It’s getting too crowded but it’s still beautiful
reviews.text: I’ve been coming to Playa Norte for thirty years. It’s not the tranquil place it once was but it’s still beautiful. The water is out of this world and the sunsets are legendary. There truly is no place like Playa Norte.

reviews.title: My favourite beach
reviews.text: Out of all the beaches i've been in the world this one is still my number 1. Yes it can get busy but the beach it's self is beautiful and if you got in the low season you can really enjoy it right. I love the sand, colour of the water, people selling fruit, jewelry, ice cream, you name it! it just has a great vibe with many beach clubs and fun bars to chill at for a bit or the whole day you never know;) My favourite thing to do is just lay on the beautiful sand with a beach towel and enjoy that sun:)

reviews.title: Not bad
reviews.text: Beautiful sand, but it’s roped off so you can’t go very far into the water. And of course half the sand space is taken by people renting umbrellas and tables. And you’re constantly harassed by people selling junk. Pretty crowded, even in March. Not a lot of Americans. More of a local vibe, which was great.

reviews.title: Boat music too loud
reviews.text: The beach is really crowded, the beds cost 200 peso and they pack the beds away at 5pm! The boat music is all day, each boat blasts out different music at the same time. Forget the island and go to Isle Holbox!

reviews.title: Beautiful!
reviews.text: Love this Beach!!  Went to the east side, and thought it was less crowded!! Brought our own beer, towels - went in for food. Ate on beach! Great day!

reviews.title: Absolutely perfect. I've never been to Eden, but has to be a close as it gets.
reviews.text: The most beautiful beach and water I've ever seen, and I've seen a lot. Fun and peaceful at the same time. Wear dark sun glasses, LOTS of beautiful "scenery," Lol  Visit the Green Demon and tell Korina her twin says "hola, bonita chica."

reviews.title: breath taking
reviews.text: I would recommend the Green demon for a great place to eat and lounge. Fresh food, friendly staff and best spot for the beach

reviews.title: Vacation
reviews.text: I’ve been to Isla several times. I absolutely love it. For me, the best time is after all the ferries have gone for the evening/night and it’s just us and the locals.   Unless you stay overnight at least a couple nights, you won’t understand how special this little island is. The expats who live there are very dedicated to respecting and helping the locals.  I’m way overdue for an Isla fix.

reviews.title: Nice beach, crystal blue water
reviews.text: Spent the day at Playa Nortw the first full day after arriving on Isla Mujeres.  What a great place.  Weather was wonderful, beach fabulous, and several places nearby to grab a drink or bite to eat.  Will plan to return before our trip back home.

reviews.title: Best beach on Isla Mujeres.
reviews.text: Chairs and umbrella available for rent. Also service from beach bar for drinks and food. Wifi available at beach bar.

reviews.title: Fantastic beach!!!
reviews.text: Just an absolutely gorgeous stretch of white sand beach and turquoise waters...Just like in the pictures you see as one of the 25 most beautiful beaches in the world!We visited in December and are already making plans this summer to go back again!Highly recommended if you're visiting the Cancun area!!

reviews.title: Fun place to people watch!
reviews.text: Really fun and great beach area.  Walk a bit before settling on a spot to get a chair and umbrella. Some will charge $20 each and some have a min $ amt to spend for the day.  Worth checking out if you aren't staying on that side of the island!

reviews.title: Over-rated , crowded beach. Not worth the hype
reviews.text: Many locals recommended Isla Mujeres as a beautiful beach. It was VERY crowded and NOT worth the crowded ferry, aggressive vendors and its just boring. We shouldve just stayed in Playa del Carmen. We enjoyed and had some drinks but i would not come back to Isla or even Cancun for the matter. Sorry but most people that come here are older, caucasian and not really looking for culture .. I MUCH prefer Mexico City

reviews.title: Nice Beach!
reviews.text: Spent an afternoon on the beach here last week after spending the morning driving around the island on a golf cart ...thankfully the sun came out! Paid a $20 fee for the beach club to use a chair, sugars, etc. beach was ok....Not sure how this was rated one of the top 10 beaches in the world that but still nice.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach and ocean
reviews.text: Great place to hang and swim. Yes a bit crowded and you have to pay for a lounge chair rental but that's the price of Paradise.

reviews.title: Beutiful beach
reviews.text: Beutiful beach , lovely sand superb blue water , really super for swimming. Lots of chairs to rent to sit on and some bars with good shade. It may be busy if you stayed here in a hotel, we stayed a little further away but could get here easily . One of the best beaches I have been too. I would have loved to have seen it years ago with very few people and less development.

reviews.title: BEAUTIFUL WHITE-SAND BEACH
reviews.text: I think this is the most beautiful white-sand beach in the Cancun area. This place is definitely worth the ferry trip to see and visit. The beach is so shallow that you can walk 50 meters in to the sea and the sea level is still around knee-high.

reviews.title: Beautiful sand and water
reviews.text: We visited Playa Norte while touring the island on a golf cart.  The sand is soft and white and the water colors and clarity are out of this world!  Families beware - not like a typical beach in the US...there was some exposure.

reviews.title: Playa Norte
reviews.text: Beautiful scenery, clean water, low tide excellent for children. Got to watch the sunset! Definitely an absolutely great experience!!! Want to go back!

reviews.title: Great beach
reviews.text: We absolutely lived on Play Norte beach while on Isla Mujeres.  Our hotel was nearby, so we wandered down to the beach, rented chairs and spent most of every day there.  The beach can get a bit crowded, so if you arrive early (before 10:00), you can reserve/rent beach chairs and secure a good spot.  There are plenty of bars, restaurants and vendors bringing good by so you don’t even need to get up if you don’t want to.

reviews.title: LOVE THIS PLACE!!!
reviews.text: I love Isla Mujeres. It is my favorite place to vacation!!! The North end is so beautiful, it's usually where we hang out most of the time when we visit.

reviews.title: Beach Bliss
reviews.text: This beach was stunning..the island is commercialized but not like Cozumel is...buggies,scooters and golf carts are everywhere. The beach was beautiful although a little congested. Loungers are available, sometimes with a little wait for one. Food purchased offsets costs and servers are ever present for drink or food orders. The ferry was easy to take from the pier. Worth doing

reviews.title: Beautiful Beach
reviews.text: it's a beautiful beach, but the tourism is ruining it. You can't even walk in front of the hotels because they have row after row of chairs out. It's a nice beach to walk, it's not rough at all. You do have to pay for the beds that are out there. They will hound you. Take your own drinks and chairs. and it's cheaper. We spent time here almost everyday.

reviews.title: Stunning!!!
reviews.text: What an amazing beach, beautifull white sand, crystal blue waters I have been to this beach many times during the past five years and it never dissapoints! Pictures dont lie and the laid back vibe of Isla is hypnotic.

reviews.title: Excellent beach for calm waves
reviews.text: This beach is really great. I only want to warn people than only enjoy fierce waters and playing with them that they will not find that here at all. This basically a pool set in the sea. Waves are so calm, sometimes you can brealy feel them, other times they rise but only barely. Other than that, it's beautiful and if you arrive before 11am, and specially before 10 am, you can enjoy the views almost by yourself, after that be ready to share... a lot.

reviews.title: Its a nice place but be careful how you organize your visit!
reviews.text: It is a cute island, and can be visited very quickly! Best idea to negotiate a deal with a cab driver that then will take you to 4-5 main important attractions. The turtle sanctuary is nice and the kids like it!Did not like the dolphine thing, seemed cruel for the dolphines! Overall an ok day trip!

reviews.title: This has to be one of the most spectacular beaches in Mexico
reviews.text: Every visit to the island we walk the beach at least once. The sand, water and view is fantastic. You can stop and enjoy a drink, get a fantastic massage, or just sit and gaze at the sights. As many times as we have visited I never tire of the view

reviews.title: Favorite spot in the Island
reviews.text: We always make sure to take a day trip to Playa Norte during our annual Cancun trips!  The amazing beach and calm water are good for the soul!  Find a place that rents loungers and umbrellas and settle in for the day.

reviews.title: Get a Golf Cart first
reviews.text: See the whole Island while You enjoy the beaches. The iguanas are on the move so keep watch. Enjoy your ride.

reviews.title: Wow!
reviews.text: This is an incredible beach with magnificent, clear water! So many food and drink options. Affordable chairs/umbrellas to rent for the day!

reviews.title: Relaxing
reviews.text: We spent three days on a row at the beach with a 3 and 7 year old. Hang at one of the beach clubs, grab a lounge chair and your favorite cold beverage and let your self relax.

reviews.title: Silver sands - delightful swim
reviews.text: Although a delightful swim - it is potentially so hot and sunny that you cannot stay in long. The beach is easily accessible.

reviews.title: One of the most beautiful places I’ve ever visited!
reviews.text: Very very very beautiful! Clean water, very white sand, an amazing vibe! I could see the sunset and was amazing.One of most beautiful beaches of the world. The prices of main street are a bit overpriced, so try the paralel street: Calle Guerrero.

reviews.title: One of the most beautiful beaches I've ever seen!
reviews.text: We've been to Isla Mujeres in both summer (when we swam with whale sharks) and winter (when the States are good and cold):  two very different experiences but one thing remains constant:  Play Norte is one of the most beautiful beaches I've ever seen!  For a quiet and laid back experience, consider spending more than just a day or two on this wonderful island and on this amazing beach.

reviews.title: It was Carnival and it was PACKED
reviews.text: I've never been to playa norte during carnival and would avoid it in the future.  it will always be a gorgeous beach but is hard to enjoy with so many ppl

reviews.title: Have to check it out!
reviews.text: Awesome beyond words! This beach is so beautiful! But with beauty does bring crowds. We stay at the opposite side of Playa Norte but love to stop by and just visit!

reviews.title: Top 3 beaches of all times
reviews.text: Almost unreal how nice this beach is, and you can visit and stay very inexpesively. Crystal clear waters, calm, white sand, cold beers, etc.....

reviews.title: Stunning
reviews.text: The beach is stunning with crystal clear waters. Does get very busy though as very popular for day trippers. If visiting Isla Mujures is a must. Good bars surrround beach beach for food and drink

reviews.title: Wonderful beaches
reviews.text: The best beach I have been too.  I will definitely go back.  The water was turquoise and nice white sand.  I can see why it was #9 for best beaches.

reviews.title: Isle of Mujeres
reviews.text: Beautiful, clean and friendly Island. Water is breathtaking!! Did an afternoon trip to this lovely place. Rented golf carts and did some exploring. It’s a great little trip from Cancun.

reviews.title: Excellent beach, amazing water!
reviews.text: The sand is like flour and the water is as clear as you can imagine, you can see a long way out! We were there in early March and all the places we found charged a fee for chair and umbrella use. It was very busy and the boats that tie up along the buoys to party crank their tunes so you are sure to be part of the parties! That was annoying but the water is amazing and clear!!

reviews.title: Best white sand Beaches
reviews.text: Playa Norte was a beautiful surprise for me. I had not experienced the beauty of the Yucatán area and Isla Mujeres. I was not disappointed. I would definitely come back

reviews.title: Amazing!
reviews.text: We almost never go back to a vacation spot, we just prefer to have new experiences, but we are definitely going back there!

reviews.title: Great Way to Spend a Day!
reviews.text: My wife and adult children and spouses spent two days on Playa Norte. We rented loungers for $150 pesos each in front of Chimbos and got great service from their staff. Would highly recommend!

reviews.title: Amazing Beach!
reviews.text: This is by far one of my more favorite beaches.  The water is so wonderful, and the views breathtaking.  If you have a chance, make sure you catch the sunset!

reviews.title: One of my favorite places on this planet
reviews.text: Playa Norte is absolutely stunning. The water, the sand, the sun. There is not one bad thing I can say about this place. I highly recommend it.

reviews.title: Not much fun any more
reviews.text: Sorry to be a bummer but the crowds have gotten too big and there are to many people trying to sell you things  This used to be a cool place to hang out. If you go a little more towards the west it's not quite as bad. It's usually pretty crowded and chair to chair.

reviews.title: A piece of paradise !!!
reviews.text: If you want to spend a day at the beach with crystal clear water and white sands this is the place you have to go.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach
reviews.text: Lovely but the beach chairs are too pricey. Nice and clean and great sand and facilities. Plenty of beach restaurants also.not Rocky either

reviews.title: Great beach, ask for Jorge to get your chairs and umbrella.
reviews.text: We visited three times during our trip and we loved it. It is not cheap but you can rent chairs, umbrellas and also get buckets of beer, mixed drinks, tacos, cigars, etc. We used Jorge every time and he took very good care of us. The beach is beautiful. Do not visit the island without visiting this beach.

reviews.title: Vacation spot
reviews.text: Beaches were crowded, the views were fantastic lots of restaurants & bars close by, great shopping close..

reviews.title: A different beach experience for us.
reviews.text: We were used to beaches in Mexico where you select a beach restaurant and they set up the chairs and table and expect you to stay and buy all day along with numerous vendors selling every imaginable.  Here, you pay for the chairs, and are not bothered by anyone.  They have food and drink, but you have to make contact with them for service.  The sand was spectacular, white and find.  The water was relatively calm, and the beach was great for walking and people watching.

reviews.title: Heavenly!
reviews.text: It’s a beautiful beach with azure waters and pure white sand. The loungers are rented for $200-$300 pesos, however you can bring your own towel and just chill on the beach. We rented a cart and rode around the whole Island. Playa Norte  was the highlight of our Isla Mujeres visit.

reviews.title: ISLA MUJERES
reviews.text: I was on this beautiful island 12/18 for the second time.  I will go back again ... love it!  If you want a place to stay at a place with a beautiful view, check out Casa Cural y Galería Isla Mujeres!!  OMG!!!

reviews.title: Sugar soft sandbars and salty kisses
reviews.text: The north side of this tiny island is where locals and tourists come together to worship the sun!  The best time to visit is early or late in the afternoon when the tourists and catamarans have either not arrived yet or already left.  During the peak hours this area will be crowded so make an effort to outlast this so you see some amazing (AMAZING) sunsets here, so stay longer and watch the sun set for the day.  The entire beach hugs a very wide sandbar that stretches all around the eastern tip of island, where you can snorkel and see little fish in the laguna.

reviews.title: Best beaches and ocean access
reviews.text: Playa norte must be on the top 10 list for most beautiful beaches! The soft white sand is cool to walk on.  The ocean is easily accessible, and not deep.  There's a huge sandbar by the Mia hotel, and it's shallow enough for kids to sit on . . . Just be careful on windy days as the current can get strong.  The water was very warm in the shallower parts, and the most beautiful blue/turquoise color.  We went to Tuturreque and paid 250 pesos per person for a chair, umbrella and table, and it went toward food and drink consumption.  For around $14 USD, we thought it was a great deal.  Food was very tasty.  We h as d chicken nachos that was huge!  We also tried their salad, hamburger and chicken wings, and all were tasty.  It was fun eating on the beach.  Playa norte is very busy, which makes for great people watching. Many boats/yachts anchor outside the swimming area, and usually one or two has salsa music loud enough to enjoy on the beach.  There are vendors walking the beach, but they don't bother you if you're resting, and will quickly move on if you politely say no.  You can bring your own chair or towel and sit on the beach for free, but you won't have access to the bathrooms (which, at Tuturreque were VERY nice).  There are a lot of shops and restaurants in Centro, right behind the beach.  It's a great place to spend the day.

reviews.title: Beautiful Sand
reviews.text: North Beach on Isla Mujeras is very busy but one of the best beaches in Mexico. Having travelled extensively on both coasts of Mexico this beach could be our favourite. A channel used by Ferries, Sail Boars, and big power boats alike keeps everyone interested as they pss by no more than 150 feet from the beach. The beach itself has beautiful sand and the drop off in the water is very gradual and sandy. Beach chairs are approxiamately $20 Can for an afternoon (2 chairs). Your neighbors may be from France, Israel, or Norway as was the case for our 3 times visiting this beach. Although there are numerous hawkers of typical touristy items, they didn’t seem to be as aggressive as in other parts of Mexico. This beach is well worth a visit or three.

reviews.title: Getting worse every year....
reviews.text: Seems like every year the beach gets smaller, further emphasizing the number of people that are jammed on this beach.  This is further compacted by the large number of smokers on the beach....and I mean chain smokers...that ruin it for the non-smokers with the second hand smoke that drifts 25+ feet away from them....  I'm glad I was able to experience this beach 5-10 years back when it was one of the regions top beaches...

reviews.title: If you have a chance stay next to this beach
reviews.text: We stayed in Playa Del Carmen. We did not like the beaches there at all. We came to Isla Mojeres and to Playa Norte - it was great. go there do not think twice. We also went to Albatross beach on that Island - it is even nicer and more quiet.

reviews.title: An afternoon swimming at the North Beach
reviews.text: Truly one of the loveliest beaches on Isla Mujeres!if you bring your own towel, you can lie on the extremely fine sand beach and no one will bother you. Vendors will come by and attempt to make sales, but they are not in your face. The water is safe and protected and you can spend hours in it!

reviews.title: Busy but nice beach!
reviews.text: Sand was amazing, but don't look for "peace and quiet' here.  Nope. This is a "let's have beers and watch people" kind of beach.

reviews.title: yes it is a beatiful beach
reviews.text: we spent our first visit ever to isla at playa norte in front of the mayan beach club. if i had to do it all over again i wouldnt have changed a thing. thanks, t/a for guiding me down the right path again

reviews.title: Beautiful scenery
reviews.text: We did a day trip out to Isla Mujeres.  We rented a golf cart which you can drive around the entire island with.  I'll post a different review about our experience on the island, but keep this one focused on the north side of the island.We eventually made to the north side of the island, which made the trip worth it.  There's a small strip of sandy beach, but the rest of the north shore is rugged rock with big waves crashing on the rocks.  Absolutely gorgeous scenery.  It was rather windy, but there were very few people.

reviews.title: Nice beach but crowded
reviews.text: Playa Norte is located at the tip of isla mujeres. There are loads of restaurants and bars. There is also a lot of people there. If you are looking for a secluded and quiet beach then this is not it. A lot of foot traffic and music from various boom boxes and restaurants. The beach itself however is very nice with white sand and turquoise water. The lagoon is perfect for families with kids and since it's so shallow, it allows the the kids to explore and to be in the water without a parent.

reviews.title: Best beach ever!
reviews.text: If you come to Cancun and don't come here you missed the whole experience! This is true Mexico with amazing people and scenery!

reviews.title: Had to WALK on BOARDWALK! Beautiful View, but very crowded
reviews.text: We had to stop by and take a walk on the boardwalk and wade in... but it was too busy to stay. We took some pictures and took in the view, then headed out to explore the island!

reviews.title: The pictures say it all
reviews.text: This will rival anything including French Polynesia and it only takes just over three hours from the Mid-Atlantic need I say more

reviews.title: A lovely beach
reviews.text: This is the go to beach on Islam Mujeres. The water is clear and warm. There are many day beds you can rent and it is close to the bars and facilities. Because of it's popularity, parking is somewhat difficult. It's best to take a taxi or golf cart.

reviews.title: Most beautiful beaches
reviews.text: Had drinks on the beach at the beach club! Very attentive service from Gabby. Pina Coladas were the favorites amongst my crew!

reviews.title: The paradise exist
reviews.text: This beach is such amazing. The water is clear. You must visit Playa Norte and enjoy it. Drink some cold beers and relax

reviews.title: North beach
reviews.text: One of the best beaches around. White sand, crystal clear waters. The only problem is that it is crowded with tourists and day trippers from Cancun. I go to playa in the mornings and late afternoon when the crowds are less. The beach across from the lighthouse is not as popular with less people but great places to eat.

reviews.title: Really the only swim capable ocean water on the Isla
reviews.text: Extremely calm, wade out forever, watch where you locate or you could be 6 rows back, sometimes 3 minutes more walking is worth a whole bunch more

reviews.title: Love Playa Norte!
reviews.text: We love Playa Norte!  While there may not be as much beach frontage as there used to be, due to rentable beach chairs from the numerous beach clubs, if you walk far enough east it does thin out and there is ample room to find a spot to lay your towels on the sand.  We found good locations east of Buho’s, and in front of Green Demon.  What we like best about Playa Norte is how far out you can wade in the water and it’s only up to your hips and waist.  This cools you off nicely from the warm sand and sun, and affords for some great vistas.

reviews.title: What’s Not to Love
reviews.text: Popular and safe, we left our bags and shoes unattended at one specific tree every time we were there. Nothing was ever disturbed. The water is warm and shallow and very salty so even the sinkiest person can float and enjoy that sensation of weightlessness.

reviews.title: Awesome place
reviews.text: You will love this beach, is the paradise. We had nice time all days on this wonderful beach. The clear water, nice weather, cold drinks.

reviews.title: Spectular beach
reviews.text: The most beautiful beach.  The sand is like powder sugar!!  It's very clean.  No better way to spend the day!!

reviews.title: Perfect sand clear blue water
reviews.text: We want to go again, and again, and again!!!! We particularly enjoyed the beach near the Mia hotel and near the Coco Beach bar.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach, slightly deserted area on the north part.,
reviews.text: Walked to the beach from our hotel in town.  The beach circles around the island from the north to west side of the island. Not much for eating or anything else in the north part , so eat before you go there.  As you go toward the east part of the island, the beach gets more populated with restaurants and bars  Its a beautiful walk all the way along the beach to the ferry terminal - very picturesque.  I'd go back in a minute, although it is a bit touristy.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach
reviews.text: Took ferry over to Isla Mujeres for a day trip. The ferries are clean, quick and run frequently, and fare includes return.Playa Norte is a beautiful white sand beach with crystal clear azure water, that is shallow for a long way and no seaweed.It is an easy walk from the ferry, either along the main road or through the quaint narrow streets... just watch out for all the tourists driving golf carts or scooters!Each year we go back the beach is more crowded...but still worth the trip.

reviews.title: Overcrowded beach
reviews.text: This was w/o any doubt the quickest visit to a beach anywhere in the world. The beach was completely packed with loud people. Alright, the beach is completely white and the water has a beautiful blue color... But there is no relaxing feel at all. If you feel like having a quite and relaxing time at the beach, avoid this place and choose a more upscale hotel with private beach!

reviews.title: InFamous beach
reviews.text: Great water white sand lots of people having a great time. Music is a little loud at night when you're trying to sleep.

reviews.title: Pristine
reviews.text: Beautiful fine white beach and crystal blue water. Great snorkelling and breath-taking sites...could stay here!

reviews.title: Rated in Top 10 beaches of the World
reviews.text: Visited this place for lunch and a swim when I spent a day on the Island. Restaurant was fantastico with a fabulous host. The beach is great and the water is deep enough to have a great swim. Note, for small children it's also very good. There is no rip.

reviews.title: Heaven On Earth
reviews.text: The beauty of Playa Norte is better experienced than explained.  Having been on many beaches all over the world I would rate Playa Norte as one of the best.  Each day of our 7 vacation we walked the calm shallow waters of Playa Norte.  There are plenty of beach bars to stop for refreshments and/or snacks.  There are vendors who walking the beach as well with sarongs, bags, t-shirts, fruit, pastries, jewelry, hair braiding, massage, etc.  all were very respectful of a "no thank you".  There's no place i'd rather be!

reviews.title: Superb beach
reviews.text: Fine sand .  You can walk out quite a ways ( 100 feet ) and still be waist deep.  Waves aren't tough either. Couple hotels northwest corner are more crowded and jammed with beach loungers. Snorkeling on Northeast corner past the dock you can see by MiaReef

reviews.title: I can see why this one of the top 10 beaches in the world!
reviews.text: I can't say enough about the mind boggling blue water this beach brings.  Lots of chairs and umbrellas for rent around $600 pesos for 2 people.  Some establishments count food and drinks toward the chair rental so just order 600 pesos and they free, not hard to do.  I recommend the Mayan Beach Club!

reviews.title: Beautiful beach!  Safe to swim
reviews.text: One of my favorite beaches in the world!  Fine white sand, turquoise waters that are fantastic to swim in, gorgeous sunsets, beverages and food service on the beach, chair and umbrellas rental.

reviews.title: Absolutely beautiful beach
reviews.text: It has seen better days for sure, but it is still beautiful. Watch out for the party boats, they don't leave you much room to swim anymore. But we were there on a weekend so not sure what it may be like during the week.

reviews.title: 1 out of 2 spots you can't miss!!!!
reviews.text: The locations surround are probably the most beautiful in the whole Mexican CaribbeanThe watercolor is amazing, it is always warm,  It's shallow for some miles, Is is safe for the kinds since the ocean bottom is mostly flatIt keeps the island's environment in the around buildings, people are so kind in the restaurants, the location is so clean and so the people I saw in the times I have been there.The shapes of the sand related with the ocean changes often and this makes the location even more magical since you can come today and some weeks later and you can surprise!The restaurants are considerable expensive, anyway, Mexican beaches are free to transit and to choose a spot near to the water so you can bring your own stuff that you can buy in many convenient grocery stores in the city, make sure you buy them before arrivingRecommended place!

reviews.title: Very calm water
reviews.text: Beautiful and BUSY. 20 peso to use the bathroom. Nice to watch the ferry going by, lots of boats. Fine for a day trip.

reviews.title: beautiful beach
reviews.text: this is a beautiful beach with perfect sand and beautiful soothing water. the waves were small. there are chairs, tables and umbrellas you can rent (and I probably would next time if I planned to stay awhile because the sun was very bright and hot) but there were plenty of people just relaxed sitting on the sand. great spot for families.

reviews.title: Turquoise Water!
reviews.text: This beach is really nice! We were looking for the best beach in Isla Mujeras and we knew it was right off the ferry terminal. So we saw the first beach which was the central beach and started swimming there I thinking it was the best. Although we weren't completely impressed, we tried to act like we were. When we finished, we drove down more and saw this beach. When we saw the water, we felt so dumb for stopping at the wrong beach lol. But yes, this Playa Norte beach is extremely beautiful.

reviews.title: Leisure
reviews.text: Great Beach! The beach staff is super attentive. Drinks and food are reasonably priced. A must see when coming here

reviews.title: I'm hesitant...
reviews.text: But here goes. This is the best beach around. I understand in sharing this information, that next time I go it will have more and more people until it's no longer the magical place I now know. So stay away. 😉

reviews.title: Amazing day exploring the island
reviews.text: THIS IS A MUST DO if you are visiting somewhere on a resort in Cancun. We ended up going on the last day we were on vacation, but if we would have known hoe much fun it would of been we would of made a point of going atleast 2 or 3 times even. We rented a golf cart and just drove around the island, stopped at bars, shops and took in the breathtaking views from every angle.  The beach is rated one of the top 10 in the world so you can only imagine how beautiful the white sand is the the water is clear and aqua. The restaurants are good and the vibe is to be experienced at least once during your stay. We loved it and can't wait to go back. Highly recommended if you want a day away from the resort and would like to explore. We took a catamaran and we enjoyed that as well.

reviews.title: Beautiful Beach with Lots of Services
reviews.text: We didn’t spend the day on the beach, but walked all along the beach.  We stopped and had a few drinks and the best ceviche while watching the sunset. It was gorgeous!!

reviews.title: Beautiful Beach
reviews.text: If you like the beach you will love this one! Beautiful white sand and carribean blue water! Be sure to get a message on the beach. So relaxing.  We stayed in Cancun and took the ferry over for the day. Made me wish we would have stayed here instead. Next time for sure! We will be back!

reviews.title: Beautiful, white powdery sand
reviews.text: This is a nice beach about a 15 min. walk from the Ferry Station.  Easiest access might be from Miguel Hildgo Street (the pedestrian street).   If you are not a hotel guest, many of the hotels on the beach will rent you a lounge chair and an umbrella for about 100 pesos for the day.

reviews.title: SSSSHHHHHH don't tell everyone that we have found paradise!
reviews.text: SSShhhhhhh, don't tell everyone! This is clearly paradise....crystal soothing waters, sand that never gets hot to the feet no matter the degrees..actually it is coral, so it doesn't burn your feet like sand might when it gets hot..an easy swimming and snorkeling paradise..great for children as Playa Norte has a few areas that are shallow ( abut up to the waist) and fish galore....there is one side that is the bay side, and here you can wlk out quite far...if you walk to the tip of Playa Norte and around a bit, you will see a wooden bridge, swim under it to the other side and you will be in a cove where fish abound!!! a wonderful protective area....or simply lounge on the beach and watch the world go by. The water is the variant color of a turquoise and blue jeweled necklace...so come and jump in....bring the kids and the snorkel.....and don't mind me, but I will be daydreaming with my feet in the sand....sigh...

reviews.title: Won't be back
reviews.text: This is our 4th trip to Isla Mujeres.We have always loved it here,till this trip, we got back yesterday.This beach used to be so pretty Now it's wall to wall people not too clean and tons of tour boats just off the beach with more tourists. When we went we could barely find a spot to put our towel. There is another beach to swim and that's where we swam.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach
reviews.text: Always pretty.   White sand.  Beautiful blue water.   You can go out really far without it being very deep.

reviews.title: a lot of white sand and beautiful sunsets
reviews.text: We were there during the week a bit later the day and it was not too busy, so we liked it. It seemed like it got more busy on the weekend so, as day tourists from Cancun come over.I would recommend to watch sunset from here

reviews.title: beautiful
reviews.text: Very very pretty beach. Nice sand beautiful water, The only reason i give it 4 stars, way too many people when i was there. i much prefer renting a bike and finding a quiet place on the East side of the Isla.

reviews.title: Great beach!!!
reviews.text: You cannot find a more perfect beach than Playa Norte. Lots of sand and great swimming. There are lots of beach clubs too!

reviews.title: Busy beach
reviews.text: Nice in the morning before the hoards of day trippers descend. Everyone charges for sunbeds but the beach is free and usually tables and chairs are as well.

reviews.title: Gorgeous beach with gentle waters
reviews.text: This beach has soft white sand, turquoise water, and beach side restaurants that will happily lend you a lounge chair if you order a drink or food. The bay side was always calm for us if the other side was rough at all but the reef seemed to calm any big waves. Even my youngest snorkeled non stop and he is usually firmly planted in the sand!

reviews.title: Breath taking beach! It’s an island must!
reviews.text: This is one of my all time favorite beaches to visit in the Caribbean! I have been to many places and always find myself saying still love Playa Norte better.

reviews.title: Interesting and educational
reviews.text: Visit the turtle farm to learn about conservation on the island. I was worried about going based on some reviews. It’s not sad there at all.

reviews.title: Heartbreaking
reviews.text: It has taken me a year to bring myself to write a review for this place. We have been returning to Isla for the past 11 years, but no more. It has gotten so crowded and noisy that the lovely relaxed feel of this beach and entire island is lost. The last few years is completely out of hand. Our favorite restaurant - Velasquez was gone and in it's place a tourist shop. Many others are gone as well. High prices, huge crowds, unfriendly people have taken their place. Lounge chair and umbrellas cram every square foot. You must have a death wish to even cross the road over to the beach. The continued building around the beach has completely ruined this lovely place. So very sad

reviews.title: A Bit touristy
reviews.text: I found the north to be crowded, unfriendly and touristy. One sunset was enough for me. I prefer the beaches in the south.

reviews.title: The water is SOOOO CLEAR!!!
reviews.text: After swiming with shark, which per se is one of the most beautiful things I've done because the giant creatures can really show you the meaning of calm, we were taken to this beach, to relax some and to offer slack for those who got sea sick from the trip. It also gave us hope that we could find sargassum-free beaches near Playa del Carmen, where we were based.

reviews.title: Paradise Lost
reviews.text: As the song goes, "They called it paradise, I don't know why. You call some place paradise, kiss it goodbye". Sadly, so goes Playa Norte.  Over the past 25 years, the once tranquil stretch of white sand and turquoise water has transformed into a hectic sea of tables, umbrellas, rental chairs and people so thick they resemble ants on a melting candy bar.  During our visit to Isla last week, we took a walk along the north end streets and beaches. Overcrowded, noisy and chaotic are just a few words to describe what we encountered. What's left to enjoy? Umbrella tables blocked the view, vendors calling out for massages or chair rentals, people shoulder to shoulder, boats anchored offshore - a complete mess. Streets jammed with cars, golf carts and people.  The noise and hammering of new construction...  Hidalgo Street has become one endless food court filled with the masses of tourists looking for I don't know what.  I can't understand why anyone would travel out to this Island and actually spend a day here.  Sort of like sitting in the middle of a hot freeway. I hope something can be done to reverse this trend, but have serious doubts. Paradise lost:(

reviews.title: Best beach for miles around!
reviews.text: This is cleary the best beach in Isla Mujeres. It's flat, flat, flat and you can walk out into the water a long way and still be able to hold a beer. Really. You can walk wayyyyyy out and still have your chest above water. Which makes this a very popular and safe beach. And beautiful. It's all white sand. There are hotels that sit off of it and some beachfront bars. All very quaint and awesome. In fact, this beach is better than anything in Cancun. Believe me, I've been here dozens of times.

reviews.title: Best beach on the Island!
reviews.text: We stay on Playa Norte when we travel to Isla. It is by far the most beautiful beach with generally calm water and little seaweed. Although it is pretty shallow, still the best and seems like where the locals are as well!

reviews.title: Nice beach. too crowded.
reviews.text: Nice beach. too crowded. Way too many people for my taste and the boats get too near the beach. Water is crystal clear.

reviews.title: Best beach on island
reviews.text: This beach is definitely worth to visit. The water is cristal clear, the sand white and clean, the water very warm because of the flat access. There are coconut palm trees everywhere under which you can sit and relax. The bars and restaurants provide food and drinks of good quality for reasonable prices.

reviews.title: Don't kill the charm of Plaja Norte
reviews.text: Used to go twice a year in Isla Mujeres. Plaja Norte used to be a beautiful, wild beach with an amazing charm. Nice beach-bars, good music, a lot of things to do. This year we've been sad seeing this amazing beach full with umbrelas and chairs and beach-beds all along the beach. It is so wrong dear administrator of the beach, Municipal of Isla Mujeres. You bearly can step around Xchel Beach Hotel. The administrator needs to understand long run they will lose the tourists. The tourists who love Plaja Norte don't want the umbrelas, they want wild Plaja Norte. The money will not come from those umbrelas and beach-beds but from the bars and restaurants. By the way those are not even occupied at half capacity.

reviews.title: My favorite beach in Mexico
reviews.text: We only hang around the part at Mia Reef because that’s the absolutely most beautiful area. The other parts are just too crowded. But the area around the bridge is just amazing and even has a small bit of snorkeling. We walk down here every day of our trip just to get in the water a bit and then walk Playa Norte where all the beach clubs are located.

reviews.title: Lots of room whether you want to rent chairs or lie in the sand
reviews.text: Pretty soft beach, lots of lounge chairs/table and chairs with umbrellas available.  About $20 for the day.  BYOB or they have bar/restaurant service.

reviews.title: Great beach
reviews.text: Beautiful beach. Plenty of restraunts on the beach and places to shop or get a beach message. Not crowded

reviews.title: Excellent Beach!
reviews.text: The sand and water is breathtaking! The water is so clear that you can see the fish without any snorkeling gear! Must visit if you go to the island!

reviews.title: overrated beach
reviews.text: we went to isla mujeres for the day.  we were excited to go to playa norte.  when we arrived, it was around 11 am.  the  beach was already crowded and there were a lot of people in the water.  the beach was very crowded.  we rented 2 chairs for 300 pesos and it was worth it.  around 30 minutes later, there were no free beach chairs.if you don't mind the crowd, it is a great beach.  the water is shallow, clear and warm.

reviews.title: Beautiful
reviews.text: Lovely!! The most beautiful beaches. Crystal clear water....shallow and great snorkelling. A must visit for everyone.

reviews.title: Too crowded
reviews.text: Nice beach and landscape that unfortunately has become too crowded Difficult to relax there, too much noise and too many people

reviews.title: Not great
reviews.text: Very crowded, average beach for Mexico. You can get chairs for $100 pesos, Good is available but very average

reviews.title: Best beach of isla mujeres
reviews.text: It’s our second time on the isla. The first time we came was not that nice coz seaweeds were everywhere but this time was perfect. We stayed there for a week and the water was nice and clear.It was a paradise!!! We do recommend this beach if you have to visit isla Mujeres.

reviews.title: Gorgeous Views, Overcrowded
reviews.text: If your objective is simply to soak up the sun, this is your place. In spite of the beachfront service (you rent beach chairs in front of the restaurant of your choice and waiters will take care of you all day), the beachfront is overrun. Again, this is perfectly fine depending upon what you're looking for. I can't complain about the majesty of the beach. It is, no doubt, the most gorgeous beachfront on the island. Get there early to secure a good spot (9:00-9:30 am at least). Take a great attitude, and you'll be just fine. If you spend some time on Isla, opt for spending a bit more money another day, and find a private beach in order to truly unwind.

reviews.title: Beautiful - bring cash
reviews.text: One of the nicest beaches I’ve been to. Clear water, white coral sand, and plenty of places to stretch out an relax while enjoying food and drinks from one of the many beach clubs - BRING CASH, many do not take credit cards. It can get very busy during peak season. If that’s when you’re there: Get there early and secure a complimentary chair and umbrella at one of the beach clubs. Usually they will have a minimum order of approx $12+ per chair for you to sit there and order cocktails and food. If you are there later in the day and space is scarce, there are other beach clubs that will sell you a pair of chairs for $10-15 a pair. Not the best option but it’s there if everything is full during peak season. Another option is bring your own towel / chair / umbrella. Beach club food and drink vary widely so check reviews online. Highly recommend the Green Demon and Na Balam. Mia Reef Resort offers day passes with unlimited food and drink on a pristine, protected private portion of the beach on the NE corner of the island. Recommend trying for a day although doesn’t have the same vibe as the rest of Playa Norte (quieter, mainly hotel guests).

reviews.title: Fantastic Atmoshpere
reviews.text: Great place to hang out in the water and enjoy the day. The water is shallow for quite a ways out, and the boats anchor around the beach. There are bars lining the beach that always have good drink specials.

reviews.title: The best beach at Isla Mujeres.
reviews.text: Beautiful beach, great water activities and delicious food. A great place to relax at Isla Mujeres.If you can, it's better to visit during the week.

reviews.title: Best beach in Isla
reviews.text: Some of the clearest waters we have seen and beautiful beach for hotels, locals and tourists.  Spend an amazing day on a lounge or table side eat, drink and relax.  A must see.

reviews.title: Coco Massage AMAZING!!
reviews.text: We stayed at Villa Del Palmar I am paid $150 per massage at the hotel. We ended up taking a ferry over to Isla Mujeres and got massages on the beach. They were extremely nice, professional, and excellent masseuses. $30 A piece. We love them so much that we took a ferry back over the next day to get massages again. The next time we bought to one hour massages they gave both my husband and me a facial each included. I highly recommend skipping the mainland massages and going out to Isla Mujeres for a massage on the beach!!! They were absolutely wonderful!

reviews.title: Beautiful view
reviews.text: Beautiful view with palm trees, white sand and turquoise ocean. Nice and natural decorated bars. It was very crowded at this time of the year, however we swam at 10 am and it was better.

reviews.title: Elegy for Playa Norte
reviews.text: A figurative "paving" of paradise, Playa Norte is increasingly suffering from the same malaise as the rest of the once exquisite, but now crushingly overrun Isla Mujeres. Isla has always struggled with its proximity to Cancun, and the daily invasion of its hordes of all-inclusive day-trippers, the number of bracelets lined up their wrists attesting to the levels of all-inclusive benefits from their resorts across the water, traffic jams of hundreds of rented golf carts aimlessly circling the roads of the island driven by distracted and bored tourists who just need something to do, an abundance of near misses as carts drive up one-way streets--we actually witnessed a terrible accident as a golf cart driven by a tourist turned the wrong way onto a one-way street and collided with a local scooter sending the local scooter driver to the hospital and the tourist to the mid-island municipal police station for detainment and some serious payouts--the assault that is Hidalgo Street, meant to mimic Cancun for touristic tackiness, decibels, and clutter, the current and massive concrete development of condo/mall/timeshare development on Medina where the family-run Velazques used to be, and much more. Here's a narrative snapshot of the Playa Norte on an average day. With a gradualness that actually isn't so gradual, one cabin cruiser after another, one excursion boat carrying flocks of tourists after another, one booze cruiser after another, arrive and set anchor, crank their music to ear-bleeding levels, and ultimately form a flotilla, a naval blockade that runs the entire length of Playa Norte, so the view from the very few remaining available squares of beach uncolonized by the hotels and their bed/lounger/umbrella combos and beach bars is nothing but a sea of pleasure craft--upwards of 50+ on any given day--that arrive unfailingly and after a number of hours, depart back to the dubious pleasures of Margaritaville. Lest this be taken as a lament from a romanticizing gringo about the way things used to be or should be, it should be acknowledged that the development explosion is clearly a boon to the local economy, and one shouldn't begrudge people for wanting a piece of the action, some more than others of course (like the real estate barons benefitting from the new condo/mall under construction). Playa Norte...turquoise waters, crystal clarity, a warm, shallow and inviting sea, floury white sands, breathtaking beauty at one time, and now a beach city dominated by unrestrained, and it seems, unregulated commercial development. This beach is well and truly disappearing.

reviews.title: Beautiful, but.....
reviews.text: The fine white sand and aqua water make this a gorgeous (and surprisingly clean) destination. However, it is quite crowded and narrow. That would be doable, but a real shame that many of the large boats that anchor here daily and spill passengers from Cancun feel compelled to blast (bad) music at full volume.  Why come all the way to a small Mexican island to listen to Guns ‘N Roses at 10 decibels? A bit more peace and quiet would make this a paradise.

reviews.title: Love it every time!!
reviews.text: The beach is full of bars, spa services, hotels and vendors, The water is a beautiful turquoise color and you can walk out a long way before the water is up to your hips!! Every year the beach changes its shape and depth due to the winds coming in from the north and that's always interesting to see!!!!

reviews.title: Favorite spot on earth
reviews.text: Clear water, white sand, calm and you can walk like 200 yards into the ocian and the water level won't go beyond your chest.

reviews.title: Best beach in the Yucatan!
reviews.text: Water clarity is very good and a beautiful shade of blue.  Lagoon is 5 min walk.  Beach is clean and full of bars and massage places.  Too bad its become so commercialized.  Everywhere you sit, theres a different business claiming their rights to it.  The beach itself, it the best out of all the beaches in Playa Riviera.  If you're wanting to see the best water quality in the Yucatan, this is mosdef the beach.

reviews.title: A natural wonder.
reviews.text: Playa Norte shows up regularly on the lists of the worlds top beaches.  The beach clubs, hotels and city employees all cooperate to keep it clean and safe.

reviews.title: Beautiful but often windy
reviews.text: We stayed on Playa Mujeres for two days at the Hotel Ixchel right on Playa Mujeres. Loved the immediate beach access there. The beach is beautiful and you can rent two chairs for $20 USD or 300 pesos MX, with chair-side food/drinks service.This is a public beach so it gets very crowded.In the winter (Dec), it can get very windy as you are facing the open ocean from the northern tip of the island, which can be kind of annoying after a while and the water gets rough.

reviews.title: Cristal clear water whow
reviews.text: great beach with cristal clear water and white powder beach. There are some brestaurants - bars on the beach but you can get away from them as well is you like a bit more quiet

reviews.title: Paradise
reviews.text: Best place to relax.  Feel the breeze. Ether under a palm tree or under the sun. Wanna see some under water nature without snorkeling, this is the place.  Excellent for a ages.  There's energetic  waves or a nice calm spot to let the little ones have fun.  I'm telling you. You'll fall in love with Islam mujeres.

reviews.title: Playa Norte Great Beach for Sun, Fun and Friends
reviews.text: Spent a day here at Playa Norte as we always do when we visit Isla Mujeres.  We like the margaritas and food from the restaurant next to Na' Balam and we enjoy sitting under the umbrellas by the beach.  We usually walk down to the bar with swings and have a couple of beers before we check out some of the street vendors.  Always a great time!

reviews.title: 2 weeks of beautiful beaches and food
reviews.text: Went to the beach everday, a lot of beach clubs all with great food. Never had a bad meal service was impeccable.

reviews.title: Gorgeous beach!
reviews.text: My group took a taxi here and spent the day at the beach - it was very chill and we had a great time!

reviews.title: The views are really deceiving...
reviews.text: We went to playa norte expecting a huge, beautiful beach that was the gem of Isla Mujeres, but instead we wound up on a pretty tiny beach with a lot of junk on it. The photos (ours included) are pretty good at cropping that out. I would probably avoid heading over to see playa norte on future trips now that we've seen it once.

reviews.title: Amazing!
reviews.text: The sand is soft, the water is warm and you can walk out in the water quite far. There is not a lot of beach area (long and narrow) as compared to the central beach around the bend, but you are able to walk out a lot farther in the water. There are quite a lot of fish and you can watch the pelicans diving for them. We were here on calm, hot day and there were a lot of boats anchored outside the swimming area, but it still wasn't very busy on the beach. We also came on a very windy day, which made for a lot of fun jumping in the waves.

reviews.title: calm & clear waters and a less busy beach
reviews.text: Pay for a lounge chair on the beach and sit back and relax. You can stop at the local supermarket for snacks and drinks, or order things from the local beach restaurants.

reviews.title: Great beach
reviews.text: Best beach on Isla mujeres.  Soft sand, chairs and umbrellas for rent.  Food and bars nearby. Walking distance from the ferry. Locals hang out here.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach, soft sand, great people watching!
reviews.text: Beautiful beach, soft sand, great people watching! This beach has everything...great sunsets, nice massage tents, food, shopping, chairs to rent...I could go on and on!

reviews.title: Best beach on the island
reviews.text: This is a great place to go to hang out on the beach for a day. It's not far from the central market street of the island, and there are several beach bars to get food or drinks at (though I recommend packing a picnic). It's worth it getting there a little early and paying for lounge chairs & umbrellas, the sand is white and the water clear.

reviews.title: The beach on the whole island!!!
reviews.text: No need for anything here. Service, soft sand, music, people watching to the max and food just steps away. Lounge chairs, towels, massage...........hey what are you waiting for?

reviews.title: This is my favourite placein Mexico
reviews.text: We spent a week here, it was heaven. I love the island life. Highly recommend to anyone. It's nice that it's not as busy and touristy as other places on the mainland, seems like it's a popular mexican holiday destination for locals. Beaches were the best I've seen in Mexico. Water great, sand great, shallow waters!

reviews.title: Paradise!
reviews.text: My husband and I are staying in Cancun but spent a day zipping around Isla Mujeres with our 10 month old. Final destination- North Beach. However, we accidentally went farther than expected and had to park our golf cart by the Playa Mia resort. We were so glad we did, as there’s a beautiful shallow bay there, protected from the waves and definitely baby-friendly. No beach clubs, so very peaceful and serene. Could have spent our entire two weeks there!

reviews.title: Gorgeous
reviews.text: Beautiful beach location to relax and enjoy paradise. Plenty of options to rent chairs and umbrellas... usually you can negotiate lower rates if it's not crowded. Close to beach bars/restaraunts.

reviews.title: Beautiful Beach
reviews.text: Spend some time on Playa Norte, it is a great place to bring a towel and go for a swim in clear blue water!

reviews.title: Great weekend getaway
reviews.text: While it was busy with golf carts and scooters it has a relaxed vibe for a weekend getaway. There are many restaurants on offer and things to do and see.

reviews.title: Gorgeous beach!  Clear turquoise water!
reviews.text: We stayed at a hotel right on Playa Norte - one of the prettiest beaches I had ever experienced.  Water is clean, calm, clear and gorgeous!

reviews.title: Anniversary trip
reviews.text: Beautiful beach, great weather, friendly people. What more could you ask for?  We will never go all inclusive again.

reviews.title: Amazing beautiful beach & Island Tour
reviews.text: I wanted to visit the island since we have booked our honeymoon in Cancun. we looked at different options/ tours and we agreed that it would be much easier and cheaper if we arrange ourselves the trip. From Cancun Hotelera zone, we took the local bus up to Playa Tortugas , where we got on a ferry to Isla de Mujeres. ( return trip for 2 people was about 700 pesos). we went on the ferry that left at about 8.30 am . wasn't busy as well. the ferry - ultramarine - I believe was called - are very nice, clean and modern. the journey takes up to 40min.once arrived in port - u actually arrive in the main town / city centre. very very close to Playa Norte. we went first to hire a golf cart ( 800 pesos) - so we can go and explore the island. i though advise to walk to playa norte - if you want to chill out a few hours on the beach and enjoy the warm blue waters and then go and hire a golf cart to explore.i am saying this because, we didnt realize how close is the port to the beach and as well, we barely found a parking space ( for free) for the golf cart near the beach, even though was very early still. At the beach, the average price for 2 lounges with 1 umbrella is 300 pesos. the drinks from the bar are around 100 pesos / each. we stayed at the beach up to 1pm, at that time the beach was already pretty full of people and it became very crowded. but it was nice for a half day .after Playa Norte, we continued our adventure and  island exploring on our golf cart. we just droved around the island , on the edge of the sea side, and we stopped every time we wanted to explore a bit more.amazing little island; beautiful scenarry, worth going for a day trip or a weekend.

reviews.title: Lovely beach..food..snorkeling
reviews.text: We stayed a week at a condo on playa norte. The kids snirkled everyday. There are plenty of restaurants along the beach. Easy drinks and great food. It's a must visit if you're staying on the island.

reviews.title: Great beach
reviews.text: Prefer the area between Mia reef and the island it is calm in all weather in any weather thus is truly a great beach for kids

reviews.title: Chimbo Beach
reviews.text: Visited Isla Mujeres and rented a golf cart for the day (800 peso). Found ourselves at the Chimbos Beach club, and rented a couple of lounge chairs and an umbrella (300 peso) to enjoy the beach with. Unfortunately, this is pretty much a necessity as there is no other place in the beach to sit, let alone lounge. The place is packed, and for good reason. Great white sand beach and a gentle slope into the water makes it great for our little one. Staff were friendly and helpful, not overly pushy (saying something considering everyone in the area is pushing something

reviews.title: Beautiful sand and water, but a lot of people.
reviews.text: Beautiful experience!  The water was clear and the sand was beautiful. However, there was not much room to enjoy the beach without being forced to rent a chair. We luckily found a shady spot. However, it was near the day trippers' boats which blasted loud music the whole day. I would recommend!

reviews.title: Great water
reviews.text: Definitely worth a visit. Very swimmable. Little to no waves at all. Safe for kids to swim. Go to the north side. Go north, the water seems to be better as opposed to the part of the beach facing west. Go north to the north side. You’ll know it when you see it. Go away from Coco’s and head north.

reviews.title: Beautiful but crowded
reviews.text: This a beautiful turquoise water beach, however is the most visited in all Isla Mujeres, is something you have to see but if you are the kind of person that likes something more relaxing this is not the place for you.

reviews.title: Prestine beach
reviews.text: Bright blue water, clean sand, and not to crowded. Close to restaurants and golf cart rentals to tour the island. best beach on Isla for sure.

reviews.title: Favorite Beach in the World
reviews.text: For years we have been TA users and it has never steered us wrong. Thanks to everyone who posts info so collectively we all benefit. While I’m a long time user I am also a first time reviewer. Therefore it is appropriate to begin with one the best spots in the world. We have visited some of the best beaches in the world but Playa Norte is still our favorite. Crystal clear and calm water. Fine white sand.  Minimal crowds (not too crowded or empty) and no motorized water activities. Food and drink available close by. The northern end next to the Villa Kiin provides the calmest and most shallow waters for lounging in a large beautiful “pool”.The small island feel and reasonable prices are also great draws that keep us coming back. We typically stay at a modest hotel steps from the beach for very little dinero each day. Over the years we visit Isla and Playa del Carmen or large resort on the Riviera on the same trip. However, our Isla days seem to increase each trip demonstrating our love of this beach and island. Hope you all find joy in life and continue to search for the perfect beach for you as we are.

reviews.title: Simply beautiful
reviews.text: Beautiful clear water, white sand and no seaweed. Not too crowded. One of the best beach I’ve visited.

reviews.title: Beautiful perfect beach.
reviews.text: the is amazing beach to walk in clear blue water. you can walk the whole beach, stop at a bar get a drink and keep walking through the water. excellent.

reviews.title: Priviledge Aluxes Beach Club, not a hotel guest
reviews.text: This is the only Beach Club I have been going to for the past two years because it's just a few blocks from my apartment and the service is fabulous.

reviews.title: Isla Mujeres & Norte Beach
reviews.text: A lovely island with the most beautiful beach!!We booked a day trip to Isla Mujeres with Scuba Caribe and it was very enjoyable, once on the boat over we hired a golf cart for 4 hours through S.C for $60 US dollars which is around $1200pesos we found out once on the island their a bit cheaper, so you could shop around as their are a number of companies hiring the said carts. It’s a real fun day on the carts and takes about two to three hours to get around the island if stopping off at the different sites. One cool spot was feeding the turtles in a marina then we drove to the southern most point of the island to see the light house and giant Iguana statue...a lovely spot!! On our return finishing up at Norte Beach a beautiful beach beyond compare!! We eat at the Mayan Beach Club restaurant which is one of the first restaurants at the northern end of the beach, the food was fine and if you choose to eat there you’re allowed to use their beach sun beds free, which we did!! So we recommend you definitely do a day trip to Isla Mujeres and it’s gorgeous Norte Beach!!

reviews.title: Beautiful beach
reviews.text: This is such a beautiful beach, fine white sand, clear & mostly calm water, great breeze.  There are many places along the beach to grab a couple of chairs and an umbrella.  Yes, you will pay a little for these but it's fun, relaxing, great people watching.  It's a must visit if ever in Isla!!

reviews.title: Beach is as described
reviews.text: Beach is nice beautiful sand, found some shade over looking a shallow section to keep an eye on the young one.  Wife went snorkeling where the boats tie off and came back disappointed and sad at the trash and waste she saw littering the coral area.  The super shallow spots are clean and lots of small fish.

reviews.title: The most beautiful beach in all the Riviera Maya
reviews.text: This is my favorite beach in all the Riviera Maya, it never disappoints! The colors are so intense and beautiful, the water is always so calm, and the sand so soft, plus you get a sunset on that side, you just fall in love with that place

reviews.title: FAVORITE BEACH IN MY TRAVELS!!  CLEAR WATER - CALM WAVES - COOL CREATURES
reviews.text: I loved this beach.  I thought the main beach was a bit too crowded, but we stayed at Mia Reef and that side was AMAZING!!!  I would try to stay at one of the hotels with a more private beach area, but still......it is an amazing place to visit.

reviews.title: Awesome
reviews.text: Really nice beach for people would like enjoy clear and nice water, make party, taking sun and enjoy the sunset....

reviews.title: Beautiful Beach!
reviews.text: Playa Norte is amazing!  We have stayed in a few different places on Isla Mujeres but Playa Norte is our favorite.  This side of the island has the calmer water and is perfect for relaxing and swimming.  No matter how many times we visit I’m always amazed at how clear the water is!  It’s close to several shops, restaurants and the service is always great.  We can’t wait to return!

reviews.title: Paradise
reviews.text: This is one of the most beautiful beaches I have ever seen. Crystal clear water. Does get crowded. Tour boats bring people there.

reviews.title: Aaaaah
reviews.text: Beautiful place.  So nice to get away from the rat race.  Got to see Ricky Martinn's house too!  The sand was so soft and warm.  We are definitely going back,

reviews.title: Nice, clean beach.
reviews.text: Worth  making the tripto the north end of the island to visit Playa Norte.  The sunsets there are amazing!

reviews.title: Chimbos on Norte Playa
reviews.text: At the northern most tip of the Norte Playa beach is a restaurant named Chimbos. The lounge chair rental was 300 pesos, about average for the beach. The water and beach are great. Nice sandy beach, clean water, not very crowded. The food was excellent, prices reasonable.... good enough that we came back a second day. The whole fried fish was 170 pesos - about $9 US.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach, but not good for snorkeling
reviews.text: Great sand, lots of beach clubs that offer umbrellas, lounge chairs, and drinks at a good price.  The water stays churned up, so this isn't a good place to snorkel.

reviews.title: Awesome water
reviews.text: Can be a little crowded but I believe it is part of the appeal. I have never seen bluer water in my life. Be prepared for the locals hawking their wares but also part of the charm. Take pesos with you, it affords a better deal when buying food and drink and the like.

reviews.title: So relaxing!!
reviews.text: Great beach .. rented the beach chairs, lunch right on the beach. Massage was absolutely wonderful!!

reviews.title: Beautiful Beach
reviews.text: The beach was beautiful here but really not that much better then at the Palace beach.  In order to get a good spot you have to buy drinks and food.

reviews.title: Always beautiful, but usually crowded
reviews.text: This is the island’s best beach, and it is really worth spending time here while you’re on the island or even if you arrive on a private boat. It has many restaurants, bars and hotels where you can get a lounge chair for rent. The access to and from the rest of the streets, shops and restaurants is ideal, and you don’t even need any type of transportation to get there if you arrive by ferry. The sunsets are amazing.

reviews.title: What did i miss?
reviews.text: I was excited to spend the day at isla mujeres. I'd read all of the great reviews and knew to skip the golf cart, walk around the island and land at the north beach, all of which I did   It is A beautiful beach and there were tables, chairs and umbrellas.  Aside from that I'm not sure what the fuss is about.  The water had an odd odor and there was way too much drinking for my taste.   Walking around the island was annoying.  I had to keep my eyes down to escape the constant barrage of people selling things, which made it hard to view the beautiful,paintings throughout the town.    I'm glad I went but honestly, I wouldn't go back.  I know it's "touristy" but it was way too much.

reviews.title: One of the best memories of my life
reviews.text: The clear water, the fish, the warmth of the water. I have never swam in such clear waters before. It is the best beach I have been to. You have to visit this beach if you are in Isla Mujeres.

reviews.title: Beautiful & Safe
reviews.text: The white sandy beach was beautiful. Chair rentals plentiful. Felt safe and comfortable. We stayed in one are, rented a bed and ordererd our drink which was brought to us. Server was friendly and helpful as we need to capture our memories.

reviews.title: Nicest beach on Isla
reviews.text: The beach is lovely - powder sand and clean, clear water.  Nice mix of locals and visitors on the beach.  Day tripper boats anchor off this beach which says something as well.  Still a low key, laid back vibe.

reviews.title: It is a commercial beach. Chair and umbrellas a-plenty.
reviews.text: It is the "POPULAR BEACH". we felt safe. The chair vendors are a little pushy but otherwise nice spot for lunch and people watching

reviews.title: Best beach on Isla Mujeres!
reviews.text: Out of all beaches on this island, this one is the best! Resorts, little bars with swings, & a place where all the yachts pull up & anchor to go swimming. The water is so clear & beautiful. Close to Hildago street where the shops & restaurants/bars are located.

Cool spot to swim in clean shallow water and hang out on the beach at the top tip of the island by the pink hotel (mia reef)Nice beach bar called the Green Demon nearby. Good service, cool setup and decorating, good music 👍Further down/south east of here it gets busy and more generic/boring beach clubs and the water was more rough with a fair bit of seaweed around. We would suggest to northern tip!

reviews.title: Gorgeous Beach
reviews.text: Came to this beach as a stop off point on a boat trip. The beach has gorgeous turquoise water and soft white sand with plenty of loungers and umbrellas for hire. The beach is just off the bustling front street with lots of places to go shopping for souvenirs or go for a bite to eat/cold drink.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach
reviews.text: Our stay was beautiful. Bring cash to stay out of the hot sun. There was a restaurant across the street that brought us beer and appetizers.  Water was amazing and calm.

reviews.title: beautiful turquois water!!
reviews.text: The water was crystal clear, and beautiful.  The beach was very busy on a Sunday.  I think there were a lot of locals there.

reviews.title: Meh
reviews.text: Perhaps I’ve been spoiled by Barbados and Tobago, but this beach was just OK. I found it noisy and busy, the sand wasn’t as luxurious as I have read elsewhere. I actually preferred beaches down the coast.

reviews.title: Beach
reviews.text: It was Small and dirty but fun. Love isla Mujeres. It was a great day for kite flying. We enjoyed it.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach
reviews.text: From the clear blue water, to the abundance of food and drink options this beach is a must see.  We had rented a golf cart to tour the island and then spent a few hours on the beach before heading back to Cancun and it was the perfect way to end the day.

reviews.title: Most Beautiful Beach on the Isla
reviews.text: Eye candy - everything my heart could ever desire!! Lovely clean turquois water and powder-white sand

reviews.title: Beautiful Beach
reviews.text: Beach is great and there are a couple of restaurant/bars right on the beach that will provide beach service.

reviews.title: wonderful beach
reviews.text: Busy place but the beach is worth it!  Such a pretty site and the sunsets are amazing!   Chairs and umbrellas are available for some but are also for rent.  Loved it!

reviews.title: Best beach to relax on
reviews.text: During this trip to the island we did not see any of the seaweed that is a problem at most other beaches. Sand was clean, the beach mama's out every morning cleaning the beach. Just perfect for wading into the water without being washed up from the waves.

reviews.title: Delicious Food in a Spectacular Setting
reviews.text: Enjoyed a fabulous meal in a beautifully appointed dining room with gorgeous water / beach views.  Service was superlative and I can't wait to go back again!

reviews.title: Nice clear water
reviews.text: Wonderful beach, really clean, white sand, very close to many restaurants, no transportation need it when arrived to Isla Mujeres , visitor can walk to the beach enjoying  the other nice places view, Sunblock need it!!!

reviews.title: Beautiful beach and not crowded but be alert!
reviews.text: Gorgeous beach and not crowded like Puerto Vallarta.
