As with most mexican tourist towns, once you enter the airport terminal you are deluged with "special offers just for you" which are not special at all.  These are all efforts to get you to a timeshare presentation and then, well you're on your own to get out.  Not worth it. Book your ride to your hotel (or accommodations) in advance and just keep walking, following the directions given ahead of time.  If you are staying somewhere reputable or renting a private condo, you will be fine but don't stop and listen to the "pitch" at the airport.  Do as much research as possible on your accommodations ahead of time to get the most relaxing experience (which I failed to do and ended up unknowingly at a time share I was assured was not a time share).

reviews.title: Beautiful public beach
reviews.text: The best beach in Isla mujeresA must see place, we went there because there were sargazo in cancun it was a great idea

reviews.title: Awesome Turquise, Clear and calm water!
reviews.text: Ohhhh...this beach was paradise for us!! The water is such a gorgeous turquoise color and quite clear! We especially loved that the water was calm and there were not waves to knock you over! Great place to watch the stunning sunsets!

reviews.title: Best Part of the Island
reviews.text: This beach is a dream!  Turquoise, clear water with white sand.  You can see lots of fish and float along and relax.  This is a MUST SEE if you're in Cancun.

reviews.title: Beautiful, but crowded!
reviews.text: We stayed in a hotel right on Playa Norte.  The water is gorgeous - so many shades of blue it will blow your mind.  We visited in September, which is slow season and it was still busy - lots of boats anchored off shore that feel the need to compete with one another in how loud they can crank their music.  I imagine that is 1000 times worse in high or summer seasons. There are many vendors on the beach selling items from beaded jewelry, to fresh fruit and pistachios.  We bought a few things: coconut popsicles, pistachios, cannolis and pineapple - all pretty yummy.  Beautiful beach; beautiful people.  We will return!Enjoy...!

reviews.title: This is our new favorite vacation location!
reviews.text: Beautiful, silky turquoise water.  We advise if you snorkel get an approved guide, not  one traveling the beach. Ours guided us into schools of barracuda then into an area of strong current. We ended the snorkeling early after that.

reviews.title: Beautiful Beach
reviews.text: Beach is beautiful, water is a pretty blue color. There are beach chairs to rent about $20USD for 2 chairs, and umbrella. They are owned by the restaurant and bars that service the beach. The beach is very busy, chairs can fill up, and water is often busy with private boats coming in to swim. There is a rope that they stop at so they can't go any closer. Water was busy but did not feel crowded. Lots of people walking around selling jewelry or braids etc.

reviews.title: Beautiful calm waters
reviews.text: Our hotel Mia was located on the north side.  It is wonderful here. Great waters to snorkel, swim, float, etc...

reviews.title: Best Beach for Beach lovers!
reviews.text: The Water is shallow for ever, No Seaweed, Warm, No Waves, So Much Fun, Sand is so soft, No rocks or Coral

reviews.title: white sand and turquois water
reviews.text: Everything you want. Sunbathing, strolling, Party, Drinks and Swimming. During the off-season not crowded.

reviews.title: Very nice beach
reviews.text: A very nice looking beach with clean turquoise water. It's one of the best beaches in the island and that's why there are many people and therefore not much space to swim.

reviews.title: Playa Norte Smelled like an Overflowing Sewer!
reviews.text: I have read such wonderful reviews and was shocked to find that when we visited in September of 2018 the entire beach area smelled of sewer and I mean an unbearable stench of horrid odor.  There was no place to escape it so we had to leave. If you are planning a visit here you might want to skip it until they get the problem resolved. Also, the locals were asking an outrageous $20 per person for a chair and umbrella.  My friend and I would have had to pay $40 just to sit on their beach - Wow!

reviews.title: The Best Beach In The Cancun Area
reviews.text: What can be said about the absolutely clear and calm water at Playa Norte? A great place to swim and plenty of places to get a quick cocktail or beer. Not very deep unless you wander out from the beach but an incredible swimming experience because the water is so calm. Great place to visit and spend a day.

reviews.title: The best beaches on the island!
reviews.text: The north end of Isla has the best beaches and water to play in!  Depending on where you are staying you might have a private section for the resort or you might have to rent a chair and umbrella.  Either way it is worth it!!!!!

reviews.title: Beautiful Beach
reviews.text: Most popular beach on Isla. I can see why! Although it does get quite packed. You can rent an umbrella and loungers for up to 400mxn, or there are places that u can buy drinks and get loungers for free.

reviews.title: Beautiful calm blue water
reviews.text: The beach can be crowded in front of Ixchel but we preferred bringing our own beach chairs down closer to the MIA where the sand is wide and you have some personal space.  Can’t wait to return!

reviews.title: Absolutely beautiful!
reviews.text: While the rest of Cancun and points south have been struggling with the seagrass problem, this beach is untouched by it! Clear turquoise water is a welcome relief from the hot sun! Beautiful soft, white sand that doesn't get too hot to walk barefoot on. We'll worth a visit!

reviews.title: Wonderful!
reviews.text: We decided to take the ferry and make a day at Isla Mujeres and it was great.  We took a two block walk to get the golf cart and made our way to Playa Norte first to beat the crowd.  We got there around 10:30 or 11 and had no problem getting a chair in the front.  There are many "beach clubs" that try to get you to buy a package, but we just rented a chair and umbrella from a place that offered waited service where we could pay drink by drink.  I believe it was around $20-$30 for the umbrella and two chairs.  Dos Equis was around $3 each.  We spent a few hours at Playa Norte and then headed to check out the rest of the island around 2:00.  By 2:00 it was pretty crowded and the boats were heading in.  But no seaweed like Cancun and there were fish swimming around so that was nice to see. After driving around the island we are pretty sure Playa Norte is one of the only accessible beaches.  The others are rocky.  So this is a must!

reviews.title: Great beach playa norte
reviews.text: We stayed in Cancun the beaches are not great.  So we took the ferry over to Isla Mujeres for $19.00 usd round trip. It is really easy to get to on your own.  Playa Notre is a beach on Isla Mujeres. We rented a golf cart for the day for $45.00 usd and explored the island.  The best part of play norte is towards the end.  The waters are so crystal clear and calm.  We went to seven-eleven and bought really cheap drinks and snacks, we had a lovely day on the beach.  Another day we did the snorkeling excursion for under $50.00 including transportation from Cancun to Isla Mujeres. One issue: the lack of English spoke on the excursion.  My family speaks Spanish fluently but I don't,  so I was out numbered.   Americans make sure your guide speaks English! My husband had to translate for 5 out of 11 ppl on the boat. Anyway, the snorkeling was great and we had a good time. I highly recommend Isla Mujeres, but convert some USD to Pesos because the some ppl will lower the exchange rate and you lose out.  Maybe change $100 to start, it is easier when you leave the Cancun area and go on excursions.

reviews.title: BEST BEACH IN MEXICO!
reviews.text: I have been to places all along both coasts of Mexico. Nowhere compares to the beauty of Play Norte!

reviews.title: Very Crowded
reviews.text: This beach is very pretty early in the morning when it's not crowded. The later in the day it gets the more crowded it gets. I was however disappointed to see as much sea weed as I did. There is a spot out in front of the Mayan beach club that has sea weed in the sand and there is sea weed floating in the water. Not a lot but there is still some. Coming from Texas and always experiencing Texas seaweed beaches this was kind of disappointing to see. I'm sure though that this is seasonal and that there isn't always sea weed.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach
reviews.text: It gets crowded on the high season, but there is a reason for this. It's the nicest easily accessible beach. Plus amongst the only ones not affected by the algue problem the island and Yucatan has been encountering.

reviews.title: Breathtaking Beach
reviews.text: One of the most breathtaking beaches I have ever been too. Clear blue waters, clean white sand, just awesome!! The ladies on the beach that provide massages were amazing (MeMe) was my masseuse and she is the BEST!! Great restaurants and bars right on the beach with great food and cocktails.

reviews.title: Stopped here twice
reviews.text: Once on our golf cart tour of the island and again the next day - taking the time to wade in the pools and watch the fish in front of the Mia hotel. Only complaint is it draws a lot of boat traffic.

reviews.title: Best Mexican Beach
reviews.text: I imagine you have been in many beaches in your life, well this is the one, or at least one of your top five, imagine a tranquil beach, white sand, the water in your belly for hundreds of yards, you can even see great fish swimming beside you, and after all, at the  dusk.. the best paint the sun and atmosphere bring you a show of colour and greatness, the only place besides cozumel where you can see a sunset (because in the mexican caribbean form the coast you can only see the dawn, but here in this beautiful tiny island this is the right spot to see the best sunset in the world, this is it.. the place you imagine when you are in trouble or picture yourself after life... live and enjoy playa norte.

reviews.title: Amazing - All we hoped for and more!
reviews.text: Beautiful beach with soft, clean white sand.  The water is amazing clear and calm.  The shallowness of the water allows you plenty of room even when the beach is busy.  Can’t wait to go back!

reviews.title: Dreamy
reviews.text: Playa Norte isn't the most beautiful beach on the island; however, it is the most beautiful beach inhabited by people on the island, but it very well maybe one of the most beautiful beaches I've been to. There are lots of beachside restaurants and bars to choose from and an umbrella and two chairs will run you about $20 USD for the day. This is my second trip to Isla Mujeres, and it definitely won't be my last. The beautiful beaches, friendly faces and affordable accommodations will keep me coming back!!

reviews.title: Loved it!
reviews.text: We walked onto the beach down the main thoroughfare and were greeted with many offers for umbrellas, chairs, and food.  Though it initially caught me off guard, we accepted all of those and had an amazing time.  It was a weekend, so it was busy, but not overly crowded.  Service was terrific and reasonably priced.  For 5 people, present for 8 hours, we had 3 large umbrellas, 5 lounge chairs, food and drinks for all throughout the day, and 2 paddleboards for an hour, with generous tips for about $230.  Shout out to our waiter, Angel, who never left us wanting for anything.

reviews.title: 2018 Summer Vacation
reviews.text: The Island is gorgeous and the people so friendly. What can I say about the beach it's breathtaking. The sand is so clean and the water is so clear and seaweed free at this time of the year. Mexico was an amazing experience, I can't wait to go back.

reviews.title: Stunning white sand beaches
reviews.text: We were dropped off by our catamaran and had 2.5hrs to explore the area. The beaches were stunning, very relaxing day. Some of our group walk to the other side of the island, through the shops and homes. Lovely, safe place to visit.

reviews.title: In love!
reviews.text: Best beach ever ❤️ crystal clear water, white sand, amazing bars with delicious drinks, all you need!

reviews.title: omg
reviews.text: this is easily one of the most exquisite beaches I've ever been to Water is perfect and when you stand in it you'll see little fish all around you My favorite place..

reviews.title: amazing, even more than Thailand beaches
reviews.text: white sand, blue water, feels like a postcard. better to stay in the hotels there to enjoy the sun beds and the proximity to the rooms.

reviews.title: Beautiful but Overrun :/
reviews.text: There's WAYYYYYY too many boats and people to really enjoy the beauty of this beach. Get there before 10am or after 5pm to really see it for how it was meant to be. Still though, you will have a lovely time in the water and on the beach if you don't mind some company. The water is amazing and clear and very warm. There's decent offshore snorkeling at Mia Reef at the Mia Reef hotel towards the Northeast tip. Mid-day boats start to block your awesome view and loud music takes over but you're still on one of the prettiest beaches in the world so it's hard to complain.  Go down towards the Mia Reef end, there's more beach and there's a lagoon area with flat crystal clear water about knee deep it's really beautiful!

reviews.title: Beautiful white sand beaches
reviews.text: Soft white sand and clear turquoise waters. It was super hot in August and the water was so cool and refreshing! Loved this place!

reviews.title: Great beach with beach chairs
reviews.text: the best beach on the island. white sand and warm water. There are sand bags on the outside of the swimming area so you can swim without worrying about the waves. As the best beach in Isla, you can expect it to be packed!GO THERE FOR SUNSET. the sunsets from the Playa Norte are amazing and you can watch them either from the sand or from the water.

reviews.title: Best beach in the Caribbean
reviews.text: We love this beach! There are multiple beachclubs where you can get a lounge chair and order food and drinks. The water is so warm and refreshing, and not deep at all.

reviews.title: Busy with lots of trash, not to mention the sea grass issues
reviews.text: Hard to believe this beach was ranked one of the best in its current state.  Trash everywhere, overcrowded with boats, and not to mention the seaweed/grass issue that is plaguing Cancun.  Playa Centro was clean and very nice on the other hand.  They really need to clean this beach up, it’s sad to see it go to waste.

reviews.title: Awesome beach,  like heaven on earth
reviews.text: This beach is so relaxing and blue.  Great views of the yachts and tourism from all over the world. You must try this beach,  warm blue water and soft white sand.

reviews.title: Somewhat overrated
reviews.text: We stayed mid-island and so we were spoiled by a private beach. Playa Norte is kind of a zoo and we much preferred our little section at the boutique hotel Isla Mujeres Palace (which was awesome, if you're travelling without kids).

reviews.title: Overcrowded
reviews.text: Isla mujeres is a very crowded island with many hippy pubs without a nice deco, no quality or cool ambiance.If you are looking for some relax or isolated beach, do not go here.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach
reviews.text: Playa Norte is a beautiful beach on Isla Mujeres. Long stretch (seemed like hundreds of metres) of white sandy beaches made of crushed coral, crystal turquoise water that comes chest high far out from shore, gentle waves. Beautiful for swimming and cooling off in hot, humid August weather. Because of its shallow, calm water, I can imagine it would be perfect for kids to play in too. I believe one end of the beach - the south west - has a more public beach with some restaurants, and the other end - north east-  seems a bit quieter with more hotels and beach clubs.Having said all this, because the long stretch of beach is home to the main hotel zone and close to the island's centre on Isla Mujeres, it is crowded. There are hotels as well as beach clubs along the strip where you can pay to rent beach chairs, and more importantly, umbrellas for shade. It seemed that the beach clubs were like restaurants where you could also order snacks and drinks. We set up camp at a place called the Green Demon where this was the case. There isn't much "free" space on the beach, nor "free" shade. So, if you are staying at a hotel along the beach, I imagine it's not an issue. But if you are just visiting, expect to pay for a spot to sit and some shade. And expect to share your little slice of paradise (what a view!) with thousands of others. Beautiful, but busy.

reviews.title: Go! Go! Go! Is all in say!
reviews.text: It’s very beautiful the water is clear, but make sure to get there early before the crowd. There’s plenty of food and you can get a very good massage on the beach! I got a chair and umbrella for the full day for $20 US dollars. I’m sure I could’ve got it cheaper than that, but I thought it was a very good deal especially since I had a front row seat which is another reason to get there early. Here’s a little advice, if you want to take plenty of good photos? Once again, get there early! because even though The water is clear, once the crowd gets there they tend to kick up a little sand from the ocean floor and that makes it just a shade of cloudiness which is still clear but not as clear. Enjoy!

reviews.title: Best beach
reviews.text: Ranked 4th world wide I have been to the top 3North beach is better.  The sea grass is not bad and water quality is great

reviews.title: Beautiful
reviews.text: I stayed a the Mia Reef Villa Resort which we  loved. Has it own private beach, water is calm and crystal clear.

reviews.title: Nice beach.
reviews.text: Nice beach, busy even in low season, roped off area for swimming to prevent you being hit by passing  dive boats and ferries. Witnessed women sieving the sand some mornings to remove the trash which I was impressed with. Lots of souvenir shops, restaurants and bars nearby.. preferred to stay in my hotel pool area which was adjacent the beach.

reviews.title: Nice public beach with food and drinks
reviews.text: Is on the seaweed free isla mujers. I compare the beach and water to the white sand and color of Aruba, very nice Sandy beach.Little beach restaurants to get food and drink and rent lounge chairs. Good place to visit if your on the island and want to leave your resort for a bit.

reviews.title: Too Crowded
reviews.text: We ended our whale shark excursion at this beach, and we have visited some pretty amazing beaches and this one was nice, but it was way too crowded.  Tons of boats just floating near by, and lots of people in the water and on the sand.

reviews.title: Amazing beach!!
reviews.text: Best beach in all of Mexico!!! Such a beautiful turquoise blue. Calm waters , friendly people and a lot of fun!

reviews.title: Beautiful beach
reviews.text: We stopped here on the way back from swimming with the whale sharks.  It's a beautiful, white sand beach.  Had a great time floating in the water and enjoying the scenery.  It can get quite busy but it was still worth the visit.

reviews.title: Beauty of a beach
reviews.text: This beach isn't overwhelmed by all the seaweed like other beaches. Try green demon on the beach if you stay at Paradise Suites.

reviews.title: Isla Mujeres
reviews.text: Swam alongside with Whale Sharks which was truly spiritually awesome.  Drive gocart everywhere including to areas visitors do not visit. The locals have their own "local" beach of which locals can fish and then grill right on the beach.  The hotel we stayed in was okay.  Restaurants were very good. All we ate while there were plates of seafood. Would I go back?  Yes.  Relaxing time.

reviews.title: Amazing beach
reviews.text: Amazing beach, so clean and the water so so blue! Looks like Maladives. The only downside, the amounth of tourists talking loud + the loud music from eateries.

reviews.title: One of my favorite beaches
reviews.text: Water is great.. lots of palm trees.  Amazig vacation here.  Better then the other Riviera Maya beaches in my opinion.

reviews.title: Nice beach, but no free bathrooms or showers
reviews.text: The beach itself is very nice. Clear blue water and cool sand. Fairly crowded, but not so so much so that it wasn't enjoyable. When I first arrived in Isla Mujeres, I was overwhelmed by the number of people trying to sell me things and the HEAT. I found myself immediately searching for the beach (and not wanting to do much else). As much as I wanted to dive right into the water, the beach was fairly restricted because the hotels occupy most of the beach space with lounge chairs and umbrellas that you must pay for (unless you're staying at that hotel). If you don't want to pay for a chair, you better bring a beach blanket or towel and find some space in the sand (not much to choose from). *I would strongly recommend wearing your bathing suit or changing on the ferry ride over because there are NO free bathrooms, places to change, or even showers! (unless you're staying at one of the hotels on the beach).*

reviews.title: Gorgeous beach
reviews.text: The beach is absolutely beautiful. The sand is white and clean, water is blue and clear. No seaweed and very pleasant to swim in. The beach was very crowded, but that's to be expected. You can rent chairs and beds, but we just put a towel down on the sand. There are many trees, so not difficult to find shade.  There are several restaurants with food and drinks. Ask for ice cream in fruit bowls, it is the best! There are no lockers, so you need to figure out a way to secure your stuff. I had waterproof case for my phone which I took with me swimming, but left clothes and stuff on the beach. Definitely worth going to this beech, especially if you can go in the morning or evening. We were there in the afternoon, and it was extremely hot.

reviews.title: HEAVEN ON EARTH
reviews.text: We went with our friends for a day trip to Isla Mujeres and it was the highlight of our trip. We rented a golf cart and putted around the island. Playa Norte is the most beautiful place in Cancun area. No seaweed, fun bars and eateries. Love the locals and culture

reviews.title: Great beach
reviews.text: Wonderful place to spend the day on the water. We always did it by boat and had the captain prepare fresh ceviche on the boat while we swam in the crystal clear water.

reviews.title: Beautiful
reviews.text: Beautiful beach! Very clean. Good for families and couples. Bars and restaurants are very fun.Its’s a must go.

reviews.title: Beautiful
reviews.text: We stayed recently at Playa Norte in the Ixchel Beach Resort. After traveling around the world and experiencing beaches in many wonderfully exotic places, we can say without doubt the Playa Norte is one of the beautiful beaches we have experienced. Muy bien!

reviews.title: Beautiful sandy beach
reviews.text: I went to the beach twice and it was so clear and beautiful. No fish to see but the water was great. No seaweed either.

reviews.title: Best beach in Mexico!
reviews.text: We are staying in the Rivera Maya, but the ocean here is full of sea weed, and a little rough.  So we decided to head to Isla Mujeres, and specifically to Playa Norte for the day.  The beach is PERFECTION!  Crystal clear water, no seaweed, perfect temperature, and the softest sand ever.  We paid about 300 pesos (approx 18 USD) to rent two lounge chairs and an umbrella (which I definitely needed because I burn easily!).  We arrived around noon on a Sunday, and it was not crowded at all.  Had bar service from the restaurant right on the beach.  Worth the additional 5-10 min walk past the first beach (playa centro) once you get off the ferry!!  Totally different water!

reviews.title: Always GREAT sunsets!
reviews.text: A beautiful beach. Blue calm shallow water. Nice for kids. Lots of vendors come by during the course of the day.

reviews.title: The most beautiful beach from the whole island
reviews.text: You must visit this beach on your trip to Isla Mujeres. Is beautiful, the best from the whole island

reviews.title: couples vacation
reviews.text: this place is beautiful,not real busy this island is a hidden gem, we are looking forward to coming back next year, beach is beautiful, people are friendly and food is homemade. island is not very big you can rent a golf cart and go from one side of the island to other.

reviews.title: One of the most beautiful of the Caribbean
reviews.text: North Beach is always a favorite water is calm it’s clear as can be blue as can be and the sand as white as can be.However in recent days it has become extremely crowded and many boats coming from Cancun every day and anchor out just passed the swim line. Even with the problem of the seagrass that the Caribbean is having North Beach is free of it for now anyway.There’s plenty of restaurants and bars along the way and it’s sunset there’s music and bubbles.Find yourself a nice tree and make yourself comfortable and settle in for an afternoon of some of the finest swimming anywhere in the world-not to mention some of the best sunsets!

reviews.title: golf cart day
reviews.text: nicest beach area on the island. we didn't stay very long just enough to get some pictures. Would definitely go back.

reviews.title: The best beach on Isla Mujeres
reviews.text: Loved this place so much. The vibe , the colours , the people , the easy access. There’s no bad thing I could mention about this beach and the whole island it’s a must go

reviews.title: Getting way too crowded
reviews.text: We still visit this beach every time we visit the island because it is stunningly beautiful. But, it is SO crowded. Try to go on a week day. Take a mask so you can check out the cute little reef on the east side of the bridge to the Reef motel. You can spend a lot of time there. Shop around for your lounger to rent. Some include a free bucket of beer although we couldn't find that on our last trip. Walk over to the west side and start heading down into the busy shop section. There are AMAZING massages available in tents on the beach for a fraction of what you'll pay in your resort.

reviews.title: Amazing
reviews.text: No algae when everywhere else in Cancun is stinking full of them! Beds on the beach are only 200 pesos for the whole day!

reviews.title: Beautiful beach, but go early to avoid party boats
reviews.text: We've been lucky enough to have a 3 week stay here in Isla Mujeres. Yes, this is one of the most beautiful beaches I've been to. The sand, the water is clear and calm with no waves. BUT...it gets crowded and turns into a party scene every day starting around 12pm. If party boats with crowds and loud pop music isn't your thing, then go in the morning to have space to swim around and enjoy the calm beauty of Playa Norte.

reviews.title: Good but so crowded
reviews.text: Our hotel shared part of this beach.  On the first day, we went down and snorkeled in the morning and almost no one was there.  By the evening, we went back out there, and we were shocked that it was absolutely packed.  Thousands of people and boats.  So if you just want to snorkel around, I'd recommend going early.

reviews.title: North beach
reviews.text: Beautiful beach, but very crowded. Hard to find a place to sit.   A lot of the tours drop off there so it stays busy during the day.   Would recommend a visit.

reviews.title: crowded
reviews.text: This beach is packed.  I didn't come to Isla Mujeres for the beaches, but to swim with the whale sharks.  We got on and off the boat off this beach.  The beach was vacant when we left at 7AM, but by the time we got back between 2-3 PM, it was packed.  We stayed at Na Balam which is the hotel located on this beach and would swim in the afternoon.  There are always people around and you have very little space on the beach or in the water.

reviews.title: Awesome beach !
reviews.text: We went to this beach 3 times on our trip to Isla Mujeres. The water was clear and so blue, just like the pics and the sand was clean and beautiful. All around were shops and eateries......wonderful atmosphere.

reviews.title: Beautiful Beach!
reviews.text: We arrived early to get umbrellas and chairs close to the water.  Have a wonderful day relaxing and enjoying beautiful views!

reviews.title: Awesome!
reviews.text: Beautiful!   GO there in the morning until 2:00.  Take a nap.  Go back from 2:00 until after sunset.  It's dreamy.  Soft sand, great water, and next to the best hotels.

reviews.title: Lots of boats now
reviews.text: Came two years ago and considerably less boats. However I could see why they are parked here because it is so beautiful. The sand is perfect. Water clear. Big storm came in. Paid $200 pesos for a covered bed and umbrella for 20 minutes and could not get refunded when this huge storm came in. He warned me so it’s my fault I suppose.

reviews.title: Beach trip
reviews.text: Beautiful beach and some lovely beach bars. Clear water perfect for swimming and snorkelling. Easy walk from the ferry terminal from Cancun.

reviews.title: Beautiful Beach but Crowded
reviews.text: This is the most beautiful beach on the island, but unfortunately it's always crowded with people and the many boats that linger offshore.

reviews.title: Supergreat beach, the very best!
reviews.text: Supergreat beach, the very best! So nice beach and water! Many nice restaurants by th beach also! We loved it!

reviews.title: Beautiful beach
reviews.text: This is the most beautiful beach on the Highland. The sand is soft and white, the water stay shallow a long ways out and is such a beautiful color. Great for couples and for families.

reviews.title: Such a beautiful beach!  Clear, turquoise water!  Stunning!
reviews.text: We stayed at a resort in the Mayan Riviera.  Seeing as they are being plagued by seaweed, we decided to do a daytrip over to Isla Mujeras to experience a good beach day.  What a wonderful place.  We booked a private transfer (Canada Transfers) to take us to the ferry terminal from our resort.  We then took the approx. 20  minute ferry over to the island.  When you arrive, turn to the left and you can walk about 15-20 minutes and you will get to Playa Norte (North Beach).  You can also rent a golf cart from 9-5 for $45 US which will allow you to drive around the island after your finished your beach time. This is the most beautiful beach on Isla Mujeras and Mayan Beach Club is the first place you'll come across on the right when you get to the beach.  For 300 pesos each (about $17US), we got 2 beach chairs and an umbrella.  The nice thing about this beach club is that any food and drink that you order comes off of that amount.  So basically, we ordered 600 pesos worth of food and drink, and got to use the chairs/umbrella for free.  Try to get there early as it does get busier as the day goes on.  It is stunningly beautiful.  The water is crystal clear and turquoise - the same way the Mayan Riviera used to be!  It was really busy to catch the ferry back at 5:30 so if that's your plan, make sure to leave yourself some extra time.  Enjoy!  It's a fabulous place!

reviews.title: Beautiful and clean!
reviews.text: Gorgeous beach! Enjoy the visit. Do NOT stay at Mia Reef. Ugh! Visit #1 restaurant, North Beach, very yummy and even more friendly.

reviews.title: I am in love
reviews.text: Having traveled to many beaches through the world, playa norte is in my top 5. The water is beautiful and clear. The isla people work hard at keeping the sea grass that washes up overnight cleaned up every morning. There are free umbrellas areas and some that cost 300 pesos ( 16 dollars). Worth it to stay away from the crowds on the free areas. Get there by 10 ish or risk not getting chairs and umbrella. It is popular but not so crowded to feel I comfortable. We will keep coming here till we figure out how to retire here and never leave playa norte. Lol

reviews.title: Nice Beach Near Downtown
reviews.text: Not too far away from the downtown craziness, Playa Norte is a nice spot to park for the day and enjoy the beach in Isla Mujeres.  Several restaurants in the area cater to bathers by letting you us their  bathrooms to change (and some have showers).

reviews.title: Gorgeous
reviews.text: This was our third visit to Isla and Playa Norte and it’s gorgeous! We get there early and it’s just so peaceful and beautiful. It livens up a bit later in the day which is also great. The water is calm and beautiful.

reviews.title: amazing beach
reviews.text: loved this beach sat at many areas of the beach but settled for a place that was cheaper than the rest got excellent service not only by the beach boy who looked after the beds and brolly' s and gave you coupons for free water from the bar to the waiters that served you on the beach with drinks and food,beautiful beach and beautiful water

reviews.title: AMAZING BEACH!
reviews.text: We stayed in Isla Mujeres for a week and took a trip to the beach every day! It is probably best to go in the morning before it gets too hot and too crowded. Later in the afternoon heaps of party boats come in, so its best to try and avoid that.The beach is the best beach in Mexico! We went at the seaweed season and THERE WAS NO SEA WEED AT ALL! The beach is so so clean, and the water is crystal clear, and the bluest water you will EVER come across in Mexico. You can't top the beach.The fish are so cute, and you can walk all the way out to the safety rope. The nice little restaurant is near, and lots of sales people pass by selling icecreams and fruit for a cheap price.The sales people can get annoying, but some of them sale amazing stuff worth purchasing. The beach chairs are 90 pesos for hire which is a very reasonable price.You can't miss the beach.

reviews.title: Relax on the beach
reviews.text: Great little island and the water is beautiful color.  White sand, then we rented a golf cart to explore.

reviews.title: Beautiful, but busy!
reviews.text: This beach is absolutely stunning! We loved it from the second we set foot on it. The sand is so so soft and white. You can rent loungers and an umbrella for 270pesos per day which was reasonable. The only thing we disliked was how insanely busy it got with all the boats that arrived there each day. It is so peaceful in the morning until about 11am when tons of tourist boats anchor very close to the beach and compete with each other to play the worst and loudest music possible! It took away from the serenity of the beach for sure.

reviews.title: By far the best beach on the island
reviews.text: It's a busy beach but for good reason.   Beautiful water and lots of sand!  You can rent chairs and umbrellas all along the beach.   Normally if you buy food and drinks they will refund your chair and umbrella fees.  At the end of the beach near Mia reef you can snorkel with children and see fish.

reviews.title: Beautiful Beach
reviews.text: This should be a definite stop if visiting Isla Mujeres.  There are great restaurants and bars, and the water is beautiful!  The beach tends to get overcrowded, so going early is a good idea.  Then, venture elsewhere for the afternoon if you don't like big crowds.

reviews.title: Beautiful water
reviews.text: Great place to swim in the sea with little ones.  Very pretty water and small waves. It’s very safe and water is very refreshing!!

reviews.title: Crowded, but stunning
reviews.text: Parked a rented golf cart on the street less than a block away and easily walked over. White sand, palm trees, and shallow turquoise water. Beautiful. See photos. We tried the beaches all around the island and this was the most beautiful, though the diving and snorkeling are more interesting over on the reef (to the southwest).Bring cash - few of the nearby bars and restaurants took credit cards. Cash only (pesos or dollars).

reviews.title: North Beach
reviews.text: Beautiful spot to cool off in the clear water! Drove our golf cart around to see the sights and some of the ruins. Drinks at the beach were delish!

reviews.title: Beautiful but overcrowded
reviews.text: This was the #1 place to visit according to Trip Advisor.  While it is a gorgeous beach, it is extremely crowded which was a big turn off for me.   People were everywhere!   A hotel with beachfront is a much better choice if you don’t like huge crowds.  We were here in the slow season so I can’t imagine what busy season would be

reviews.title: Weekend fun is the best
reviews.text: What a beautiful beach... White sand, turquoise blue water, palm trees waving in the breeze.  Just perfect to hang back and relax.  But come on the weekend - the locals hire yachts, anchor them off the beach, turn up the music and party in the sun and warm water.  It is a total blast to see everyone having a great time.  Great, fun party atmosphere - perfect for all ages.

reviews.title: Eternal Honey Moon
reviews.text: Simply astonish ! I was born in the Caribbean and been blessed so many beaches but thus Island won my heart . We spent 5 lovely days that will remember forever. Beautiful sun kissed white sandy beaches , contrasting blue tone clear waters , ranging from turquoise to dark blue. We have enjoyed the best sunsets ever at Punta Sur and Playa Norte. Good dining and a nightlife . Visit Coco Snack Bar on the beach ( Cuban and Mexican fusion), rent a Golf Car to explore the island or just enjoy and relax.

reviews.title: Best beach!
reviews.text: We stayed at a house in Isla, had access to the lagoon by the mia reef but by far our group was blown away at the beautiful Playa Norte. Its easy, rent chairs, eat, drink and bob with a float to your hearts content.

reviews.title: Great Beach!
reviews.text: I now understand why this beach is on some of the top ten beaches. The sand and breezes are perfect. We loved watching the boats coming in to enjoy the day.

reviews.title: Come in the morning!
reviews.text: In the mornings you’ll have the beach to yourself! After 13/14 hrs the beach becomes very crowded, but the place is still very nice to hangout. Showers are provided; the food on the beach is reasonable

reviews.title: Gorgeous Beach - Highly recommend !!
reviews.text: Visited Playa Norte and was amazed by the beautiful white sand and crystal clear blue water. Caught the 9am ferry using UltaMar from Playa Tortuga Ferry terminal. Rented a golf cart to visit several local attractions on the island prior to spending the remainder of the day at the beach. Ferry goes back to the main island almost every hour all the way until midnight. The beach did not have any seaweed, crystal white sand "soft" and water was amazing. Crystal clear cool blue water. We visited the island on a Thursday and it was not crowded. Laid my belongings on the beach and laid out and swam for hours. Several boats and tour guides anchor on this beach for snorkeling/swimming.  There's a restaurant overlooking the beach and if you get hungry you can grab a bite or visit one of several local food stands.The restaurant does have public restrooms and you do not need to buy anything. Highly recommend visiting Playa Norte. If we come back to Cancun we will definitely rent a hotel room on the island. Its a must see!!

reviews.title: Beautiful Beach
reviews.text: Definitely worth visiting as the beach and the water are stunning.  My teenage daughter described it as the kind of beach you see on TV.  The water is turquoise and very shallow so visitors of all ages will enjoy just floating around and taking in the views.  My little boys ages 4 and 2 loved the calm water.  It’s definitely a busy beach by noon but it’s no way overcrowded.  We rented a golf cart and near the ferry terminal and drove ouirsleves to Playa Norte, which made it a little more fun of an experience than taking a taxi.

reviews.title: Beautiful!
reviews.text: The beach here is amazing, no seaweed. We should have stayed at one of the smaller hotels near this beach instead of in Puerto Morelos. The only downside is that only a few hotels have their own beach chairs and umbrellas, the others have to be rented. Our kids would have loved to build sand castles here. The sand is white and the water is clear blue. Lots of local food stands and bars. All of the tourist shops seemed to be owned by one family and they all had the same souvenirs.

reviews.title: Nice looking too crowded and commercialized
reviews.text: We tried to go on the beach twice you have to walk through crowds and there is somebody trying to sell you a chair rental the entire time.

reviews.title: Great beaches - typical Mexican Riviera vibe.
reviews.text: Went to the Myan Beach Club - got chairs & umbrella for free with 600 peso food and drink tab.  Had a blast.

reviews.title: Playa Norte
reviews.text: A beautiful beach worth waiting for! The water was shallow walking out for quite a distance. Th kids loved playing in the sand and waves. A great place for family fun.

reviews.title: Just an Incredible Beach Area
reviews.text: For such a small island, the beaches are outstanding and the little shops are fun, too.  They have several beachside and inland restaurants that we couldn't try them all out in our week there.  Can't wait to go back.  Playa Norte is the way to go, I believe, when on Isla Mujeres.  That is some seriously blue water.

reviews.title: Beautiful but crowded
reviews.text: Beautiful beach, really crowded on Sunday, but that's to be expected, because the locals use it with their families.  The water color is exquisite, and it's great for those who don't want to go out in deep water, as it's quite shallow.

reviews.title: Best beaches in Isla
reviews.text: After driving (golf cart) through the entire island, you want to be at Playa Norte to find white sandy beaches. We found a spot right next to a pier and behind a natural wave breaker. The water was crystal clear and you can walk around about 10 different type of fish. A beautiful reef.

reviews.title: Past its prime
reviews.text: Once this beach was a well kept secret but now it is over run and over used. Erosion has shaped this beach and now there are giant unsightly algae covered black blobs positioned to reduce erosion. The remaining beach is covered by beach club vendors offering expensive chairs, umbrellas, beer, and marginal food. There is a shortage of bathroom facilities and garbage cans. The sand is nice but there are cig butts, beer caps, straws and other litter. Off shore too many boats anchor close to shore limiting swimming and creating some boat related pollution.

reviews.title: Stunning beach
reviews.text: The sea is crystal clear and the sand powder white. Just fabulous.The only downside is that loads of charters come here to let people swim so can be noisy - nevertheless it’s spectacular

reviews.title: The gold cart drive and North beach were so fun!
reviews.text: Beautiful, real deal island. Fun to drive the cart and see all the views. Go to North beach. It’s a bit crowded and you will get hassled to buy stuff but it’s still amazing. The drinks were so good especially while it’s so hot out. Ferry ride was also nice and relaxing. We felt very safe.

reviews.title: Pretty
reviews.text: Very nice lots of bars serving beers, happy hour drinks, also lots of people playing and sunbathing.

reviews.title: Paradise <3
reviews.text: It took a long time for me to decide what beach in Cancun I wanted to stay in. I read that usually people take a day trip to Playa Norte and stay on Cancun. I decided for what I wanted to do--relax and unwind solely on the clearest most beautiful beach- I wanted to instead make my entire trip on Playa Norte. I'm so thankful I made this decision! Playa norte is absolutely breathtaking, warm, calm, and BEAUTIFUL. There are restaurants directly on the beach that provide beach chairs, drinks, or food at a low cost. If you are looking for the best beach and NOT travelling to Cancun for nightlife, stay at Playa Norte! You will not regret it. Not to mention every beach in Cancun was full of seaweed and brown and dirty due to the storms this weekend that we went EXCEPT Playa Norte.

reviews.title: Hmmmmmmm....
reviews.text: Not what it once was. Over-crowded, and the proliferation and AMOUNT of boats docking a mere 300' from shore, obscure the once awesome views. Each boat competes with one another with their on-board DJ and the extra bodies brought onshore make it even more crowded. "Seaweed." "Seagrass." Way too much of this stuff on the shoreline and needs to be commercially managed and cleaned as the odor from it drying in the sun is too much to desire. Overall, this once pristine stretch of pleasure is in dire need of municipal attention like a year ago.

reviews.title: Playa Norte
reviews.text: Beautiful! A must see when in Cancun!! Take the ferry out to Isla de Las Mujeres and rent a golf cart to see the island at your own pace $12 USD per hour

reviews.title: Paradise
reviews.text: Yes! This is a Paradise!The most beautiful memories !Amazing clear sea and fantastic colour of water.Unforgettable sunrise and sunsets!

reviews.title: Amazing
reviews.text: This is by far the best beach I have ever visited. Crystal clear water. We arrived early and had few people around us we got to fully enjoy this beach. Highly recommend to visit if you get the chance.

reviews.title: Wow!!!
reviews.text: Beautiful beach the water is such a beautiful colour as is the sand. It is very busy in the day when all the day trippers come across however come early evening the place will quiet down and it is perfect. It is a lovely beach to sit and watch the sunset. Instead of buying chairs and umbrella find a restaurant order food and drink and the seats are then free for the day!!!!!

reviews.title: Paradise
reviews.text: There's not much to say about playa norte other than you need to see it to believe it, take some time to apreciate the island and respect its fauna.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach, with something for everyone
reviews.text: Lots of people, grab a chair and umbrella at one of the clubs and chill for the day. The people watching is worth the whole day. THe water is beautiful and the sand is pure white and clean. If you want less crowd, go to the left when entering the public access (towards 33 or Mayan Grill Club). Mayan grill club as great food on the beach and drinks and the most comfortable beach lounges. If you go the right,  you will be in the area where most of the boats park, so there is a lot of competing music, which might be your thing. Just walk until you find what suits your taste and have a great day!

reviews.title: White sand, cool clear water.
reviews.text: Great place to cool off. No seaweed, beautiful sand and clear water, lots of open space to swim. A great beach.

reviews.title: Gorgeous
reviews.text: The water is crystal clear and have white sand beaches! There are areas where they charge $25 for lounge chairs. We decided to put our stuff right next to those chairs and that was free! Bring towels, if you happen to forget one, they have lots of outdoor markets that sell towels from $10-$25 (plan ahead). Waves were prefect the day we went and not choppy.

reviews.title: The beach
reviews.text: A pleasant place to sit and enjoy the beach, the weather and lots of people about late in the day for the sunset.

reviews.title: Fantastic Beach.
reviews.text: We stayed in a condo complex on Playa Norte and loved the beach. It was clean, (no seaweed), the sand was beautiful and lots of different beach clubs to sit at. Highly recommend this beach when visiting Isla Mujeres.

reviews.title: Island chill
reviews.text: This was our first time staying on Isla Mujeres.  We had visited the Isla about 20 years ago when my wife had just graduated from graduate school and we took a celebration vacation to Cancun.  This visit was much different from the booze cruise two decades earlier.  This time we truly got to experience Isla Mujeres and Playa Norte.  The beach was very calm, clean and not as crowded as most beaches.   I think this was due to the low population of travelers as opposed to Cancun.  We stayed at the Privilege Aluxes which afforded us a mostly private beach in front of the hotel.   The Aluxes has a bar/restaurant right on the beach which spoiled us greatly.  We were quite thrilled by the waiters bringing cerveza in ice buckets and food to our palapa.  The beach was cool white sand flowing into brilliant blue-green Caribbean Gulf water.  The great thing was the water temp was a little cool, but once you were in it felt so good you didn't want to leave.  The only sea life that we saw were some beautiful translucent fish and a starfish that had made its way close to shore.  There were no jellyfish and no seaweed, which was a big problem in Cancun.There are many places on and within walking distance of the beach to eat and drink.  There are chairs and umbrellas to rent on the public beach and you can purchase day passes for private beach front from hotels.  Still, it never feels crowded.This is one of the most chill beaches we have visited and would highly recommend this area.The only reason we will not be rating it five star is because there is constant boat traffic in front of this beach.  Cancun booze cruise boats, Isla booze cruise boats, and dive boats aren't that bad;fun to people watch.  The thing that takes some getting used to is the ferry boats that run from Cancun to the Isla.  The tourist boats aren't that bad, but there are some older rougher running boats that are not that pretty and smell kind of bad if the wind is blowing the wrong way.  With that said, more cerveza, some Valentina sauce wings and some loaded nachos make every thing better.

reviews.title: Fantastic
reviews.text: We are living in Puerto Morelos, MX and our beach have lots of Sargrasso. Thick, brown Seaweed. We have teens visiting that want crystal clear beach water. So, we found our way to Playa Norte, Isla Mujeres. Wow. It’s was fantastic. No Sargasso. Just a beautiful beach. We stayed all day. It’s a must visit beach off Cancun by ferry.

reviews.title: Best beach on Isla Mujeres
reviews.text: This is the best beach on Isla Mujeres. Soft white sand and minimal current make it very enjoyable. it does get a little crowded, but that is because it's the best beach there. We tried a beach on the West side and the current was very strong which could be uncomfortable for someone who isn't a strong swimmer.

reviews.title: Postcard perfect
reviews.text: Playa Norte is an amazing place with great beaches, great views and best of all the first to see sunrise and sunset.

reviews.title: calm and clear
reviews.text: Playa Norte is the calmest clear water you will ever see. Go to the furthest rigt edge of Plya Norte facing the water and you will be able to walk out 100 yards and still be standing up. A alot of great bars with wonderful food and drinks will be along the whole route to it.Cant tell you enough how beautiful it is there.

reviews.title: Most beautiful water, and VERY handicap accessible!
reviews.text: I have been fortunate to travel to a lot of beach locales in the US, Caribbean, and Pacific, and I have to say that may be the most beautiful water I've ever seen. It was as clear as bathwater and as wonderfully cool. Also, what a fantastic surprise to see how handicap accessible it was! Though he was not with us this trip, we have a child in a wheelchair and are always looking for places to go. With accessible water chairs available. plenty of parking, and dedicated and well-maintained accessible bathrooms and changing areas, bringing the kids back to Playa Norte is now a family must-do!

reviews.title: Beautiful
reviews.text: The beaches here are absolutely beautiful.  Plenty of places to shop and eat.  Just a nice beach for especially small children.

reviews.title: Beautiful
reviews.text: My family of 16 visited last Wednesday July 4th, the beach is beautiful with plenty of choices of where to eat and relax.Great experience. Turquoise calm water, perfect for children.

reviews.title: Beautiful Beach
reviews.text: Beautiful, clean and calm. Some areas are for family and some for couples. You can rent two chairs and umbrella for $20-$25 a day and buy drinks from the palapa in the beach.

reviews.title: Beautiful, Bustling Public Beach.
reviews.text: We took a day trip from the comfort of our resort to see some of the sights on Isla Mujeres, and were recommended this beach by the concierge at our hotel, and it did not disappoint! We arrived with our beach gear and immediately found the water to be shallow, a beautiful aqua color, and the perfect temperature. We put our things on the beach and swam for well over and hour. We took lots of photos because it was so beautiful. Lots of boats go by and cause some gentle waves which are fun for the kids.There are tons of people here enjoying the beach - I even caught an engagement on camera!If I'm ever back on Isla Mujeres, I will definitely come to enjoy Playa Norte again!

reviews.title: The most stunning beach on Earth!
reviews.text: Playa Norte is a stunning beach. Crystal blue water like you have never seen before and the whitest of white sand. Mornings on the beach are the best - quiet and peaceful with hardly anybody around. Afternoons get busy with boats arriving, music and loads of people. There is something for everybody on this beach.  Swim, snorkel, enjoy a beer or simply just relax.

reviews.title: beautiful clear blue water
reviews.text: Playa Norte on Isla Mujeres is beautiful the water is a clear blue and the atmosphere is awesome on this little island south of Cancun if you go you will leave your soul there.

reviews.title: AMAZING BEACH!
reviews.text: We came to Playa Norte on June 28th 2018.   The weather was amazing .. sunny! HOT! but the beach and water were the star of the day - water was calm and perfect!  I could have swam in it all day.  Waves were gentle .. breeze was warm.  We rented chairs and while some napped others played in the best beach ever.. Playa Norte!!

reviews.title: Stunning beach on the island
reviews.text: Make sure to get to the beach early to get a lounger, and sip cocktails all day to get the loungers for free (at some hotels - make sure to check minimum spend vs lounger rentals). Negotiate with any hawkers on items, as they double the price for tourists, especially those who can't speak Spanish. Bought necklaces for US$30, which were originally priced at US$60!

reviews.title: Fantastic
reviews.text: Great beach to relax ... and snorkel. Water very shallow .. great for family with children. The water it’s very clear and the sand white and fine like sugar On our visit we went to playa Norte every morning.

reviews.title: awesome beach
reviews.text: This is one of the best beaches that we have visited, the blue/Turquoise water and white sand was amazing. You can spend half day or even all the day on the beach.The beach is in a walking distance from the ferry terminal and you can rent a beach chair or a table with regular chairs with umbrella. (we paid 300 pesos for a table with 7 chairs).Also there is alot of restaurants/bars that you can order near (some of them give you free beach char based on minimal consumption) by and also there are xoxo or 7 eleven market near by so you can buy your drinks and snacks.indeed there are a lot of obstacles to walk around all the beach, so probably would be good to pick a good spot to spend the day.Note: If you are going to spend your time on 'El Centro' to buy souvenirs  and the beach, renting a golf car might not be a wise option. Both are in a walking distance.

reviews.title: very good
reviews.text: very good service all the cabeall the hotelall the flightall the foodall the accoudational the way good

reviews.title: Beautiful, Perfect, Well-loved
reviews.text: An unbelievably beautiful place to spend the day. The color is perfect. The gentleness of the water is perfect. The vast amount of shallow swimming is perfect. We walked along the water from the Privilege area to Mia area, and it was all beautiful.

reviews.title: Stunning
reviews.text: This is by all means one of the best beaches I have been to. Crystal clear, blue calm waters. Great for kids. We went during low season so it was pretty good. You choose a chair or a spot with an umbrella. A young man will then come by and charge you That's just the way it works. 90 pesos for one chair. Massages were offered to is at 40 U.S. dollars. Paid 10 pesos at restaurant to wash off sand. We certainly enjoyed our time here.

reviews.title: Like a swimming pool!!!
reviews.text: Gorgeous turquoise crystal clear water. Warm and wonderful. Right outside of our hotel. Tour boats in abundance outside of the rope barrier, but it's a big ocean and we never felt crowded

reviews.title: Playa Norte
reviews.text: Incredible beautiful beach!! Such an amazing view! Arrive early for covered seating paid around $14 for a chair for all day! Different restaurants will come to you for lunch so you will never have to leave. Head to Mia’s bridge to see some fish!

reviews.title: Stunning Beach!
reviews.text: Playa Norte has to be one of the most beautiful beaches we have been to. The soft white sand and the aqua colored water that seems to go on forever. We stayed at the Mia Reef which is at the end of Playa Norte but it's beautiful all up and down this beach. Boats to bring folks over from Cancun on tours, but it's a big beach and there is plenty of room for everyone. If you get a chance I highly recommend a visit to Playa Norte....it's unforgettable.

reviews.title: Go early if you have young kids
reviews.text: It’s a fun place to get the beach experience with the white sands and blue water.  Go early to take advantage of the cool mornings and beat the crowds.  Also, getting there early means the attire of other beach patrons stays family friendly, after about 11:00, anything goes...

reviews.title: Nice beach, awkward to walk all the way around, lots of crappy obticals
reviews.text: You can really not walk very far along the beach. Maybe 15 min then there are too many obsticals in the way to go further. The water is warm, clear and calm.

reviews.title: Beautiful
reviews.text: Lovely beach with affordable amenities and lots of beach bars!  People are very helpful but we had no one bother us about buying things!

reviews.title: Amazing beach!
reviews.text: Soft white sand and clear blue water. Paradise does not even come close to describing this amazing beach. You must go!

reviews.title: Great beach
reviews.text: Be prepared to pay for your shade umbrella if your not staying at a hotel here. In addition, be prepared for more people to constantly ask you if you want to buy something as they walk up and down the beach with their items for sale.The service was good. Our waiter was Johnny on the spot with our drinks and was very attentive. The beach is great & the water is plenty warm.

reviews.title: Never seen anything like it
reviews.text: We were told a few times “visit the north beach, it’s the best beach” etc. When we got there it certainly didn’t let us down. Quite simply stunning. Crystal clear water and pure white sand. We headed off to one side and found ourselves a secluded small beach, which after climbing down a few rocks we enjoyed a paddle and a bit of snorkelling. Views are breathtaking. Highly recommended.

reviews.title: Super beach!
reviews.text: This is the best beach we have ever visited.  Love the atmosphere.  The water is clear and not too deep.

reviews.title: Crystal clear waters and white sand
reviews.text: It was everything advertised. We rented a double bed Cabana for the day for $20 and had shade just 30 feet from the water.Very nice spot.
